EHR_Dialogue_False_FoodAsAnxiety_1: Just stress... my stomach always acts up...
EHR_Dialogue_False_FoodAsFlu_1: Must be the flu going around...
EHR_Dialogue_False_HypoAsExhaustion_1: Just need to rest... so tired...
EHR_Dialogue_False_HypoAsFlu_1: Coming down with something... feel cold and achy...
EHR_Dialogue_False_SepsisAsFlu_1: Just a bad flu, I'll sleep it off...
EHR_Dialogue_False_SepsisAsFood_2: Probably just food poisoning, it'll pass...
EHR_Dialogue_False_SepsisAsFood_3: Bad food is all, need to rest...
EHR_Dialogue_Flu_S1_Expert_1: Typical influenza presentation. Monitor for complications.
EHR_Dialogue_Flu_S1_Inter_1: Influenza symptoms. Rest and fluids needed.
EHR_Dialogue_Flu_S1_Master_1: Influenza-like illness, likely viral URI. Symptomatic treatment indicated.
EHR_Dialogue_Flu_S2_Expert_1: Influenza with systemic symptoms. Risk of secondary bacterial infection.
EHR_Dialogue_Flu_S2_Inter_1: Moderate flu. Watch for pneumonia signs.
EHR_Dialogue_Flu_S2_Master_1: Moderate influenza. Oseltamivir within 48h of onset would be ideal.
EHR_Dialogue_Flu_S3_Expert_1: Complicated influenza, possible viral pneumonia or bacterial superinfection.
EHR_Dialogue_Flu_S3_Inter_1: Severe flu with respiratory involvement. Need antibiotics for secondary infection.
EHR_Dialogue_Flu_S3_Master_1: Severe influenza with ARDS risk. Empiric antibiotics for bacterial co-infection.
EHR_Dialogue_Flu_S3_Novice_1: Worst flu ever... can't breathe right...
EHR_Dialogue_Flu_S4_Master_1: Fulminant influenza with cytokine storm and multi-organ failure.
EHR_Dialogue_FoodPoisoning_S1_Expert_1: Acute gastroenteritis from contaminated food. Onset suggests bacterial toxin.
EHR_Dialogue_FoodPoisoning_S1_Inter_1: Foodborne illness. Need to stay hydrated.
EHR_Dialogue_FoodPoisoning_S1_Master_1: Foodborne intoxication, likely Staphylococcal or Bacillus cereus based on onset time.
EHR_Dialogue_FoodPoisoning_S2_Expert_1: Acute phase. Monitor for signs of dehydration and electrolyte imbalance.
EHR_Dialogue_FoodPoisoning_S2_Inter_1: Severe dehydration risk. Need oral rehydration.
EHR_Dialogue_FoodPoisoning_S2_Master_1: Peak toxin effect. Supportive care and fluid replacement indicated.
EHR_Dialogue_FoodPoisoning_S3_Expert_1: Hypovolemic state from fluid loss. Critical dehydration.
EHR_Dialogue_FoodPoisoning_S3_Inter_1: Severe dehydration. Need IV fluids if possible.
EHR_Dialogue_FoodPoisoning_S3_Master_1: Severe gastroenteritis with hypovolemia. IV fluid resuscitation required.
EHR_Dialogue_FoodPoisoning_S3_Novice_1: This is really bad... I'm too weak...
EHR_Dialogue_FoodPoisoning_S4_Expert_1: Cardiac and renal compromise from severe dehydration.
EHR_Dialogue_FoodPoisoning_S4_Inter_1: Organ stress from dehydration... this could kill me...
EHR_Dialogue_FoodPoisoning_S4_Master_1: Multi-system failure secondary to hypovolemic shock.
EHR_Dialogue_HeatStroke_S1_Expert_1: Heat exhaustion progressing. Risk of exertional heat stroke.
EHR_Dialogue_HeatStroke_S1_Inter_1: Early heat illness. Core temp rising. Need cooling now.
EHR_Dialogue_HeatStroke_S1_Master_1: Thermoregulatory stress. Remove from heat, begin cooling measures.
EHR_Dialogue_HeatStroke_S1_Novice_1: Getting heat exhaustion... need shade and water...
EHR_Dialogue_HeatStroke_S2_Expert_1: Classic heat stroke - hyperthermia with CNS dysfunction. Ice water immersion if available.
EHR_Dialogue_HeatStroke_S2_Inter_1: Heat stroke developing. Mental status changes. Emergency cooling needed.
EHR_Dialogue_HeatStroke_S2_Master_1: Exertional heat stroke, core likely >40C. Rapid cooling critical to prevent rhabdomyolysis.
EHR_Dialogue_HeatStroke_S2_Novice_1: Heat stroke... need to cool down fast!
EHR_Dialogue_HeatStroke_S3_Expert_1: Multi-organ dysfunction from hyperthermia. Coagulopathy likely.
EHR_Dialogue_HeatStroke_S3_Inter_1: Severe heat stroke. Organ damage occurring.
EHR_Dialogue_HeatStroke_S3_Master_1: Severe heat stroke with DIC and rhabdomyolysis. Mortality risk extreme.
EHR_Dialogue_HeatStroke_S4_Master_1: End-stage heat stroke with cerebral edema and multi-system failure.
EHR_Dialogue_Hypothermia_S1_Expert_1: Stage 1 hypothermia - shivering, vasoconstriction. Need passive rewarming.
EHR_Dialogue_Hypothermia_S1_Inter_1: Mild hypothermia. Need shelter and warmth now.
EHR_Dialogue_Hypothermia_S1_Inter_2: Core temp dropping. Shivering is a warning sign.
EHR_Dialogue_Hypothermia_S1_Master_1: Mild hypothermia, core temp 32-35C. Remove wet clothing, passive external rewarming.
EHR_Dialogue_Hypothermia_S1_Novice_1: Getting too cold... need to warm up...
EHR_Dialogue_Hypothermia_S2_Clueless_1: S-so sleepy... just want to rest...
EHR_Dialogue_Hypothermia_S2_Expert_1: Stage 2 hypothermia - decreased shivering, mental confusion. Active rewarming needed.
EHR_Dialogue_Hypothermia_S2_Inter_1: Moderate hypothermia. Confusion setting in. Need heat source.
EHR_Dialogue_Hypothermia_S2_Master_1: Moderate hypothermia, core 28-32C. Active external rewarming, handle gently to avoid cardiac arrhythmia.
EHR_Dialogue_Hypothermia_S2_Novice_1: This is bad... can't feel my hands anymore...
EHR_Dialogue_Hypothermia_S3_Expert_1: Severe hypothermia - paradoxical undressing, cardiac risk. ICU-level care needed.
EHR_Dialogue_Hypothermia_S3_Inter_1: Severe hypothermia. Paradoxical warmth means I'm dying.
EHR_Dialogue_Hypothermia_S3_Master_1: Severe hypothermia, core below 28C. Risk of ventricular fibrillation. Active core rewarming required.
EHR_Dialogue_Hypothermia_S3_Novice_1: Feel warm now... that's bad, isn't it...
EHR_Dialogue_Hypothermia_S4_Master_1: Core temp critical. Apparent death. CPR and ECMO rewarming only hope.
EHR_Dialogue_Sepsis_S1_Clueless_1: I feel really off... maybe tired?
EHR_Dialogue_Sepsis_S1_Clueless_3: Why do I feel so weird?
EHR_Dialogue_Sepsis_S1_Expert_1: SIRS criteria - elevated temp, increased heart rate.
EHR_Dialogue_Sepsis_S1_Expert_2: Early sepsis indicators. IV antibiotics needed.
EHR_Dialogue_Sepsis_S1_Expert_3: Inflammatory response to wound infection detected.
EHR_Dialogue_Sepsis_S1_Inter_1: Early signs of infection. Need antibiotics.
EHR_Dialogue_Sepsis_S1_Inter_2: Wound's getting infected, need to treat this fast.
EHR_Dialogue_Sepsis_S1_Inter_3: Systemic infection starting. This is serious.
EHR_Dialogue_Sepsis_S1_Master_1: Sepsis Stage 1. qSOFA score indicates systemic response.
EHR_Dialogue_Sepsis_S1_Master_2: Presenting with SIRS. Broad-spectrum antibiotics required.
EHR_Dialogue_Sepsis_S1_Novice_1: I might be getting sick from that wound...
EHR_Dialogue_Sepsis_S1_Novice_2: That cut doesn't look good, I feel feverish
EHR_Dialogue_Sepsis_S1_Novice_3: Think my wound might be infected...
EHR_Dialogue_Sepsis_S2_Clueless_1: I feel terrible... so tired and cold...
EHR_Dialogue_Sepsis_S2_Expert_1: Organ dysfunction beginning. Lactate levels likely elevated.
EHR_Dialogue_Sepsis_S2_Expert_2: Severe sepsis. Need fluid resuscitation and antibiotics.
EHR_Dialogue_Sepsis_S2_Inter_1: Sepsis progressing. Need stronger antibiotics now.
EHR_Dialogue_Sepsis_S2_Inter_2: Blood pressure dropping. This is septic shock territory.
EHR_Dialogue_Sepsis_S2_Master_1: Severe sepsis with hypoperfusion. Immediate intervention required.
EHR_Dialogue_Sepsis_S2_Novice_1: The infection is spreading... need medicine!
EHR_Dialogue_Sepsis_S3_Clueless_1: I... I can't... everything is wrong...
EHR_Dialogue_Sepsis_S3_Clueless_2: So cold... can't feel my hands...
EHR_Dialogue_Sepsis_S3_Expert_1: Multi-organ dysfunction syndrome. Mortality rate critical.
EHR_Dialogue_Sepsis_S3_Inter_1: Septic shock. Organs are failing. Need emergency care.
EHR_Dialogue_Sepsis_S3_Master_1: Refractory septic shock. Without ICU-level intervention, prognosis is terminal.
EHR_Dialogue_Sepsis_S3_Novice_1: I'm dying... the infection is killing me...
EHR_Dialogue_Sepsis_S4_Expert_1: Terminal sepsis... no viable treatment options remain...
EHR_Dialogue_Sepsis_S4_Inter_1: Total organ failure... nothing can save me now...
EHR_Dialogue_Treat_Sepsis_Master: Broad-spectrum IV antibiotics, fluid resuscitation, source control
EHR_Dialogue_WoundInfection_S1_Expert_1: Cellulitis developing. Oral antibiotics should suffice at this stage.
EHR_Dialogue_WoundInfection_S1_Inter_1: Local wound infection. Needs cleaning and antibiotics.
EHR_Dialogue_WoundInfection_S1_Master_1: Localized bacterial infection, likely Staph aureus. Debridement and antibiotics.
EHR_Dialogue_WoundInfection_S1_Novice_1: Wound is getting infected... need to clean it...
EHR_Dialogue_WoundInfection_S2_Expert_1: Progressing soft tissue infection. IV antibiotics warranted.
EHR_Dialogue_WoundInfection_S2_Inter_1: Advancing cellulitis. Risk of systemic spread.
EHR_Dialogue_WoundInfection_S2_Master_1: Spreading cellulitis with abscess formation. I&D may be necessary.
EHR_Dialogue_WoundInfection_S2_Novice_1: Infection is spreading... this is bad...
EHR_Dialogue_WoundInfection_S3_Expert_1: Necrotizing soft tissue infection possible. Urgent surgical evaluation needed.
EHR_Dialogue_WoundInfection_S3_Inter_1: Severe wound infection. May become septic.
EHR_Dialogue_WoundInfection_S3_Master_1: Suspected necrotizing fasciitis. Emergent surgical debridement is life-saving.
EHR_Dialogue_WoundInfection_S3_Novice_1: Infection is really bad now... feel feverish...
EHR_Dialogue_WoundInfection_S4_Expert_1: Gas gangrene or necrotizing fasciitis. Amputation or death.
EHR_Dialogue_WoundInfection_S4_Master_1: Fournier's gangrene or Type I necrotizing fasciitis. Mortality exceeds 30%% even with surgery.
EHR_Dialogue_WoundInfection_S4_Novice_1: I'm going to lose this limb... or worse...
EHR_Dialogue_WrongTreat_HypoAsFlu_1: Take some medicine for the fever...
EHR_Dialogue_WrongTreat_SepsisAsFood_1: Just need to rest and let it pass...
EHR_Dialogue_WrongTreat_SepsisAsFood_2: Drink fluids, it's just food poisoning...

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_Secret_1: The public mirrors are failing, but the old archive at %s still answers. Save what you need while it is up.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_Secret_2: Someone on radio mentioned %s. It looks abandoned, but the downloads still work.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_Secret_3: If you are looking for the missing manuals, try %s before the relays go dark.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_Secret_4: The board at %s is still reachable. Do not waste bandwidth downloading everything.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_Secret_5: I found useful scans at %s. Writing the address here in case I do not get another connection.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_1: Signal check. If anyone can read this, one relay is still carrying traffic east of the county.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_10: Looking to trade lamp oil and clean jars for batteries. I check this board every second evening.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_11: Mark blocked roads in pencil. Wrecks move, fires spread and yesterday's safe route may be closed tomorrow.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_12: Large groups of infected drift west after heavy rain. The fields are quieter for now.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_13: The shallow well tastes wrong after the last storm. Boil everything, even if it looks clear.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_14: Cold weather will come eventually. Collect blankets and seal broken windows before supplies are buried under snow.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_15: Replaced a burned fuse at the relay. Connection should hold until the generator needs fuel again.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_16: Someone is leaving empty cans as trail markers near the warehouses. It may be a trap, so watch the rooftops.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_17: Clean wounds immediately and keep bandages dry. Infection from dirty cuts is still dangerous even without a bite.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_18: Saving cabbage and tomato seed for spring. Leave a reply if you have packets worth trading.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_19: I transmit at noon when fuel allows. If you answer, keep it short and never give an exact location.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_2: We found clean water, but the road south is packed with wrecks. Travel on foot and stay off the pavement.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_20: No network signal remains south of the rail yard. This relay is probably the edge of the connected area.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_21: Weekly check-in: two voices answered on radio, one new light seen at night, no safe road east.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_22: Found fresh footprints near the creek that were not ours. Someone else is surviving out there.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_3: Three of us are still here. We only connect when the generator is running, so replies may take a while.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_4: Saw lights in an upstairs window last night. If that was you, cover them before dark.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_5: Canned food is getting hard to find. Gardens and rain barrels matter more every day.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_6: Long-range radio has gone quiet again. Local relays may be all that remains of the network.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_7: Another week, another signal check. Leave a short post if you are alive.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_8: Do not follow the highway signs north. The road ends in a wall of abandoned cars.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_9: Potatoes are growing in buckets on the roof. It is not much, but it proves we can make food without leaving the building.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Deta: We will check the location again after the next weather change.
Mark it on paper because the route may not remain safe.
Travel quietly and leave before the light starts to fade.
A small group can use it, but a crowd would attract trouble.
Fuel and clean water are still the limits on how long anyone can stay.
Leave a short reply if conditions change before our next connection.
We are not sharing an exact camp location over the board.
The infected wander through irregularly, so wait and watch before approaching.
This may help someone who reaches the area later in the season.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen: Rain barrels behind the brick apartments are full and the upper lids are still sealed.
Dry seed packets were found inside metal drawers at the farm supply office.
Bicycles can pass the vehicle pileup beside the highway without drawing much attention.
The creek north of the tracks is clear upstream but contaminated below the wrecked tanker.
A two-person watch rotation kept the courtyard quiet through the last three nights.
A covered trade cache has been placed beneath the fallen sign near the county road.
The backup generator at the service building runs cleanly after replacing its cracked fuel line.
The western fields are quiet at dawn, with only a few infected near the tree line.
A locked cabinet in the small clinic still holds bandages, disinfectant and sealed gloves.
The north warehouse has useful hand tools, but the loading floor is unstable near the office wall.
The old bridge can be crossed on foot if you stay beside the southern railing.
The relay mast is working again after cleaning corrosion from the battery contacts.
Thin cooking smoke appeared on the ridge for three evenings and vanished before sunrise.
Cold nights are arriving earlier, and several empty houses still have intact fireplaces.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_1: There are people in the street attacking anyone who falls. This is real. Turn off your lights and stay quiet.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_10: If this post goes through, the network is still alive somewhere. People are not answering anymore.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_11: We barricaded the store, but the glass will not hold another rush. Moving upstairs while we still can.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_12: Fire jumped from the clinic roof to the building next door. There are no crews left to stop it.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_13: Someone keeps calling for help from the intersection. Every time a person goes out, more of them appear.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_14: The last school bus is overturned by the rail crossing. Do not take that road.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_15: Gunshots solve one problem and bring twenty more. Use them only if you have no other choice.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_16: No ambulances, no police, no fire department. Whatever supplies you have are all you are getting.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_17: Our shop doors gave way. I am leaving tools behind and taking only water, fuel and the truck.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_18: We are trapped above the second floor. The stairwell is full of them and the fire escape is damaged.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_19: A helicopter circled twice without landing. People ran into the street and drew a crowd of infected behind them.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_2: The checkpoint is gone. Cars are burning on both sides of the road and nobody is directing traffic.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_20: Save your radio batteries. Most stations are dead and the few remaining signals repeat old recordings.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_21: The evacuation convoy never made it past the interchange. Do not follow the abandoned buses.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_22: The supermarket is completely overrun. There is food in smaller houses if you can enter without making noise.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_23: My neighbor died last night and stood back up this morning. Stop waiting for this to make sense.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_24: The eastern bridge is burning and part of the span has collapsed. There is no route through downtown.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_25: This board takes longer to load every hour. Copy down useful addresses before the connection disappears.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_26: If your generator is outside, shut it down before refueling. The sound carries farther than you think.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_27: We waited as long as we could. My family is leaving before sunrise. I hope somebody reading this gets out too.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_3: We are leaving through the back roads. If the bridge is blocked, we will try the old service road.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_4: They do not stay down unless the head is destroyed. I wish I was making this up.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_5: Water pressure just stopped. Fill every container you have while anything is still coming from the tap.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_6: Military frequencies are mostly silent. A repeating transmission says major routes are compromised.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_7: Is anyone on this board actually safe? Please answer with your town, not your address.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_8: The hospital is burning. I cannot reach my brother anymore.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_9: Do not use sirens or car horns. The noise pulls them in from blocks away.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Detail_1: There are no emergency crews left in sight.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Detail_2: Noise draws more of them before anyone can clear a path.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Detail_3: Anyone still moving through the area should stay out of the open.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Detail_4: We watched several survivors turn back and disappear between the buildings.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Detail_5: The safest route from yesterday is already unusable.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Detail_6: If this board stays online, post a warning before anyone else walks into it.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_1: Fire has crossed the downtown block and the smoke is hiding movement at street level.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_2: The infected packed against the road barrier until the fencing folded into the traffic lane.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_3: People in the apartment building pulled furniture into the stairwell and cut the lights.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_4: The warehouse doors are open and armed groups are dragging crates into pickup trucks.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_5: The evacuation line broke apart when the lead vehicles tried to turn around.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_6: The telephone exchange is dark, but one pay phone outside keeps ringing by itself.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_7: Freight cars are blocking the rail yard while infected move between them in large groups.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_8: Every house on Cedar Street is silent except one alarm that has been sounding for hours.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_1: Did anyone else lose cable for a minute? Mine came back, but every local channel is showing the same county notice.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_10: Our grocery delivery never arrived this morning. The manager says the truck was turned around at the county line.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_11: County used to run emergency drills every summer. This does not look like any drill I remember.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_12: Rumor at school says classes might be cancelled tomorrow. Teachers were told not to discuss it with students.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_13: Long-distance calls connect for a few seconds and then drop. Local calls still work sometimes.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_14: We sold out of masks before lunch. Please stop shouting at the counter staff; we do not have more in the back.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_15: There is no severe weather in the forecast. Whatever is causing the outages, it is not a storm.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_16: Highway patrol came through asking every shop how many tow trucks were running. They would not say why.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_17: The daycare called for early pickup. They said several employees failed to arrive for work.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_18: Three helicopters crossed town heading south. Too high to see markings, but they were moving fast.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_19: Our office sent everyone home before noon. They told us to take our files but leave the computers on.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_2: Traffic is backed up past the school. If you are heading into town, take the long way around.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_20: Lunch crowd is full of people trading rumors. Nobody has heard the same story twice.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_21: The library is closing early. Do not worry about due dates until regular hours resume.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_22: Package routes east of town are suspended. Anything already on a truck may be returned to the depot.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_23: If you own a battery radio, check it now. Local stations are already having trouble staying on air.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_3: The pharmacy line is out the door. People keep saying it is just a bad flu, so why is everyone buying masks?
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_4: Is tonight's game cancelled or not? The radio keeps cutting away before they say anything useful.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_5: Power blinked twice on our block. Save whatever you are working on before it happens again.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_6: The emergency broadcast says to stay calm and avoid unnecessary travel. No evacuation order has been issued.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_7: My brother works near the hospital. He says ambulances have been arriving nonstop since before sunrise.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_8: Does anyone know why the pay phones are all busy? I cannot get through to my parents in Louisville.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_9: The gas station has a line around the block. Half the people there are filling spare cans.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Detail_: People are treating it like a temporary inconvenience, but the mood is changing.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Scene_1: The bank closed its lobby before lunch and moved every employee away from the front windows.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Scene_2: The bus depot cancelled two routes without posting a replacement schedule.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Scene_3: County offices are stacking file boxes in the hallway and sending temporary staff home.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Scene_4: The grocery store limited water and canned food to two cases per customer.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Scene_5: Telephone repair crews were called back to their yard before finishing today's service calls.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Scene_6: The local radio station asked volunteers to bring spare batteries and extension cords.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Scene_7: The animal shelter stopped accepting strays and asked owners to keep pets indoors.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_1: The school sent everyone home. One of the buses never arrived and nobody at the office will answer.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_10: My son has a fever but no bites. The emergency number rings once and disconnects. What am I supposed to do?
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_11: An abandoned car rolled into our lot with blood on the driver's door. Nobody has come looking for it.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_12: There is screaming behind the clinic and something keeps hitting the side entrance from inside.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_13: Both roads toward the county line are blocked now. People are turning around and driving across fields.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_14: The emergency shelter at the school is locked. A note on the door says to remain at home.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_15: Television keeps repeating the same message, but the footage behind the anchor is getting worse.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_16: Antibiotics will not fix this. We tried to explain that before the crowd broke the front windows.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_17: A coworker collapsed in the parking lot and attacked the people helping him. Police never arrived.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_18: Power has been off for an hour. We are cooking what will spoil and giving it away at the back door.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_19: My delivery van was surrounded near the courthouse. I left it running and got out through an alley.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_2: Police closed the main road. I saw people running between cars near the checkpoint.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_20: Families are sheltering in the reading room. We pushed shelves against the glass doors.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_21: Every dog on our street has been barking since sunset. Now some of them have stopped all at once.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_22: The dark column north of town is smoke, not cloud cover. Wind is carrying it east.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_23: The AM station ended mid-sentence. One weak signal is still repeating instructions to boil water.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_3: Do not go to the clinic. The doors are locked and the parking lot is completely full.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_4: They are saying bites now. Not fever, bites. What kind of sickness spreads through bites?
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_5: Someone is pounding on the house across the street. The owners will not open the door.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_6: Shortwave traffic reports trouble in more than one town. This is not limited to Knox County.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_7: The television signal is gone. If anyone still has radio news, please post what you hear.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_8: My brother finally called. He said to lock every door and not let anyone inside, even if they look injured.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_9: Soldiers are checking cars near the bridge. They turned us back without explaining where we should go.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Detai: Nobody in charge will explain what triggered the response.
The crowd gets more frightened each time another emergency vehicle passes.
People are leaving on foot because traffic is no longer moving.
Anyone nearby should keep their distance and find another route.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Scene: A second checkpoint appeared on the highway and officers are searching every vehicle.
Hospital staff put tents in the parking lot, then moved everyone back inside without warning.
The school shelter opened for less than an hour before guards locked the outer gates.
The supermarket stopped selling food after a fight spread from the checkout line.
Sheriff cars keep passing toward downtown with lights on and no sirens.
Technicians climbed the radio tower this morning and came down carrying equipment cases.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day1_1: Hey, random add, but do I know you from the county board? Everything around town is acting strange today.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day1_2: Sorry if I added the wrong person. Have you heard why the roads near the hospital are blocked?
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day1_3: Hi. The phone lines are busy and this is the only service that still connects. Is it normal where you are?
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day2_1: Thanks for accepting. People here are saying the sickness makes them violent. Lock your doors tonight.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day2_2: The news stopped giving details. If you hear anything reliable, stay inside and keep a radio nearby.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day2_3: I added anyone who looked local. My family is trying to decide whether to leave before the roads close.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day3_1: The phones are dead here. We are leaving town before dark. Do not go near anyone who has been bitten.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day3_2: I can hear sirens everywhere and nobody is answering emergency calls. Find somewhere quiet and stay there.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day3_3: They broke through the store entrance. I am moving to the back roads now. Good luck, whoever you are.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day4_1: This may be my last connection. They are in the street and the power keeps failing. Do not come looking for me.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day4_2: We are shutting the generator down after this message. Noise brings them closer. Stay alive.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day4_3: Almost everyone on my contact list has gone offline. If you can read this, keep moving and avoid the main roads.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_Advertisement_1: Your Value Club account qualifies for special prices on batteries, bottled water and household storage. Bring this message to any participating location.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_Advertisement_2: Summer cabins are still available near the lake. Reserve two nights and receive the third night free. Telephone confirmation required.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_Advertisement_3: New kitchen organizers, tool cabinets and weather radios are now available by mail order. Ask about our twelve-month payment plan.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_Advertisement_4: Schedule a complimentary tire and battery inspection this week. Offer valid while appointment slots remain.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_Advertisement_5: Rent any new release and choose a second tape at no charge. Late fees and membership rules still apply.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_fire_1_Body: Complete the engine and breathing apparatus checklist before the next shift change. Report missing seals immediately.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_fire_2_Body: Saturday's mutual aid drill begins at 0700. Bring turnout gear and a working portable radio.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_fitness_1_Body: An instructor is needed for two evening classes this week. Reply if you can cover either session.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_fitness_2_Body: The new conditioning plan is available at the front desk. Review hydration guidance before outdoor sessions.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_food_1_Body: The morning delivery is expected early. Cold items must be checked and stored before regular preparation begins.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_food_2_Body: The county food safety refresher is scheduled for Thursday. Bring your current certification card.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_general_1_Body: New clerical, warehouse and maintenance openings were posted this morning. Applications are available at the county office.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_general_2_Body: Registration is open for evening courses in first aid, home repair and basic computing. Space is limited.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_medical_1_Body: Additional clinical coverage is needed this week. Reply with your certification and the hours you can work.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_medical_2_Body: The infection control refresher has been moved to the main conference room. Attendance will be recorded.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_outdoors_1_Body: Recent rain has damaged several access roads. Use the north trail and report fallen trees when you return.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_outdoors_2_Body: Line, seed, gloves and water purification tablets are discounted for registered field workers this week.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_police_1_Body: Several patrol shifts still need coverage. Confirm your availability with the desk before this afternoon's briefing.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_police_2_Body: The revised evidence intake sheet is now in use. Old forms will not be accepted after Friday.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_trades_1_Body: Three maintenance calls remain unassigned. Check the work board for locations and required parts.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_trades_2_Body: Wire, fasteners and replacement blades arrived this morning. Professional account holders may reserve stock by phone.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_veteran_1_Body: Your regional services office has opened additional appointment times. Call before Friday to reserve a slot.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_veteran_2_Body: The monthly post meeting begins at 1900. Volunteers are also needed to organize the storage room beforehand.

UI_AA_ModName: Auto All - Cook, Read, Tailoring and Reload
UI_AA_clean_dry: Cleaning stopped: the water ran out after %1 things.
UI_AA_clean_natural_note: This water is tainted. It washes exactly the same, and it does not affect infection - sterilising is what does.
UI_AA_clean_no_soap: No soap, bleach or cleaning liquid within reach.
UI_AA_clean_no_water: There is no water here. Sinks run dry once the water supply is shut off.
UI_AA_clean_with_soap_tt: Washes you, your clothes, your gear and your dirty bandages - %1 things in all. Soap, bleach or cleaning liquid in reach is used automatically, which is about five times faster.
UI_AA_clean_without_soap_tt: Washes you, your clothes, your gear and your dirty bandages - %1 things in all. Water only, so it takes considerably longer.
UI_AA_cook_interrupted: Auto cooking stopped: the ingredient could not be added.
UI_AA_cook_noingredients: Nothing within reach can go into this recipe.
UI_AA_cook_norecipes: This item is set to hide its recipes, which is a base game setting, not a mod one - the game's own cooking options are hidden too. Right click the item and choose Show Recipes to bring them all back.
UI_AA_cook_option_hidden: Auto Cook: recipes hidden for this item
UI_AA_cook_option_tt: Fills the dish on its own with the best ingredients within reach, spreading the food types so the meal does not make you unhappy. Recipe limit: %1 ingredients. Reachable now: %2.
UI_AA_cook_return_failed: Could not put %1 ingredient(s) back - they are still in your inventory.
UI_AA_cook_setup_tt: Opens a window to choose the dish, what it is for, and how much of each ingredient goes in.
UI_AA_cook_size_auto: As many as the recipe allows
UI_AA_cook_skilled: Your cooking is good enough to use the sad end of the pantry.
UI_AA_cook_ui_hint: Left click a row to raise it, right click to lower it.
UI_AA_dismantle_blocked: Nothing here can be taken apart right now. Worn, broken or already-used items do not count.
UI_AA_dismantle_inuse: Those are being worn or carried. Take one off first, or use a spare.
UI_AA_dismantle_keeping: Leaving %1 alone: worn or in hand.
UI_AA_dismantle_option_all: Auto Dismantle: every electronic within reach
UI_AA_dismantle_option_tt: Takes apart %1 of the %2 within reach, one after another, for Electrical XP. Any that are in a container are fetched, and the screwdriver is only picked up once.
UI_AA_mech_disposable: Use a car you can afford to lose
UI_AA_mech_inside: Get out of the vehicle first.
UI_AA_mech_left_off: %1 parts done, but %2 could not be refitted - see console.txt.
UI_AA_mech_minchance: Only parts the game rates %1 or better
UI_AA_mech_nokey: Without the key, some parts stay locked.
UI_AA_mech_nothing: Nothing on this car can be worked on right now.
UI_AA_mech_parts_safe: Parts are safe at this setting
UI_AA_mech_seats: To work on seats, make sure they are empty.
UI_AA_mech_skipping: %1 parts skipped: the odds are too low
UI_AA_mech_stuck: Stuck on this car - %1 parts done.
UI_AA_mech_will_break: Parts will break at this level!
UI_AA_med_nosupplies: No bandages or tools within reach.
UI_AA_med_option_tt: Treats %1 injured body part(s): bullets and glass out, burns washed, wounds disinfected and bandaged. A sterilised bandage is used first when you have one.
UI_AA_open_notool: No can opener or sharp knife within reach.
UI_AA_open_option_all: Open Every Can and Jar Within Reach
UI_AA_open_option_tt: Opens %1 of the %2 within reach, one after another. Any that are in a container are fetched, and the can opener is only picked up once.
UI_AA_opt_cleanSelf_tt: Off means only clothes, gear and bandages are washed.
UI_AA_opt_cleanWring: Wring the clothes out and put them back on
UI_AA_opt_cleanWring_tt: After the washing, wrings out every wet garment and dresses the character again in whatever it was wearing. The base game takes the clothes off to wring them and leaves them in your inventory.
UI_AA_opt_cookBadFromLevel: Use bad ingredients from Cooking level
UI_AA_opt_cookBadFromLevel_tt: From this Cooking level the picker stops avoiding rotten and depressing ingredients. 0 never allows them. Poison is always refused.
UI_AA_opt_cookMaxIngredients_tt: Stop before the recipe is full. 0 uses whatever the recipe allows.
UI_AA_opt_cookPriority_tt: What the picker maximises when it chooses the next ingredient.
UI_AA_opt_cookReturnItems_tt: Returns ingredients borrowed from a cupboard or fridge once the meal is done. The finished dish always stays in your inventory.
UI_AA_opt_cookSameTypeMax: Max copies of the same ingredient
UI_AA_opt_cookSameTypeMax_tt: Piling the same food in a dish is what makes it depressing to eat. 2 is a safe value.
UI_AA_opt_cookSkipFavorite_tt: Items flagged as favourite are left alone.
UI_AA_opt_cookSkipPoison_tt: Never puts poisonous items in the pot.
UI_AA_opt_cookSkipRotten_tt: Never puts rotten, burnt or tainted food in the pot.
UI_AA_opt_cookSkipUnhappy_tt: Skips ingredients that add unhappiness while a better one is still available.
UI_AA_opt_cookSpiceMax_tt: How many spices at most may go into one dish.
UI_AA_opt_cookSpices_tt: Adds the spices you have once the ingredients are in.
UI_AA_opt_cookSpoilFirst: Use up the food closest to spoiling
UI_AA_opt_cookSpoilFirst_tt: Among the ingredients on offer, prefers the ones with the least time left before they go stale. Nothing rotten is ever used - that is a separate setting.
UI_AA_opt_discord_desc: Our Discord is where bugs get reported, ideas get discussed, people find others to play with, and new mods are announced. Come and say hello.
UI_AA_opt_discord_tt: Opens the invite in the Steam overlay, or in your browser when the overlay is off.
UI_AA_opt_dismantleMax_tt: Caps how many are taken apart in one go. 0 means as many as there are.
UI_AA_opt_dismantleResultsToSource: Send the scrap back where it came from
UI_AA_opt_dismantleResultsToSource_tt: When the electronics were taken from a crate, a cupboard or the floor, the parts go back there at the end instead of weighing the character down. Used on something already carried, the parts stay in the inventory.
UI_AA_opt_dismantleReturnItems: Put the screwdriver back when finished
UI_AA_opt_dismantleReturnItems_tt: Returns the screwdriver to the container it was taken from, once, after the whole batch. Turn this off to simply keep it.
UI_AA_opt_fastForward_tt: Single player only - the server owns game speed in multiplayer. It is only taken from normal speed, and if you change the speed yourself the mod stops touching it for the rest of that job.
UI_AA_opt_mechFailSound_tt: Single player only. The base game plays this sound on a failed part through the server, so it is silent when there is no server. This plays it for you. It is heard, not carried: it does not draw zombies the way the multiplayer one does.
UI_AA_opt_mechMax_tt: 0 means every part it can do.
UI_AA_opt_mechMinSuccess_tt: Parts the game gives a lower chance than this are skipped instead of risked. 0 works on everything, 30 will not wreck the car, 100 never risks a part. The chances themselves are the game's and are never changed.
UI_AA_opt_medDisinfect_tt: Uses alcohol or an alcoholic drink on each open wound before dressing it, exactly as the Health window would. Turn it off to save your alcohol - the bandaging still happens.
UI_AA_opt_modules_desc: Turn off anything you do not use. Its menu entries disappear completely, so the right click menu only shows what you actually want.
UI_AA_opt_modules_tt: On by default. A server can also switch this off for everyone in its sandbox options.
UI_AA_opt_notifyEvery_tt: Seconds before the same progress message shows up again.
UI_AA_opt_notify_tt: How the mod tells you what it is doing.
UI_AA_opt_openMax_tt: Caps how many are opened in one go. 0 means as many as there are.
UI_AA_opt_openResultsToSource: Send the opened food back where it came from
UI_AA_opt_openResultsToSource_tt: When the tins were taken from a fridge, a crate or the floor, the opened food goes back there at the end instead of weighing the character down. Used on something already carried, it stays in the inventory.
UI_AA_opt_openReturnItems: Put the can opener back when finished
UI_AA_opt_openReturnItems_tt: Returns the can opener or knife to the container it was taken from, once, after the whole batch. Turn this off to simply keep it.
UI_AA_opt_readMagazines_tt: Magazines that still hold at least one recipe you do not know.
UI_AA_opt_readMaxBooks_tt: Stops once this many books and magazines have been read.
UI_AA_opt_readNearby_tt: Off means only the books already in your inventory and bags are read.
UI_AA_opt_readReturnItems_tt: Returns each book to the container it was taken from.
UI_AA_opt_readSkillBooks_tt: Books that raise an XP multiplier, as long as the level band fits your character.
UI_AA_opt_reloadMaxCycles_tt: One cycle is filling the magazine and emptying it again.
UI_AA_opt_ripMax_tt: 0 means as many as the batch allows.
UI_AA_opt_ripResultsToSource: Send the strips to the source
UI_AA_opt_ripResultsToSource_tt: Ripped sheets and strips go back to the container the clothing came from.
UI_AA_opt_ripReturnItems_tt: The cutting tool goes back to the container it came from, once, at the end.
UI_AA_opt_ripSkipFavorite_tt: Items flagged as favourite are left alone, wherever they are.
UI_AA_opt_showTab: Auto All tab in the character window
UI_AA_opt_showTab_tt: Turn this off to take the tab out of the character window. Nothing is lost: every setting it holds is also here in Mod Options. Useful on a controller, where one fewer tab is one fewer to cycle past.
UI_AA_opt_sterilReturnItems: Put the alcohol back when finished
UI_AA_opt_sterilReturnItems_tt: Returns the leftover alcohol or water to the container it was taken from, once, after the whole batch. Turn this off to simply keep it.
UI_AA_opt_stopDamage_tt: Stops when overall body health drops.
UI_AA_opt_stopOnAim_tt: Stops as soon as you raise the weapon.
UI_AA_opt_stopOnMove_tt: Pressing a movement key always stops the automation.
UI_AA_opt_stopZombie_tt: Stops as soon as a zombie is seen or chasing.
UI_AA_opt_tailorFabric_tt: Which material the training sews on. Any picks the cheapest one you carry.
UI_AA_opt_tailorHolesFirst_tt: Sews the actual holes before padding intact parts.
UI_AA_opt_tailorMaxCycles_tt: One cycle is patching every body part and unpicking them all again.
UI_AA_opt_vhsMaxTapes: Stop after this many tapes (0 = no limit)
UI_AA_opt_vhsMaxTapes_tt: At zero it keeps going until nothing within reach still teaches anything.
UI_AA_opt_vhsNearby: Also take tapes from nearby containers
UI_AA_opt_vhsNearby_tt: With this on, the shelves and boxes open in the loot window count as well, not just what the character is carrying.
UI_AA_opt_vhsReturnItems: Put each tape back where it came from
UI_AA_opt_vhsReturnItems_tt: Turn this off to keep the watched tapes in the inventory instead.
UI_AA_read_nothing: Nothing within reach still teaches you anything.
UI_AA_read_option_tt: Reads every skill book and skill magazine within reach, one after the other, and puts each one back. Found now: %1 books and %2 magazines. Books above or below your level are skipped.
UI_AA_reload_ejecting: The magazine will be taken out of the gun first.
UI_AA_reload_interrupted: Reload training stopped: the reload did not go through.
UI_AA_reload_lost: Reload training stopped: the magazine is gone.
UI_AA_reload_nomagazine: This gun feeds from a magazine - carry one to train on it.
UI_AA_reload_option_mag_tt: Trains on %1, the magazine this gun feeds from. Currently %2/%3 rounds, %4 spare in the inventory. Stops when you move or press ESC.
UI_AA_reload_option_tt: Loads and unloads this over and over to train Reloading. Currently %1/%2 rounds, %3 spare in the inventory. Stops when you move or press ESC.
UI_AA_reload_stuck: The rounds are not moving. Stopped - check console.txt.
UI_AA_repair_noholes: Nothing here has a hole in it.
UI_AA_repair_nomaterials: Not enough thread or fabric to sew with.
UI_AA_repair_option_all: Auto Repair: every hole within reach
UI_AA_repair_option_all_tt: %1 holes across everything within reach, worn clothes included.
UI_AA_rip_blocked: Found things to rip, but none of them can be right now. Try again in a moment.
UI_AA_rip_from_body: %1 more will be taken off the bodies first.
UI_AA_rip_keeping: Leaving %1 alone: worn, held or favourite.
UI_AA_rip_notool: No scissors or sharp knife within reach.
UI_AA_rip_option_tt: Will rip %1 of the %2 within reach.
UI_AA_rip_protected: Only worn, held or favourite items here.
UI_AA_steril_nosupplies: Not enough rubbing alcohol, spirits or hot water within reach.
UI_AA_steril_option_tt: Sterilizes them one after the other with the alcohol or boiled water in reach. Ready to do: %1 of %2.
UI_AA_stop_hurt: Stopped: too hurt to keep carrying this.
UI_AA_stop_stuck: Stopped: an action would not finish.
UI_AA_tailor_button_tt: Patches every body part of this garment, unpicks the patches and starts over. Needs a needle, thread and rags. The garment does not have to be worn. Stops when you move or press ESC.
UI_AA_tailor_interrupted: Tailoring training stopped: the stitch did not go through.
UI_AA_tailor_lost: Tailoring training stopped: the garment is gone.
UI_AA_tailor_nofabric: Tailoring training needs rags, denim strips or leather strips.
UI_AA_vhs_nodevice: There is no video player nearby.
UI_AA_vhs_nopower: The video player has no power.
UI_AA_vhs_nothing: No tape within reach still teaches anything.
UI_AA_vhs_option_tt: Plays %1 tapes through the video player one after another, taking each one out when its programme ends. Tapes that only pass the time are left alone.
UI_AA_vhs_stuck: The video player stopped responding. Stopped - check console.txt.
UI_AA_vhs_toofar: Too far from the video player to follow the programme.
UI_AA_wring_nothing: Nothing you are carrying is wet enough to wring.
UI_AA_wring_option_tt: Wrings out %1 wet garments, one after another, putting each one back on afterwards.
UI_ADHD_Distracted2: I can't focus on that right now
UI_ADHD_Distracted5: I need to do something else for a bit
UI_ADHD_Distracted6: Time to do something more interesting
UI_ADHD_Distracted7: I need to do something more interesting for a while
UI_AEP_Auto_tt: Repeat this exercise automatically, resting when needed. Tick this, then press Start below to begin.
UI_AEP_BoozeMaxDrunk_tt: A safety cap. Alcohol is left alone once intoxication passes this.
UI_AEP_BoozeSip_tt: How much to drink at a time. Less means less intoxication. Raise it a little if the sip seems to do nothing.
UI_AEP_Desc: Pick an exercise on the Fitness panel, tick AUTO and press Start. Your character will exercise, sit down to rest when tired, then get up and go again. Every setting below takes effect immediately, even mid-game.
UI_AEP_HeavyLoad: Heavy Load level that halts exercise (0 = ignore)
UI_AEP_HeavyLoad_tt: Carrying too much is not something resting fixes, so auto mode stops once the Heavy Load moodle reaches this level.
UI_AEP_KeepSpeed_tt: The game normally drops back to 1x whenever an action finishes, and auto exercise finishes an action every set, sip and sit-down. This holds the speed instead. It is released the moment things get dangerous - a zombie in sight, taking damage, catching fire - and again whenever auto mode stops. (No effect while connected to a multiplayer server - the server controls game time.)
UI_AEP_Mark_tt: Read this book during the rest breaks of auto exercise. The bookmark applies to the book type rather than the single copy, so it survives picking up another copy. The book has to be in your main inventory to actually be read.
UI_AEP_MaxTries: Give up after this many doses (0 = unlimited)
UI_AEP_MaxTries_tt: If this many doses in a row fail to bring the pain down, stop auto mode instead of working through everything you are carrying.
UI_AEP_MoodleThreshold: Exhausted level that still allows exercise
UI_AEP_MoodleThreshold_tt: The base game refuses to exercise above this Exhausted moodle level. Set it to 4 and the moodle never gets in the way, leaving the endurance percentages above fully in charge. This also applies to the vanilla fitness panel.
UI_AEP_MoodleWait: Exhausted, I can't start another set. Catching my breath...
UI_AEP_NoticeMode_tt: Where to show what auto exercise is doing and why it stopped.
UI_AEP_PainBlockAt: Pain level that halts exercise (0 = never)
UI_AEP_PainBlockAt_tt: At this Pain level your character stops exercising and waits for the pain to ease. Keep it higher than the painkiller level above - if it is equal or lower, exercise halts the instant your character is sore enough to want a pill. For reference, the base game locks its own Start button at level 4.
UI_AEP_PainThreshold: Pain level that triggers a painkiller (0 = never)
UI_AEP_PainThreshold_tt: Once the Pain moodle reaches this level, your character reaches for pills or alcohol. Set it to 0 to disable everything pain-related.
UI_AEP_PainWait: Hurts too much to exercise. Waiting for it to ease off...
UI_AEP_ReadRecipeMags_tt: Bookmarked magazines that still teach a recipe you do not know. They are short and one-off, so they are read before skill books.
UI_AEP_ReadSkillBooks_tt: Only bookmarked skill books you can read right now and still have a multiplier to gain from. Books above your level and books you have already used up are skipped.
UI_AEP_ReadWhileResting_tt: Read while sitting and waiting for endurance to come back. Sitting recovers endurance at exactly the same rate whether you read or not, and sitting even makes reading slightly faster, so this costs you nothing. Pick what to read by right-clicking a book in your inventory, and keep it in your main inventory (books inside bags are not read).
UI_AEP_ReliefCd_tt: Keeps your character from swallowing one dose after another. Nothing is taken while a dose is still working, so this only matters when pain outlasts the effect.
UI_AEP_RestBelow_tt: Once endurance falls below this, the current set is cut short and your character sits on the ground.
UI_AEP_Resting: Worn out... let me sit until I get my wind back
UI_AEP_ResumeAbove: Stand back up at this endurance (%%)
UI_AEP_ResumeAbove_tt: Once endurance recovers to this while resting, your character gets up and starts the next set. Keep it higher than the value above.
UI_AEP_SetMinutes_tt: How long a single set runs. It ends sooner if endurance runs out first.
UI_AEP_SpeedHealthMin: Health at which the speed is released (%%, 0 = ignore)
UI_AEP_SpeedHealthMin_tt: Stops holding fast-forward once overall health falls below this. Meant to catch slow drains such as starvation or illness.
UI_AEP_StatusRepeat: Repeat the same reason every (minutes, 0 = once)
UI_AEP_StatusRepeat_tt: How often to say the reason again while your character still cannot exercise.
UI_AEP_StopHealth: Auto exercise stopped: health is too low
UI_AEP_StopHealthMin: Health at which exercise halts (%%, 0 = ignore)
UI_AEP_StopHealthMin_tt: Switches auto mode off once overall health falls below this, whatever the cause - hunger, illness or injury.
UI_AEP_StopHeavy: Auto exercise stopped: carrying too much
UI_AEP_StopInput: Auto exercise stopped: you took control
UI_AEP_StopItem: Auto exercise stopped: the equipment for this exercise is gone
UI_AEP_StopNoRelief: Stop when there is nothing to treat the pain with
UI_AEP_StopNoRelief_tt: If pain is blocking exercise and there are no pills or alcohol left, switch auto mode off rather than sitting there indefinitely.
UI_AEP_StopOnClose: Stop when the Fitness panel is closed
UI_AEP_StopOnClose_tt: Turn this off and auto exercise keeps running after you close the panel.
UI_AEP_StopOnDamage_tt: Switches auto mode off when health drops sharply. This catches being hit by something; slow drains like hunger are handled by the health threshold above.
UI_AEP_StopOnInput_tt: Switches auto mode off the moment you press a movement key, aim or attack. Only character input counts, so clicking buttons on the Fitness panel will not stop it.
UI_AEP_StopPain: Auto exercise stopped: in pain, with no pills or alcohol left
UI_AEP_StopPainMaxed: Auto exercise stopped: the painkillers are not helping
UI_AEP_StopStuck: Auto exercise stopped: the exercise animation keeps getting stuck

UI_AGD_GarageManagerEmptyHelp:
Select a garage on the left, then use the buttons to manage it.

How it works:
  1) Discover the keypad code (code shows as Hidden until discovered).
  2) Set a public frequency (F-####) once the code is discovered.
  3) Pair a remote/controller to the garage and operate it.

Tips:
- Stand by a garage door and use 'Add Current (nearby)' to create an entry.
- 'Update Proximity' fills missing coordinates only when you're near the door; once set, coords stay locked.
- Codes are Hidden until discovered via the keypad; once discovered, you can set a public frequency (F-####).
- Drag-and-drop entries in the list to reorder them; order is saved.
- 'Keypad: Locked Out' means too many wrong attempts; wait or use appropriate tools (if available).
- Renaming a garage updates paired remote labels automatically.

UI_AIWeekOne_Ambient_tooltip: Let NPCs occasionally speak to you without being spoken to. Turn off to only pay for conversations and reactions to events.
UI_AIWeekOne_ApiKey_tooltip: Only needed for the OpenRouter provider. Paste your key from openrouter.ai/keys, then press Accept. It is shown masked, stored only in your local ModOptions.ini, never logged, and sent only to OpenRouter.
UI_AIWeekOne_Approach_tooltip: People who know you will walk over and start the conversation themselves instead of waiting to be spoken to. They only do it when they actually have a reason: they owe you and it is bothering them, you promised them something and never came back, they saw what you did and have been working up to saying so, they heard something they think you should know, or they are a frightened companion who needs to talk. Heavily rate-limited - one person at a time, and each person at most once every few minutes. They give up if you walk away.
UI_AIWeekOne_ArmLaw_tooltip: Bandits only loads a spawned NPC's gun when its clan definition lists both a weapon AND an ammo entry, so police and soldiers often arrive carrying a firearm they can never fire. This issues rounds for the weapon they already have, using Bandits' own weapon builder. Law enforcement only - civilians are left exactly as they spawned.
UI_AIWeekOne_Betrayal_tooltip: A companion you mistreat can walk out, rob you, or turn on you outright - and they pick a moment when you are hurt or asleep. They always show discontent first, so it is never a bolt from the blue. Turn off if you want followers who are loyal no matter what.
UI_AIWeekOne_BodyState_tooltip: Getting hurt stops being a one-line event. A leg injury makes an NPC genuinely limp - they move slower until it heals, using the same speed variable Bandits sets on every NPC. Injuries are remembered with the day they happened, so days later somebody will still tell you their shoulder is not right and that they favour it without thinking. Blood on their clothes is something they know they are wearing, and after long enough without a wash they are aware of the state of them.
UI_AIWeekOne_Budget_tooltip: Hard stop after this many AI requests in one session, as protection against unexpected cost. 0 means unlimited.
UI_AIWeekOne_CatchLies: NPCs remember what you told them
UI_AIWeekOne_CatchLies_tooltip: Each conversation records one thing you asserted. Later, if your story changes, they notice and call it out. Costs nothing extra - it is one optional field on a reply the mod was already requesting.
UI_AIWeekOne_CompanionSupport_tooltip: A companion who is bleeding or starving asks the group for help instead of suffering in silence. If another companion nearby is carrying a bandage or food they hand it over and say so, and it genuinely costs them the supplies. If nobody in the crew has it, they ask you for it and remember that they are still waiting - so it comes up again next time you speak to them. Treating each other builds the same bond that travelling together does.
UI_AIWeekOne_CompanionVehicles_tooltip: Companions get into a car when you do and get out when you do. Bandits 42.20 has this code commented out, so without this they can end up stuck in a vehicle permanently. Only acts when the car is stopped, and places them safely beside it rather than under it. Respects the Bandits sandbox option for NPCs entering vehicles.
UI_AIWeekOne_Concurrent_tooltip: How many requests may be in flight at once. Keep low unless you have many NPCs talking at the same time.
UI_AIWeekOne_Crime_tooltip: NPCs react to theft, break-ins, threats and killings they actually witness, and can report you.
UI_AIWeekOne_CustomModel_tooltip: Any OpenRouter model id, for example anthropic/claude-3.5-haiku. Only used when Model is set to Custom.
UI_AIWeekOne_Danger: NPCs avoid places they know are dangerous
UI_AIWeekOne_Danger_tooltip: The mod already recorded where gunfire happened and where people were killed, but nothing ever checked that information before sending somebody somewhere - so an NPC could tell you there had been shooting at the warehouse and then set off through the warehouse. Now they weigh up a destination first: live zombies near it, incidents they have heard about (discounted if they only half-believe the rumour), and places they personally ran into a crowd. Brave people discount all of it, paranoid people overrate it, and somebody who never heard about the shooting walks in anyway. Fleeing and retreating are never blocked - nobody stands still and dies because every exit looked risky. Costs nothing in API usage.
UI_AIWeekOne_Debug_tooltip: Verbose [AINPC] logging in console.txt, and adds the AI Debug Inspector to the right-click menu on NPCs.
UI_AIWeekOne_Doors_tooltip: Survivors shut the door after walking through it, instead of leaving buildings hanging open. Not everyone bothers: careless people leave it, frightened people always close it, and after dark - or once everyone knows what is walking around out there - nearly everybody does. They will not close a door on you or on somebody following right behind, and they leave locked and barricaded doors alone. Costs nothing in API usage.
UI_AIWeekOne_Eavesdrop_tooltip: When you SNEAK within earshot of two NPCs who cannot see you, they speak candidly - worries they would hide, resentments, what they really think of you, things they have and do not want known. Walk up in plain sight and you get the guarded version instead. If they spot you mid-conversation it stops dead and they trust you noticeably less.
UI_AIWeekOne_Enabled_tooltip: Turn the whole AI layer on or off. When off, Bandits and Week One behave exactly as they do without this mod.
UI_AIWeekOne_Gang_tooltip: Ask people to join you and they will weigh it up properly - what they would be leaving behind, whether they trust you, how bad things have got. On day one almost nobody walks away from their home and job; by day six being alone is what kills you. Members take jobs (lookout, scavenger, medic, driver), form their own opinions about each other, and a crew that stops getting on is where betrayal comes from.
UI_AIWeekOne_Impersonation: Uniforms change how you are treated
UI_AIWeekOne_Impersonation_tooltip: NPCs react to what you are dressed as. A full police uniform carries real weight with frightened civilians; scrubs get you near the sick. But a costume is not an identity - real officers know you are not one of them, anyone carrying a matching rumour sees through it, and a half-outfit fools nobody.
UI_AIWeekOne_Language_tooltip: What language NPCs speak in. Auto follows the game's own language setting. The game UI text is translated separately. Changes take effect on the next line of dialogue.
UI_AIWeekOne_LocalModel_tooltip: Leave BLANK to use whatever model your server currently has loaded - easiest, and works for most people. Fill it in only if your server hosts several models at once, using the exact name it reports (for example llama3.1:8b).
UI_AIWeekOne_LocalUrl_tooltip: Only used by the Local provider. Any server speaking the OpenAI chat API works. LM Studio: http://localhost:1234/v1 - Ollama: http://localhost:11434/v1 - KoboldCpp: http://localhost:5001/v1 - llama.cpp: http://localhost:8080/v1. Remember to actually start the server (in LM Studio that is the Developer tab).
UI_AIWeekOne_MaxDistance_tooltip: NPCs further away than this never use the AI; they keep running Bandits' normal logic.
UI_AIWeekOne_MaxTokens_tooltip: Visible reply budget. If a reasoning model spends it before writing the JSON answer, the bridge automatically retries once with a larger internal allowance.
UI_AIWeekOne_MemorySize_tooltip: Older memories are compressed into a summary once this many are stored. Higher = better recall, slightly larger prompts.
UI_AIWeekOne_Memory_tooltip: NPCs remember what you did to them, across save and load.
UI_AIWeekOne_MetaWorld_tooltip: Everyone you have met carries on with their life while you are somewhere else. Each in-game hour a few of them travel toward wherever they were trying to get to, scavenge and find something or nothing, get hurt, run out of food, fall in with other survivors, get robbed, or lose somebody they were travelling with. It is all real state, not flavour text: meet them a week later and they are hungrier, or limping, or grieving, and when you ask where they have been they tell you what actually happened. It also replaces the old coin-flip that used to decide whether somebody achieved their goal - they now succeed because they got there, or fail because they ran out of road. Costs nothing in API usage; it is all computed locally.
UI_AIWeekOne_Model_tooltip: Which model NPCs think with, when using OpenRouter. Gemini Flash Lite is the cheapest and is plenty for dialogue. Choose Custom to type any OpenRouter model id below.
UI_AIWeekOne_NpcActions: NPCs act on their own needs
UI_AIWeekOne_NpcActions_tooltip: Instead of only complaining, NPCs do something about it: reload an empty weapon, search cupboards when hungry, go to sleep when exhausted, put the lights out when frightened at night. Costs nothing - no AI request is involved. They never interrupt themselves mid-task and never do any of it with danger nearby.
UI_AIWeekOne_NpcCap_tooltip: How many nearby NPCs get full AI treatment per scan. When a Bandits story event spawns a large group at once (the bandit storyline can send 20+ people at once), this stops the request queue being overwhelmed. Extras still run Bandits' own AI normally - they just won't talk. Companions are always included, regardless of the cap. 5 = bare minimum, 20 = default, 60 = effectively unlimited.
UI_AIWeekOne_NpcChatter_tooltip: When two people are standing together near you, they hold a real conversation you can overhear - and it has consequences: rumours spread, opinions of you shift, and they can decide things. One request covers the whole exchange, so it costs about the same as a single reply.
UI_AIWeekOne_NpcChores: NPCs wash and bury the dead
UI_AIWeekOne_NpcChores_tooltip: NPCs wash blood off themselves after a fight, and carry bodies to a grave. Burial only happens where a grave actually exists (an established base), because that is what Bandits own routine requires.
UI_AIWeekOne_NpcLives_tooltip: NPCs go somewhere rather than standing in one room for six days. A beat cop patrols, a shopkeeper minds the shop, civilians run errands at midday and head home by night. As the week turns dangerous the routine collapses with it - the same person who shops on Tuesday hides on Saturday. Costs nothing; it is schedule and geography, not extra AI calls.
UI_AIWeekOne_NpcLooting_tooltip: A desperate NPC will take what they need from a body - but with a sense of shame: a decent person will not stoop over a corpse in front of a watching crowd. Criminals do not care. The hungry and unarmed care most.
UI_AIWeekOne_Objectives_tooltip: Let NPCs ask you for help (find someone, fetch medicine, escape town) using a fixed set of safe objective types.
UI_AIWeekOne_OptionsDesc: LLM-driven personalities, memory and conversation for Week One / Bandits NPCs. Requires the bridge script (bridge/Start_AI_NPC_Bridge.cmd) to be running, plus either an OpenRouter API key or a local model server. If neither is available, NPCs simply use Week One's normal dialogue.
UI_AIWeekOne_Perception: NPCs notice what is around them
UI_AIWeekOne_Perception_tooltip: NPCs see bodies on the floor, blood, smashed windows and a ransacked room, and they see the state you are in - bleeding, limping, feverish, starving, exhausted, soaked, drunk, overloaded. They also hear gunfire and can tell you roughly which direction it came from, and they know how long it has been since they last saw you. They never see your infection status, only that you look unwell.
UI_AIWeekOne_Personality_tooltip: How strongly an NPC's traits are pushed in the prompt. Higher makes characters more extreme and distinctive.
UI_AIWeekOne_Provider_tooltip: Where NPCs do their thinking. OpenRouter needs an API key and costs a few cents per session, but is fast and stays in character reliably. Local runs on your own machine: free, private, works offline, but needs a model server running (LM Studio, Ollama, KoboldCpp, llama.cpp) and a capable enough model. 8B or larger is recommended - smaller models forget who they are.
UI_AIWeekOne_ReplyLength_tooltip: How much NPCs say. Natural mirrors how much you said - a greeting gets a greeting back. Terse is cheaper and more clipped; Chatty gives longer answers.
UI_AIWeekOne_Rumors_tooltip: Witnesses gossip. What you did in one place can be known elsewhere - imperfectly, and only by people who were told.
UI_AIWeekOne_SilenceBarks_tooltip: Week One's fixed captions ("Are you covered in blood?", street chatter) use the same speech bubble as AI dialogue and overwrite it. This hides those captions. Combat and danger shouts are always kept.
UI_AIWeekOne_SilenceVoices_tooltip: Silences the voice clips for those canned lines too, not just the text. Off by default - distant chatter is good atmosphere.
UI_AIWeekOne_SmartNav_tooltip: When an NPC gets stuck, they recover instead of walking in place: open the door in front of them, climb the fence they are pressed against, step sideways around an obstacle and carry on, or breach a locked door if they are armed for it. Only after all of that fails does the move get cancelled. Catches the diagonal collisions Bandits own handler misses.
UI_AIWeekOne_StatsButton_tooltip: Prints request counts, token usage and latency to the console and chat.
UI_AIWeekOne_StatusNoBridge: Bridge not running - NPCs will use Week One's standard replies. Run Start_AI_NPC_Bridge.cmd from the mod's bridge folder, then leave the window open. Setup steps: Zomboid\Lua\AIWeekOneBridge\READ_ME_FIRST.txt
UI_AIWeekOne_StatusNoKey: Not configured - set an OpenRouter key, or switch Provider to Local model, in Options > Mods > AI Week One
UI_AIWeekOne_Temperature_tooltip: Higher is more varied and surprising, lower is more consistent and predictable.
UI_AIWeekOne_TestButton_tooltip: Sends one tiny request through the bridge and reports the result in chat and the console.
UI_AIWeekOne_ThinkFreq_tooltip: How often a nearby NPC may think unprompted. 1 = rarely (cheapest), 5 = often (most expensive).
UI_AIWeekOne_Timeout_tooltip: After this long with no answer, the NPC falls back to normal Week One dialogue.
UI_AIWeekOne_Trade_tooltip: Buy and sell with NPCs using Week One's money. Prices come from Slayer's own shop formula, then the character haggles within a band set by their greed and how much they like you. After the collapse cash stops working and it becomes barter.
UI_AIWeekOne_Unstick_tooltip: Week One sometimes places people inside counters, sinks and beds. This moves anyone standing in solid furniture to the nearest square a person could actually stand on. Only acts when they have been motionless there for several seconds, and never moves them anywhere Bandits pathing would refuse.
UI_AIWeekOne_VoiceOut_tooltip: NPC dialogue is spoken out loud using Google Gemini TTS through OpenRouter. Every NPC keeps the same voice permanently, chosen from 30 voices and matched to their sex, and the delivery follows the mood they are already in - nervous lines sound nervous. READ THIS FIRST: this costs real money and far more than the text does. Speech is billed at 32 tokens per second of audio at $20 per million, so a five second line is roughly a third of a US cent and a long session of talking runs to a few dollars rather than a few cents. It also adds delay - the written line always appears immediately, and the audio arrives a couple of seconds later, or is quietly dropped if it takes too long. Needs the bridge running and an OpenRouter key; it does not work with local models.
UI_AIWeekOne_VoiceSpatial_tooltip: Voices come from where the NPC actually is. Somebody across the street is quieter than somebody at your shoulder, and somebody to your left is louder in your left ear. Panning uses the same isometric projection the camera does, so left and right match what you see on screen. Turn this off for flat, centred audio at full volume.
UI_AIWeekOne_VoiceVol_tooltip: How loud NPC voices are, 1 to 10. Applied to the audio itself before it is played, so it is independent of your Windows volume and of the game's own sliders. Default 6.
UI_AIWeekOne_WOFallback: Use Week One replies as fallback
UI_AIWeekOne_WOFallback_tooltip: When the AI cannot answer (no bridge, no key, timeout), fall back to Week One's keyword replies instead of a short generic line. Off by default, because a canned answer mid-conversation is more jarring than a brief one.
UI_AIWeekOne_Wanted_tooltip: Crimes that get REPORTED to the police build a wanted level, from a description going round up to shoot on sight. Officers start further up their escalation ladder the more wanted you are, civilians who recognise you get frightened, and at manhunt level patrols come looking for you instead of waiting to be called. It decays if you lie low, paying a fine settles some of it, and it stops mattering entirely once the police stop answering the phone. Crimes with no witnesses are never reported at all.
UI_AIWeekOne_WitnessFlees_tooltip: Someone who watches you kill a person will turn and run to tell others, shouting as they go. Catch them within about 45 seconds and the news dies with them; let them go and word spreads far wider than ordinary gossip. Brave or armed witnesses stand their ground instead.
UI_AIWeekOne_WorldKnow: NPCs know things about the world
UI_AIWeekOne_WorldKnow_tooltip: NPCs learn facts about places and events - who died where, which buildings have been stripped, where the shooting was - and pass them to each other and to you when they talk. Knowledge has to travel: someone only knows what they saw or were told, which makes a well-connected survivor genuinely worth talking to.
UI_AMS_Activity_Heavy: Significant during running. Heavy during sprinting.
UI_AMS_EnableMuscleStrainModel_tooltip: Heavy armor increases muscle strain when swinging melee weapons.
UI_AMS_EnableSleepPenaltyModel_tooltip: Sleeping in heavy or rigid armor slows recovery.
UI_AMS_EnableThermalModel_tooltip: Effective clothing insulation adds endurance burden during sustained body heat. Disable to remove AMS thermal burden.
UI_AMS_Help_Breathing: Restricted Breathing: This pressure appears only while respirators, gas masks, or other sealed headgear are adding load during exertion.
UI_AMS_Help_Burden: Burden: The main tier and bar describe the stable weight, bulk, and movement restriction of your worn gear.
UI_AMS_Help_CostDrivers: Cost Drivers: Shows which worn items contribute most to your total burden, sorted by impact. If one item dominates the list, swapping it out will make the biggest difference.
UI_AMS_Help_ExportTitleDesc: Support Reports: If something feels wrong, use this to save a snapshot of your current loadout, burden calculations, mod list, and game state to a text file. Attach it when reporting a problem.
UI_AMS_Help_Overview: Overview: The Burden tab shows the physical demand of worn equipment and any additional pressures that are affecting you right now.
UI_AMS_Help_Sleep: Sleep Restriction: This pressure appears only while worn rigid gear is actively reducing sleep recovery.
UI_AMS_Help_Thermal: Retained Heat: This pressure appears only when effective clothing insulation and sustained thermoregulation signals show meaningful retained heat. Short spikes stay hidden.

UI_AllInfo_animal_tip_Acceptance:
0-100, how much this animal puts up with you.
Each point takes 5 off the chance it breaks free while being sheared.
Every gain is +1, plus 0.1 per Animal Care level.
UI_AllInfo_animal_tip_Blood:
Litres you can drain into a bucket once it is dead.
Grows with weight.
UI_AllInfo_animal_tip_Feathers:
Feathers you get for butchering it.
Breed maximum x size.
UI_AllInfo_animal_tip_Fertilized:
Hours this female stays fertilised.
When it runs out she is no longer fertilised.
UI_AllInfo_animal_tip_Geriatric:
0%% until 70%% of its life expectancy, then it climbs to 100%%.
Over 95%% it loses 10%% health every hour.
UI_AllInfo_animal_tip_Health: Healthy over 80%%, off colour over 55%%, sickly over 30%%, dying below.
UI_AllInfo_animal_tip_Hunger:
Higher is worse.
Well fed under 30%%, underfed under 60%%, starving over it.
Over 80%% it starts losing weight.
UI_AllInfo_animal_tip_Meat:
Size x meat gene.
Multiplies the number of meat pieces and the calories of each one.
Butchering adds x1.1 every 2 levels.
Off the ground x0.6, on a butcher hook x2.8.
UI_AllInfo_animal_tip_Pregnant:
Days left before it gives birth.
Stress over 80 can end the pregnancy.
UI_AllInfo_animal_tip_Stress:
0-100. Calm under 40, unnerved under 60, agitated under 80, wild over it.
Over 40 milk and wool grow at 40 / stress of their rate.
Over 80 a pregnancy can be lost.
Milking with stress over 40 and Animal Care 7 or less always fails and spills the bucket.
UI_AllInfo_animal_tip_Thirst:
Higher is worse.
Fully watered under 30%%, thirsty under 60%%, dying of thirst over it.
UI_AllInfo_animal_tip_Udder:
Litres in the udder and what it holds.
It fills by capacity / 20 per game hour, times the sandbox milk modifier.
Stress over 40 slows it down.
UI_AllInfo_animal_tip_Weight:
Current weight and the most this animal can reach.
Meat and blood both scale with it.
Over 80%% hunger it starts losing weight.
UI_AllInfo_animal_tip_Wool:
Wool grown and the maximum.
It grows by maximum / 2400 per game hour: 100 days for a full fleece.
Stress over 40 slows it down.

UI_AllInfo_med_DrunkDouble: each pill counts double above 10 intoxication
UI_AllInfo_med_DrunkThird: a third of the strength above 10 intoxication
UI_AllInfo_med_FirstDoseOnly: only the first dose has to wait
UI_AllInfo_med_NoStacking: a second dose resets the clock, it does not add
