UI_VorpallySauced_CompendiumDesc:
Field observations on %1 %2.
What we've seen. What we can't explain.
UI_VorpallySauced_FLore_ofTrueAim: The barrel finds the line on its own.
UI_VorpallySauced_FLore_oftheGunslinger: Fifty percent faster. I timed it.
UI_VorpallySauced_FLore_oftheMarksman: On target before I'm ready. Every time now.
UI_VorpallySauced_FLore_oftheOperator: No wasted motion, no wasted round
UI_VorpallySauced_JournalCondition_0: The pages are mostly blank. A few nervous notes.
UI_VorpallySauced_JournalCondition_20: The handwriting steadies as the entries multiply.
UI_VorpallySauced_JournalCondition_5: Early pages. The ink is hesitant.
UI_VorpallySauced_JournalCondition_50: Heavily annotated. He kept revising his conclusions.
UI_VorpallySauced_JournalEquipHint: Equip a weapon to see its bond history.
UI_VorpallySauced_JournalGranted: A worn journal falls from between the pages.
UI_VorpallySauced_JournalIntro_FirearmBo: The gun settles into your hands. It knows the weight of your aim.
UI_VorpallySauced_JournalIntro_FirearmMa: The guns learned too. Faster than the blades, some of them.
UI_VorpallySauced_JournalIntro_Manifesta: What Pastor Mike called Manifestations. Beyond metal. Beyond explanation.
UI_VorpallySauced_JournalIntro_MeleeBond: Deeper. The weapon becomes part of the motion.
UI_VorpallySauced_JournalIntro_MeleeMark: The first signs. Subtle changes in weight, balance, edge.
UI_VorpallySauced_JournalLostToReforge_B: Lost to reforging · %1 kills · Bond unwoven
UI_VorpallySauced_JournalLostToReforge_M: Lost to reforging · %1 kills · Mark unmade
UI_VorpallySauced_JournalReforgeNote: Morrison's note: 'The soul survives the handle. This changes everything I thought I understood about where the Stir lives.'
UI_VorpallySauced_JournalReforgeNoteLoss: Morrison's note: 'The Stir was not deep enough to leap forms. The new vessel began empty.'
UI_VorpallySauced_JournalStatHint: Study the corresponding Compendium volume to reveal full details.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Bonding_ofBloodth: There's a hunger to it now. I can feel it when I swing. The damage is real but the want is realer.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Bonding_ofRebirth: It shouldn't still be in one piece. It is. I've stopped questioning it and started being grateful.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Bonding_ofTransce: Every axis improved. Not a lot on each one. But all of them. All at once. Weapon's become something it wasn't. I have too.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Bonding_ofWhisper: It takes more of them in one swing than it has any right to. I heard something in my head the first time it happened. Not words. Just a feeling. Satisfied.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Bonding_oftheCons: When it crits it really crits. And it crits a lot. I don't know what it consumed to get here. I don't think I want to know.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Bonding_oftheCove: It hits harder and it finds the vital spot more often. Like we made an agreement. Like something was agreed to that I wasn't part of, and I've benefited anyway.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Bonding_oftheUndy: The condition doesn't move. The max doesn't lower. It gets hit and it holds. I don't know what it learned from the blood, but it learned something.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Bonding_oftheWiel: It moves with me now. Fast and mean and exactly where I need it. The pushback is wrong — too strong. But the speed is wronger.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FBonding_ofTrueAi: It aims itself. That's not an exaggeration. The barrel finds the line before I've finished the thought. And then it fires faster than I can plan.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FBonding_oftheArs: More in the mag than there used to be and empty again faster than seems possible. Speed and volume together. It never runs dry at the wrong moment.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FBonding_oftheGun: Fifty percent faster reload and fires so fast between shots I stopped thinking of them as separate. This gun belongs to a different kind of fight.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FBonding_oftheMar: On target before I'm ready. Critting more than I should. This gun has a sense of occasion.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FBonding_oftheOpe: Hits harder, aims truer, gets on target faster. It's committed to the job in a way that goes beyond the metal it's made from.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FBonding_oftheVet: Accurate. Reliable. Durable. Reloads fast. It's like it's been through all of this before and decided to get better at it.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_Annihilat: I don't aim for center mass anymore. The shot handles that part.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_Brutal: Bodies are stopping faster. I don't know what that means for the gun. I know what it means for me.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_Bullseye: I aimed it once today. Once. The rest was just reflex. All of them landed.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_Combat: The delay between shots is almost nothing. The gun is angrier than I am.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_Cyclic: It's barely pausing between rounds. My finger feels like it's not even part of the process.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_Deadeye: Long shots. More crits. I'm watching them from farther away and putting them down cleaner. The gun made a deal with physics and didn't tell me.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_Deadly: Running shot, panicking, low light — still connected. Something in the gun wants to connect.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_Devastati: One burst today. One. I had to check that they were really down.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_Execution: I stopped compensating for drift. The gun compensates.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_Extended: I don't know how far that last shot went. Far enough. That's what matters.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_FullAuto: I lost track of the individual shots. There was just a sound and then silence.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_Gunfighte: By the time they see me, I've already shot twice. The draw, the aim, the crit — it's all collapsed into one motion.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_Honed: Something changed in the barrel, maybe. Or in me. The hits are heavier now.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_Keen: The timing is better. The ones I shouldn't hit, I sometimes hit. More often now.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_Long: Connected at a range that surprised me. Surprised them too, probably.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_Marksmans: Every shot counts for more now. The accuracy, the crits, the time it takes to get there — all of it moving in the right direction.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_Merciless: It puts the round where it needs to go. Every time. I'm mostly just holding it.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_Operators: Accurate, fast, and it hurts when it hits. I don't know what I did to earn this.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_Precise: Shots are landing where I point it. Actually landing. That wasn't always the case.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_QuickFire: The next shot is ready a little sooner than I expect. Small thing. Adds up.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_Rapid: I'm shooting faster than I'm aiming. It doesn't seem to matter.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_Reaching: I held the corner and still put shots downrange. More downrange than I should have.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_Responsiv: It cycles back like it's in a hurry. I can keep the pace now.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_Sauced: Critical hits I shouldn't have made, accuracy I didn't earn, damage that ends arguments. It's too much in all the right ways.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_Savage: It's putting things down in fewer rounds. I'd call that a gift.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_Sharp: Every shot punches deeper than it should. I checked the ammo. Same ammo.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_Sighted: Whatever I point it at, it finds. Not every time. But closer to every time than before.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_Snipers: The shot goes where my eyes say to send it. Not approximately. Exactly.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_Steady: The barrel settles faster. The wobble is almost gone.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_Tactical: Faster and more likely to connect. The rate of fire and the accuracy together — the gun is doing math I can't do.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_TrueAim: Stopped missing the second shot. That used to always drift.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_Vicious: It found the gap twice today. The angle I needed and couldn't have made on my own.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_Warzone: High damage and I can shoot fast and I can hit things far away. This is not a fair fight. I am grateful for that.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FPrefix_Zeroed: It's locked. I don't know how to describe it better than that. Locked on.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_ofAbundan: I shoot more and reload less. The math of it doesn't add up. I've checked.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_ofCapacit: A few more rounds before I'm fishing for a mag. Enough to make a difference.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_ofDestruc: I've stopped thinking of it as a per-shot calculation. It's more of a verdict.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_ofEnduran: This thing was not built to stop working. I've tested that.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_ofEternit: I don't know what to clean anymore. The wear just doesn't come.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_ofExecuti: I had a shot today I'll remember for a while. I won't describe it. I'll just remember it.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_ofFocus: The sight picture settles just a little faster. Small window. Worth having.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_ofFortitu: Three months. No jams from condition. Barely any wear I can see.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_ofHarm: Rounds are hitting a little harder. Same ammo. The gun does something to them.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_ofInfinit: I kept shooting and shooting and the mag kept going. I was almost embarrassed when it finally ran dry.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_ofInstinc: I'm on target before my brain finishes the command. The gap is closing.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_ofLethali: When it crits, the conversation ends. Immediately.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_ofLoading: I'm back in the fight before I expect to be. Good surprise.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_ofMastery: I cleaned it today out of habit. It didn't need it.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_ofPermane: I've stopped worrying about it breaking down. That used to take up a lot of space in my head.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_ofPrecisi: The crits sting more than they should. Something in the timing amplifies it.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_ofPreserv: Takes longer to wear out. Not forever. Just longer. That's enough.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_ofQuality: The degradation is slower. I'd say half as fast. Maybe better.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_ofQuietin: The report was softer. Not silent, but the block didn't turn. Fewer came.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_ofReliabi: Jammed once in the last month. Once. I almost didn't believe it when it happened.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_ofReloadi: Slightly faster getting the mag in. I feel it in the rhythm.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_ofResilie: Took it through conditions I wouldn't take my boots through. Still running.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_ofSilence: I fired from the roof. The horde below kept walking. Like I wasn't there.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_ofSpeed: The reload is almost automatic now. I don't think about it. I just do it and I'm done.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_ofStorage: Ran through a horde without reloading. Didn't used to be able to do that.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_ofSuppres: The shot left my hands and the sound stayed behind. The dead don't know I'm here.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_ofSwiftne: Hands do the job before I've finished the thought. I've had it for weeks and I'm still surprised.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_ofTrueFun: It feeds. Every time. I've stopped flinching when I pull the trigger.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_ofWoundin: They go down in fewer shots. That's the whole thing. Fewer shots.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_oftheArmo: More capacity, faster reload, hits harder. It's not one improvement. It's all of them, pointing in the same direction.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_oftheArse: I've started treating it like it's inexhaustible. That's an attitude you earn, not assume.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_oftheAssa: Aim fast, crit hard, hit heavy. Everything collapses into a single terrible moment.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_oftheComm: Reloads fast. Holds more. Doesn't wear down like it should. It's like it's trying to keep me alive.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_oftheFait: I put a round in the chamber and I know it will fire. That's not a small thing. That's not a small thing at all.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_oftheGuns: I reloaded mid-horde and nobody got me. That's not nothing.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_oftheImmo: It refuses to fail. Stubbornly, consistently, in defiance of everything. Refuses.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_oftheMaga: The mag holds more than the numbers on the side say. I counted. It holds more.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_oftheProf: It stays in good shape, aims quicker, and degrades like it's refusing to. This gun has professional standards.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_oftheQuic: Empty to loaded to shooting so fast I thought I'd miscounted the mag. I hadn't. It was just that quick.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_oftheRefl: I snap it up and it's already where I need it. Muscle memory except I didn't build this memory.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_oftheSauc: Durable and then more durable. I've stopped being surprised when it keeps working.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_oftheSold: Reload time almost nothing. Condition barely budges. Extra rounds in the mag. This is a weapon that was made for exactly this.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_FSuffix_oftheVete: Aims fast, reloads fast, and when it crits it really means it. Competence in one package.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Annihilati: I stopped counting what comes back out when I pull it away. Easier that way.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Apocalypti: It doesn't stop at one. The damage, the knockback, the spread — everything is too much, all at once.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Berserkers: Swinging it feels like falling forward. The momentum does the work. I'm just holding on.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Blinding: I can't see the individual swings anymore. Just the bodies going down.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Breaching: Door came off faster than it should have. I'll keep that in mind.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Brutal: Something's different about what it leaves behind. I try not to look.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Buckling: Hit one and it staggered sideways. Legs first. Like the ground gave out under it.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Cataclysmi: Hit one and knocked over two more. I'm not exaggerating. Two more.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Cleaving: I stopped tracking single targets. The arc just takes what's in front of it.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Crushing: The impact travels now. You feel it in your chest when it lands.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Deadly: It commits to the angle before I do. Crits more than they should.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Demolishin: Took out a door, got the frame, put a dent in the tree outside. This thing has opinions about obstacles.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Devastatin: It's not a fight anymore. It's arithmetic.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Earthshaki: They fall before I finish the swing. The air moves wrong and they go down.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Executione: It wants the skull. Every swing wants the skull. I've stopped arguing with it.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Extended: The nearest one is never where my eyes said it was. I keep hitting them anyway.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Felling: They're going down and staying down for a moment. Long enough to breathe. Long enough to matter.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Flooring: It dropped them. Not pushed back, not knocked sideways — straight down. Every time.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Forceful: They're stumbling back farther than they should be. Weight feels the same.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Honed: The resistance is gone. It goes through like they're not even trying to stop it.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Immolating: The last one caught fire. The one before it too. I don't think it's me doing that.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Inexhausti: I swung until I wanted to stop, not until I had to. That's new.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Keen: Something changed. I'm landing hits I shouldn't be, on the first try.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Lightning: My arm can barely keep up with it. My shoulder aches in a new way.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Long: Caught one at a distance that felt too far. Didn't miss.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Merciless: It doesn't miss the killing blow. I'm not sure it's me doing it anymore.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Phantom: It's everywhere before I've moved. The range and speed together make it feel like cheating.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Precise: Stopped hesitating after it. The swing finds the spot I mean it to.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Quick: The return is automatic now. I'm not controlling it, just riding it.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Rapid: Three of them in the time it used to take for two. I counted.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Reaching: I'm keeping more space than I used to and still making contact. Somehow.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Reapers: When it crits, it doesn't just kill. It ends. Something about the follow-through is final in a way I can't describe.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Relentless: Three hordes in an afternoon and I didn't have to stop once. The stamina cost just... isn't there.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Sauced: It's faster and it hits harder and it knows exactly where to land. All three, together, at once. I don't deserve this.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Savage: One of them didn't stand back up. Usually they keep trying. This one didn't.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Scorching: It left a mark on the floor where I set it down. A black ring. The wood underneath was fine.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Sharp: It cut deeper. I don't know how. It just did.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Shoving: I hit one through a doorframe today. It went back through the wall. I don't understand the physics.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Smoldering: The edge came back warm. Not hot — warm. Like it had been sitting in the sun.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Staggering: Hordes aren't crowding me the same. They keep bouncing off each other.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Sweeping: Two in one swing. I didn't mean to. But it happened again the next time.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Swift: It comes back around faster. Not a lot, but enough to feel.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Tireless: My arm should be burning. It's not. The weapon does something about that.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Titans: Every swing is an event. The damage, the pushback, whatever that did to the door. One hit. One event.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Vampiric: The crits feel wrong. Too clean. Too certain. Like it already knows which hits will count.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Vicious: I don't know what I'm doing different. The openings just appear.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Prefix_Whirlwind: I cleared the room before I realized I'd started. There was screaming and then there wasn't.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_ofCarnage: The arc keeps taking what's in front of it. I've mostly stopped trying to aim.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_ofCelerity: The swing comes back and I'm already swinging again. My arms figured it out before my head did.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_ofCollapse: They don't stay upright when I want them to go down. That's new.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_ofDestruct: I stopped counting hits altogether. The math got too easy.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_ofDistance: I stood back and they still couldn't close. They tried. It was almost sad.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_ofEnduranc: It's been through more than it shows. More than it should be able to handle.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_ofEntry: Took a door in two hits. Felt wrong how easy that was.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_ofEternity: It should be dust by now. The math doesn't work.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_ofExecutio: I had a crit today that made me take a step back and look at the weapon. Just look at it.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_ofForce: One hit and they're off balance. Two hits and they've stopped being my problem.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_ofFortitud: Used it hard for a week. Still looks like I found it yesterday.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_ofHarm: It hits a little harder. Not dramatically. But a little. And a little adds up.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_ofHaste: Slightly quicker than before. Just enough to change the rhythm.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_ofHushing: The shot was quieter. Not silent, but the echo died fast. The dead didn't come.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_ofImpact: They bounce back now. Just a little. Enough breathing room.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_ofIronWill: I kept swinging past the point I should have had to stop. The weapon carries some of the weight. I swear it does.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_ofLethalit: The crits aren't just bigger. They're final. One and done, when they land.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_ofMastery: It barely degrades. The edge holds. The metal holds. Everything holds.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_ofPermanen: I've stopped carrying a backup. I didn't decide to. I just stopped.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_ofPrecisio: When it crits, it really crits. The difference is significant. I felt it immediately.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_ofPreserva: The wear is slower. Not much, but I notice. It comes back from fights looking better than it should.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_ofQuality: I sharpened it twice in the last month. Used to be every few days.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_ofReach: Just a little more room. Just a little. That's enough.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_ofRending: It found a way to catch two at once. Same swing. I didn't plan it.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_ofResilien: I keep waiting for it to break. It keeps not breaking.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_ofSiege: I've stopped thinking of doors as obstacles.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_ofSilence: I fired from the second floor. Nothing turned. Nothing looked up. Like I wasn't there.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_ofVigor: My lungs feel wrong when I stop. Like I expected to be more tired than I am.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_ofWounding: They go down in fewer hits. I've been counting. Fewer every time.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_oftheApoca: More damage. More range. More of everything. Too much, probably. I don't care.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_oftheDrop: Knocked one to its knees. Ground cleared faster after that.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_oftheEarth: I hit one and it knocked the next one sideways. Couldn't have planned it.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_oftheEtern: It's built to last and it bites harder on the way out. I don't understand how those two things go together, but here we are.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_oftheFell: It drops them. Hard. I stopped watching once I knew they weren't getting up.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_oftheGhost: Fast and slippery and finding the gaps I didn't know were there. It feels like fighting from somewhere they can't quite see.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_oftheImmor: I think it's going to outlast me. I think it knows that too.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_oftheJugge: It hits, it pushes, it doesn't break. That's the whole thing. That's enough.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_ofthePhant: Three shots. Three down. The horde outside didn't flinch. The gun swallowed its own sound.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_ofthePolea: I'm hitting them before they expect to be hit. The range is wrong in a good way.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_oftheSauce: Durable and getting more durable. It's like it gets stubborn about falling apart.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_oftheSlaye: The crits are something else now. Critical chance, critical damage, regular damage — it all adds up into something I don't have words for.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_oftheTirel: I went longer than I've gone in months. Wasn't out of breath. Still don't understand it.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_oftheVoid: The reach, the speed, the spread — it covers more ground than any one weapon has the right to.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_Suffix_oftheWind: I stopped counting the time between hits. It got embarrassing how fast it was.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_oftheConsumed: It took something from them. I saw the edge change.
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_oftheCovenant: Every wound it deals, it keeps
UI_VorpallySauced_Lore_oftheWielder: It stopped being a separate thing. It's just my arm now.
UI_VorpallySauced_MagazineClamp: The magazine won't take more. Something about the fit changed.
UI_VorpallySauced_MagazineWarning: This weapon has a loaded magazine. Its capacity might change with the new marks. Continue?
UI_VorpallySauced_MoodNotify_Agitated2: An uneasy tremor in the grip.
UI_VorpallySauced_MoodNotify_Calm2: A quiet settles over the weapon.
UI_VorpallySauced_MoodNotify_Eager1: The grip tightens on its own.
UI_VorpallySauced_MoodNotify_Focused2: It narrows. Everything else falls away.
UI_VorpallySauced_MoodNotify_Focused3: It finds its line. Nothing else.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Anxious_Desc: It feels your fear, and hates it.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Cold_Desc: Just a tool. Nothing has marked it.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Damp_Desc: Rain and red run together. Nothing sticks.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dreaming_Desc: Late and still. It dreams of edges it has met.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dripping_Desc: It won't come clean. It doesn't try.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Drowsing_Desc: Idle and indoors. It dozes against your side.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Feral_Desc: Blooded in the dark. It pulls toward the next one.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Flickering_Desc: Your dread strikes a spark in it, then nothing.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gloaming_Desc: The light goes. It feels the long dark coming on.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gorged_Desc: Slick to the grip and full — and hungry anyway.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Greying_Desc: Grey at the edges — you've lasted the night. It eases.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Humming_Desc: Quiet warmth in the daylight. Content, briefly.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Hunting_Desc: Half-fed in the dark, casting for more.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Quiet_Desc: No voice in it — only the weight of the dead.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Remembering_Desc: Quiet — but it counts the dead it has made.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Restless_Desc: It won't settle. It paces in your hand.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Rinsing_Desc: The rain takes the blood. It lets go, for now.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Roused_Desc: Awake to the work now. It wants the rhythm to hold.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Settling_Desc: Clean and sheltered, it forgets what it saw.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Singing_Desc: It rings between every blow. It does not want to stop.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Still_Desc: Resting. Patient. It has all the time there is.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Straining_Desc: Heavier than it was. It blames your tired arm.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Thirsting_Desc: Clean under a dead sky. It wants that to change.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Trembling_Desc: Too much death, too fast — it shudders to keep up.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Uneasy_Desc: The dark leans in. It almost understands why.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Warm_Desc: The blood leaves a warmth it can't name.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Watchful_Desc: Awake in the dark, listening with you.
UI_VorpallySauced_NotifyShardGranted: Something fell from the weapon. Sharp. Warm.
UI_VorpallySauced_NotifyTooltipLib:
VorpallySauced: TooltipLib is missing 

TooltipLib is required. Without it, VorpallySauced shows no tooltips at all.

Your weapons still gain marks, bonds and stats — only the display is missing. Subscribe to 'TooltipLib' on the Steam Workshop. On a server, it must also be in the Mods= line.

UI_VorpallySauced_Opt_GroupTooltip: When off, nothing from this category takes hold on new upgrades.
UI_VorpallySauced_Opt_PickerHint: Uncheck any affix to keep it from taking hold. Single-player only.
UI_VorpallySauced_Provenance_Bonded: The bond runs deeper than the form. It will survive the reforge.
UI_VorpallySauced_Provenance_Vessel: The impression lives in the vessel. Reforging will unmake it.
UI_VorpallySauced_ReforgeBlocked: Only Blooded weapons can be reforged.
UI_VorpallySauced_ReforgeLoss_Bond: A deeper thing, unwoven. It was not yet ready to leap forms.
UI_VorpallySauced_ReforgeLoss_Mark: The form changed. The memory scattered.
UI_VorpallySauced_RerollComplete: The marks shifted. Something new took hold.
UI_VorpallySauced_TraitEffect_NocturnalN: Panic and stress fade at night. Night vision.
UI_VorpallySauced_TraitEffect_PanicNight: Panic and stress fade at night
UI_VorpallySauced_TraitNotify_SomethingC: It changed. Something beneath it shifted.
UI_VorpallySauced_TraitNotify_WeightShif: The weight shifts in your hand.
UI_VorpallySauced_VorpalShardDesc:
Reshapes a weapon's marks and bonds. Kills stay.
Uses: %1
UI_VorpallySauced_WeaponAwakened: It stirred. Something behind the metal woke up.
UI_VorpallySauced_WeaponBroken_TooltipLi: Broken. The Stir has gone quiet.
UI_VorpallySauced_WeaponMastery: It changed again. Deeper this time.

UI_helpPanelText:
Map Mod Manager is a tool for identifying cell conflicts between map mods.

While conflicts can work with certain maps and careful load orders, it isn't always recommended. Conflicts with vanilla cells are okay, if you don't mind overriding vanilla towns.

Hover your mouse over any cell in the grid to tell you what maps are occupying that cell.

Green and blue cells are the vanilla map.
Purple cells are map mods that don't have a conflict.
Yellow cells are map mods that override a vanilla area (town).
Red cells are map mods that conflict with each other.

The list on the right shows map mods available on the workshop. Select them to show them on the cell grid. If you aren't subscribed or want more information, select the steam icon next to the map name. If you subscribe to a new map, you'll need to restart the game.

The lists on the left show map mods you're subscribed to and their dependencies. Select them to show them on the cell grid. Toggle them by clicking the checkbox next to the map name. Dependencies appear as you select and toggle maps; hover over a dependency to show if it is required by an active mod, a selected and subscribed mod, or a selected mod you aren't subscribed to. If a dependency is red, you aren't subscribed to it.

Adjust the load order by using the 'Move' buttons underneath the list of subscribed map mods. Generally, you won't need to if cells don't conflict. If cells do conflict, check the Steam Workshop page of the conflicting map mods for advice on load orders.

Export will generate a text file with the selected maps, dependencies and the required multiplayer data to paste into your server config file. File is located in: C:\Users\User\Zomboid\Lua\pathButtons have tooltips to tell you exactly what they do.

UI_options_ZBBetterFPS_enableMetrics_des: Collects and logs detailed performance metrics for various game systems to the console every 5 seconds. Useful for identifying performance hotspots.
UI_options_ZBBetterFPS_instantZoom_desc: Removes the zoom animation when changing the zoom level, providing an immediate transition.
UI_options_ZBBetterFPS_lowerCPUMode_desc: Yields CPU time to reduce power consumption and heat. Choose when to apply CPU throttling.
UI_options_ZBBetterFPS_optimize3DModels_: Caches shader uniform locations and optimizes matrix updates for 3D characters and items. Reduces CPU overhead when many models are visible.
UI_options_ZBBetterFPS_optimizeDefaultSh: Caches uniform locations and values for chunk rendering shaders. Prevents redundant GPU calls when rendering terrain tiles, saving CPU time in the Render thread.
UI_options_ZBBetterFPS_optimizeIndieGL_d: Caches the last applied OpenGL states (blend functions, alpha tests, etc.) in the IndieGL class. Skips redundant state changes, saving significant CPU time in the Render thread.
UI_options_ZBBetterFPS_optimizeIsoMoving: An optimized implementation of the object separation logic. Uses early-exit Z-checks and squared distance math to significantly reduce CPU overhead during physics updates.
UI_options_ZBBetterFPS_optimizeRingBuffe: Increases the GPU upload buffer size to 1MB and expands the batch pool to 20,000 entries. Reduces GPU synchronization overhead and prevents buffer overruns in extremely dense scenes.
UI_options_ZBBetterFPS_optimizeSpriteBat: Intelligently merges multiple sprites and 3D models into fewer draw calls. Significantly reduces CPU usage in the Render thread, especially with many characters on screen.
UI_options_ZBBetterFPS_renderDistance_de: Default is %1. Reload your save to apply.

UI_options_ZBBetterFPS_uncappedFPS_desc: Control uncapped FPS setting. Default: don't modify, Force Uncapped: set to true, Force Capped: set to false.

UI_optionscreen_BWOA_Backup: BACKUPS: It is strongly recommended that you make frequent backups of your save file. You have only one life and cannot respawn. Additionally, game crashes may corrupt your save file, leaving you with no way to recover your progress. Save folders are located in the Zomboid/Saves directory.
UI_optionscreen_BWOA_Diff: IT'S DIFFERENT: Do not expect the usual experience as this this mod significantly changes the game. It's a lore rich, quest based, narrative-driven adventure in which you not only have to survive, but also protect other human being. UI_prof_SWATMarksmanDesc: Former SWAT sharpshooter trained in precision shooting, fast reloading and tactical movement.
UI_prof_TimbersportsCompetitorDesc: Professional lumberjack athlete trained in axe sports; lightning-fast reflexes and unmatched chopping power.
UI_prof_arcadetech_desc: A skilled technician specialized in repairing arcade machines. Strong in electricity and metalwork, but physically weak and used to working late nights.
UI_prof_awesomelockpicking_MasterLocksmi: Start with a set of professional Lockpicking tools.
UI_prof_cabdriverdesc: You spent a lot of time working in a vehicle.
UI_prof_exorcistDesc: A specialist in spirits and hauntings. Inherently knows how to craft Exorcism Kits for others. Can perform rituals to cleanse buildings.
UI_prof_infectedDesc: Recently bitten but somehow retained consciousness. You can walk among the dead, but suspicious actions will reveal your true nature. <LINE> <LINE> +2 Sneaking <LINE> +1 Lightfooted <LINE> +1 Nimble <LINE> <LINE> Night Vision
UI_prof_moredesc_startingregularityexerc: Starts with %1 %% regularity in all fitness & strength exercises
UI_prof_occultistDesc: A practitioner of the dark arts. Uses Ouija boards to summon spirits and corrupt buildings.
UI_prof_specialforcesoperatordesc:
'The only easy day was yesterday.'
-Official Navy SEALs motto
UI_prof_youthworkerdesc: You have worked your entire life, you are especially fast at completing any task
UI_profdesc_Artista: Had an audience once. Now has a knife.
UI_profdesc_Barrendero: Keeps the shelter clean and reuses everything.
UI_profdesc_BellCreekEntertainer:
Before the world ended, you sold charm, companionship, and yourself in the smoke-filled rooms of a corrupt mining town's brothel. You survived by being quick on your feet, reading the room, and slipping away before things got violent. You aren't a fighter, but you are a master at masking your fear and surviving another day.

Grants the exclusive Entertainer's Guile trait.
UI_profdesc_BellCreekMiner:
You spent years swinging a pickaxe in the suffocating, dangerous dark of a silver mine. You are intimately familiar with backbreaking labor, terrible air quality, and burying your trauma in cheap booze at the local speakeasy.

Grants the exclusive Speakeasy Charisma trait.
UI_profdesc_BellCreekSheriff:
You spent years trying to maintain a fragile peace in a town built on illicit vice, greed, and dirty mining money. You know how to handle a firearm and how to put down a violent brawl, but carrying the town's darkest secrets - and enforcing laws you don't always believe in - has taken a heavy toll on your soul.

Grants the exclusive Lawman's Grit trait.
UI_profdesc_Bioquimico: Researches, cooks, documents, and fights if needed.
UI_profdesc_Brujo: Doesn’t heal, but many believe he does.
UI_profdesc_Caballero: Moral armor or real scrap—fights the same.
UI_profdesc_Callejero: Knows shortcuts, hideouts, and useful scraps.
UI_profdesc_Camello: Moves things quietly. Gets paid well.
UI_profdesc_Campesino: Feet on the ground. Hands worn and ready.
UI_profdesc_Carnicera: Cuts with precision and no remorse.
UI_profdesc_Carnicero: Cuts flesh, cleans bone. Knows a body’s worth.
UI_profdesc_Casero: Cooks well, fixes the basics, and keeps the shelter running.
UI_profdesc_Cazador: Follows tracks. Or invents his own.
UI_profdesc_Cazarecompensas: Hunts for money. Kills for sport.
UI_profdesc_Chaman: Mysterious and skilled, mixes intuition and precision to survive.
UI_profdesc_Chapucero: Improvises fixes that sometimes work too well.
UI_profdesc_Clinico: Knows real medicine. And what hurts too.
UI_profdesc_Contrabandista: Smuggles things where no one else can.
UI_profdesc_Contratista: Builds shelters on request… or for the mob.
UI_profdesc_Curandera: Knows plants and heals with what she finds.
UI_profdesc_DeadStashConservator: A careful preservation specialist who turns damaged records and recovered machines into usable history. Starts with Archive Lore 2, Restoration 2 and Reading 1, plus +1 Maintenance and +1 Tailoring. Carries a field journal, restoration handbook, glue and scissors. Profession training makes restoration actions a further 10%% faster.
UI_profdesc_DeadStashInvestigator: A patient field researcher trained to connect scattered evidence. Starts with Investigation 2 and level 1 in Reading, Archive Lore and Fieldcraft, plus a magnifying glass, field journal and unopened case file. Receives +1 Foraging, +1 Sneaking and an investigator Search Mode speciality: a wider search radius with better odds for junk, discarded clues and rare finds.
UI_profdesc_Desgraciado: Life hit him hard. He hits back.
UI_profdesc_Desollador: Knows how to remove skin—human or not.
UI_profdesc_Dictador: He commands even though no one chose him. And he knows how to do it.
UI_profdesc_Donante: Already gave all he could. Still useful.
UI_profdesc_EHRDoctor: An EHR-trained doctor. Starts with advanced First Aid, basic short blade skill, and full disease knowledge.
UI_profdesc_EHRSurgeon: An expert surgeon. Starts with master First Aid, stronger short blade skill, full disease knowledge, and Scalpel Master.
UI_profdesc_Enterrador: Knows how to dig, close cycles, and bury fears.
UI_profdesc_Esclavo: Used to hard work—and never complaining.
UI_profdesc_Esquizofrenico: Sees more than he should. Sometimes he’s right.
UI_profdesc_Estudiante: Learns fast, full of energy and enthusiasm.
UI_profdesc_Experimento: Result of tests. Survives despite everything.
UI_profdesc_FeralDrifter:
You lived completely off the grid long before the Knox Event, relying on your instincts and biology rather than human society. The wilderness is your true home, and the apocalypse just means fewer humans to interrupt your hunt.

Grants the exclusive Eternal Hunger trait.
UI_profdesc_Feriante: Sells what he has—or what’s needed.
UI_profdesc_Filosofo: Thinks too much. Sees what others miss.
UI_profdesc_Fontanero: Born fixer. Finds leaks and patches them.
UI_profdesc_Forense: Speaks with the dead. Learns from them.
UI_profdesc_Gallego: Says he’s not Galician. Survives like one.
UI_profdesc_Gaucho: Knife, mate, and silence. Deadly if disturbed.
UI_profdesc_Gitano: Moves, trades, survives. Trusts no one.
UI_profdesc_HCB_Beekeeper: Skilled at hive care and field foraging around pollinator habitats.
UI_profdesc_HCC_Potter: You made a living at the wheel and the kiln. Pottery comes much faster, you keep your tools in better shape, and you already have an artisan's eye for clay and glass.
UI_profdesc_Hikikomikenshi: It's you. You've been living in a gray city, But you don't have any reason or room for it anymore.
UI_profdesc_Hitokiri: Butcher in the underworld who's been slain people before the crisis.
UI_profdesc_Kobudoka: Rank holder of classical martial arts who deals with polearms in general, Such as staff, Spear, And halberd.
UI_profdesc_Licenciado: Lots of study. Little street. Learns fast anyway.
UI_profdesc_Lisiado: Physically limited. Makes up for it with wit or rage.
UI_profdesc_Machaca: Used to run errands. Now cracks skulls.
UI_profdesc_Maestro: Fixes almost anything with whatever’s at hand.
UI_profdesc_Mafioso: Moves through shady deals and gets the impossible.
UI_profdesc_Malhecho: Never was right. Now he uses it to his advantage.
UI_profdesc_Matero: Always has mate tea. And patience to survive.
UI_profdesc_Militante: Obeys orders, even when there aren’t any.
UI_profdesc_Ministro: Finds resources even when there are none.
UI_profdesc_Mochilero: Travels light. Lives with what fits on his back.
UI_profdesc_Motero: Knows old routes. Some still work.
UI_profdesc_Motivado: Wants to do everything and is always ready.
UI_profdesc_Nomada: Carries his home on his back. Never roots down.
UI_profdesc_Okupa: Takes shelter where others see ruins.
UI_profdesc_PA_Chairman:
Your concern for Kikyo and Sugar, two close friends who grew up together since childhood, leaves you restless. 
Ignoring the objections of other corporate members, you resolutely step into the portal. 
Well, perhaps you should also pray that the acting chairperson can manage the company properly.
Starting Character: Rironn
Starting Equipment: WESTTECH® Energy Knife, WESTTECH® H-02c Charge Carbine (300 ammunition, 3 magazines), WESTTECH® H-04p Plasma Pistol (200 ammunition); WESTTECH® Work Uniform Set, WESTTECH® Standard Tactical Bag
UI_profdesc_PA_LittleMaid:
Staying with Miss High Lilies is always your top priority. 
Find her as soon as possible. Time is running out.
Starting Character: Kaeri Koromi
Starting Equipment: FALLON'S® Alloy Umbrella, WESTTECH® CS-Phantom Automatic Shotgun (134 ammunition); Casual Outfit II Set, FALLON'S® Doll Backpack (Blue)
UI_profdesc_PA_Moelotl:
You are a traveler sent here from the future. You are known as a Corrector, and your mission is to fix the mistakes of the past. 
However, once a mistake has been made, can it truly be corrected?
Starting Character: Kikyo (Can be switched to Sugar after entering the game)
Starting Equipment: WESTTECH® Energy Knife, WESTTECH® H-04p Plasma Pistol (200 ammunition); Casual Outfit Set, WESTTECH® Custom Moelotl Duffle Bag
UI_profdesc_PA_Ojousan:
You are the daughter of the former chairperson of WESTTECH® Corporation in the Old Era. 
The glorious past is gone, but by inheriting your father's will, there is still a chance to restore everything to its former state...
Starting Character: Lilies Kumono
Starting Equipment: FALLON'S® Alloy Umbrella, 'Goodbye Gift by Lilies' Father' (250 ammunition, 3 magazines); Miss High Outfit Set, FALLON'S® Doll Backpack (Purple)
UI_profdesc_PA_Reaper:
The temporal and spatial chaos caused by the Project Anime brought you here. 
Now, surviving and finding a way home has become an unprecedented challenge for a useless Reaper like you.
Starting Character: Tina
Starting Equipment: Reaper Scythe 'Yoru no Murasaki'; Apprentice Reaper Outfit Set, Blue Shoulder Bag
UI_profdesc_Paramedico: Runs, heals, and flees if necessary.
UI_profdesc_Paria: Cast out everywhere. But never falls completely.
UI_profdesc_Payaso: Laughs at chaos. Madness disarms or confuses.
UI_profdesc_Picapedrero: Breaks rock, breaks fear, breaks path.
UI_profdesc_Pistolero: Fast on the trigger. Accurate when it counts.
UI_profdesc_Politico: The worst and the best of society.
UI_profdesc_Principe: Raised to lead. Not to fight.
UI_profdesc_Recolector: Searches for fruit, roots, or human remains.
UI_profdesc_Repartidor: Knows every route and delivers without questions.
UI_profdesc_Rey: Thinks he has the right to rule. Sometimes it works.
UI_profdesc_Senador: Talks a lot. But survives with privileges.
UI_profdesc_Shihan: Martial artist who has devoted himself to the path of swords since he was a trainee at a dojo or tactical gym.
UI_profdesc_Solitario: Prefers silence, but calm keeps him alive.
UI_profdesc_Tarado: Not right in the head. But no one dares touch him.
UI_profdesc_Taxidermista: Meticulous handyman who gives new life to discarded things.
UI_profdesc_Taxista: Drives anything that still works. Knows all shortcuts.
UI_profdesc_Tecnochaman: Understands old machines and brings them back to life.
UI_profdesc_Toukenshuushuuka:
Expert with expertise in various forms of swords, Such as relics, Crafts, And antique works.
A more efficient repair tool can be created by combining some materials with repair tools used in special long blades.
UI_profdesc_Trafica: Gets what’s unavailable. At a price.
UI_profdesc_Traidor: Helps you. Then sells you out.
UI_profdesc_Trapero: Collects what no one wants. Lives off it.
UI_profdesc_Trilero: Always has something to offer. Or to trade.
UI_profdesc_Vago: Avoids effort whenever possible—but still survives.
UI_profdesc_WitchDoctor:
Before the Knox Event, you were a suspiciously rich doctor, but now your pristine clinic has been replaced by the untamed wilderness. You have traded sterile scalpels, pristine scrubs, and modern pharmaceuticals for foraged herbs, bone saws, and a deeply unsettling understanding of feral anatomy.

Foraging Bonuses:
+2 vision radius
+20%% chance to find wild herbs.
+10%% chance to find medicinal plants.

Grants the exclusive Primal Apothecary trait.
UI_profdesc_Yonki: Seeks his dose. Finds useful stuff instead.

UI_profdesc_YumiAlaskanWolf: A pack-minded wolf survivor with sharp senses, strong instincts, and a hunter's patience.

UI_profdesc_YumiGreenIguana: A sun-loving reptile survivor with scales, balance, outdoor skill, and cold-blooded drawbacks.

UI_profdesc_YumiLabradorRetriever: A loyal tracker with a strong nose, outdoor skill, courage, and natural foraging ability.

UI_profdesc_YumiNileCrocodile: A heavy reptile predator with scaled skin, bite power, strength, and survival patience.
UI_profdesc_YumiRedFox: A clever fox built for quiet steps, scavenging, trapping, and slipping away before trouble catches up.
UI_profdesc_YumiSaintBernard: A sturdy rescue-hearted survivor with thick fur, resilience, strength, and first-aid talent.

UI_profdesc_settlementbuilder: A practical builder focused on walls, workshops, power, and the repairs a safehouse needs.

UI_profdesc_sharpshooter: Highly trained in firearms with exceptional precision.
UI_profdesc_signalrunner: A mobile communications survivor who repairs radios and carries messages when signals fail.
UI_profdesc_specialforces: Active-duty special forces operative with comprehensive combat and survival expertise.
UI_profdesc_specialops_breacher: Shock trooper. Closes distance hard, knocks zombies down on the charge, shrugs off pain.
UI_profdesc_specialops_demoengineer: Explosives, field repairs, and tactical electronics. Targeted breach charges, jury-rig fixes, radios, and controlled-entry tools.
UI_profdesc_specialops_marksman: Precision overwatch. Aiming talent beyond skill caps — faster aim settle, first-shot lethality, and rock-steady focus.
UI_profdesc_specialops_medic: Battlefield doctor. Stabilizes nearby wounded allies with a fast, supply-driven Field Triage action and keeps them calm under pressure.

UI_profdesc_specialops_scoutghost: Recon specialist. Silent steps, night cloak, and scout sense that marks nearby threats while you stay unseen.

UI_quick_tip204: Tajadas fritas rodeado de zombies... es que tú eres demasiado sifrino, chamo.
UI_quick_tip205: ¿Plátano maduro en el fin del mundo? Mijo, no lo desperdicies. Hazle las Tajadas.
UI_quick_tip206: La Carne Mechada bien condimentada es el antídoto contra la depresión postapocalíptica.
UI_quick_tip207: Pabellón a Caballo: porque incluso en el fin del mundo, uno tiene sus estándares.

UI_trait_AHS_CalmPhysiology_desc: You remain calm even when your body feels under pressure.
UI_trait_AHS_ChronicDehydration_desc: Your body struggles to maintain proper hydration. Thirst increases quickly.
UI_trait_AHS_ChronicHeadaches_desc: Frequent stress headaches have become part of daily life. Stress builds faster and concentration suffers.
UI_trait_AHS_ChronicInflammation_desc: Your body remains in a state of low-grade inflammation. Pain and stiffness appear more often.
UI_trait_AHS_ConditionedMuscles_desc: Your muscles adapt well to repeated effort. You can feel yourself recovering faster after fatigue.
UI_trait_AHS_DisturbedSleep_desc: Your sleep cycle is unstable and easily disrupted. Fatigue accumulates faster.
UI_trait_AHS_FragilePhysiology_desc: Your body struggles to recover from extreme physiological stress.
UI_trait_AHS_HealthAnxiety_desc: You frequently worry about your physical condition. Stress and panic build more easily.
UI_trait_AHS_HydrationEfficient_desc: Your body manages water efficiently. You tolerate dehydration better.
UI_trait_AHS_ImmuneSurvivor_desc: Your immune system adapted after surviving a severe infection.
UI_trait_AHS_InfectionProne_desc: Your body struggles to fight localized infections. Bacterial load rises more easily.
UI_trait_AHS_InflammationResistant_desc: Your body recovers quickly from inflammatory responses.
UI_trait_AHS_IronGut_desc: Your digestion handles questionable food better than most. You notice less punishment from suspicious meals.
UI_trait_AHS_MentalBurnout_desc: Repeated mental strain has worn you down. Fatigue accumulates faster under stress.
UI_trait_AHS_MentalResilience_desc: You remain mentally stable even under prolonged pressure. Stress has less impact on you.
UI_trait_AHS_MuscleBurnout_desc: Your muscles fatigue quickly after repeated strain. Physical recovery is slower.
UI_trait_AHS_PostSepsisWeakness_desc: Your body still bears the scars of a severe infection. You recover slower from illness.
UI_trait_AHS_ResilientDigestion_desc: Your digestive system recovered stronger after past illness.
UI_trait_AHS_RobustDigestion_desc: Your digestion handles questionable food better than most. You notice less punishment from suspicious meals.
UI_trait_AHS_SensitiveStomach_desc: Your digestive system reacts easily to poor food. Food sickness occurs more frequently.
UI_trait_AHS_StableSleepCycle_desc: Your body maintains a stable sleep rhythm. You notice that rest leaves you more restored.
UI_trait_AHS_StressHardened_desc: You have learned to manage stress and tension better than most. You can feel it takes longer for stress to wear you down.
UI_trait_AHS_StrongImmuneResponse_desc: Your immune system reacts quickly to infections. Recovery from infections is faster.
UI_trait_AHS_SurvivorPhysiology_desc: Your body adapted after surviving extreme physiological stress.
UI_trait_AHS_WeakDigestion_desc: Your digestive system has become fragile after repeated illness.
UI_trait_AT_AnthroImmunity_desc:
Knox Infection is very rare, even from bites.
Per bite: %1%%
Per laceration: %2%%
Per scratch: %3%%
UI_trait_AT_BeastOfBurden_desc:
Your body's frame is well-built for carrying weight.
Weight cap increases by %1%%
UI_trait_AT_Bug_o_ssieur_desc:
NOT WORKING IN MP. Your ancestors weren't shy about eating insects.
You don't gain unhappiness or boredom when eating insects.
Insects are %1%% more nutritious.
You have a %2%% increased chance of foraging for insects.
UI_trait_AT_BullRush_desc:
You have horns or another feature built for knocking opponents about.
When sprinting, knock zombies over at the cost of endurance.
UI_trait_AT_Carnivore_desc:
Foods mostly comprised of meat are %1%% more nutritious, plants %2%% less.
Raw meat doesn't make you sick.
You have a %3%% increased chance of foraging for dead animals.
UI_trait_AT_CarrionEater_desc:
Your bloodline has gifted you an iron stomach.
Rotten meat is %1%% more nutritious.
Rotten and/or raw meat doesn't make you sick.
You have a %2%% increased chance of foraging for dead animals.
UI_trait_AT_Digitigrade_desc:
You lightly walk on your toes (paws or claws) and your legs are build for sneaking/running.
Stomps do %1%% more damage, but you have a %2%% decreased carry weight.
Your paws/claws cannot be scratched.
+1 Sprinting
+1 Stealth
+1 Lightfoot
UI_trait_AT_Exclaimer_desc:
The need to warn others of danger runs deep.
%1%% chance to yell per minute, when at panic level 2.
Higher panic levels mean much more yelling.
UI_trait_AT_FeralBody_desc:
NOT WORKING IN MP. Your body has a more feral form. You are faster, but most clothes feel restricting to you.
You move %1%% faster, but (most) clothes give you %2 point(s) of discomfort (%3x if any defensive stats above %4).
UI_trait_AT_FeralDigestion_desc:
Foods poisonous to ferals have %1 poison power for you.
(Foods not selected for this trait may still be poisonous to some pets!
Please be careful in what you feed them!)
UI_trait_AT_FoodMotivated_desc:
You are particularly delighted by food.
Food makes you %1 points happier and less bored;
Dog food doesn't make you unhappy.
UI_trait_AT_Herbivore_desc:
Foods mostly comprised of plants are %1%% more nutritious, meats %2%% less so.
Raw plants don't make you sick.
Poisonous plants affect you as normal.
You have a %3%% increased chance of foraging for vegetables, berries and fruits.
UI_trait_AT_Lonely_desc:
Being solitary never suited you or your pack.
After %1 hours without seeing a player, lose %2%% happiness per hour.
UI_trait_AT_LowEndHunter_desc:
You prefer to sneak up to your target and pounce on them. You are not made for long chases.
+1 Sprinting
+1 Sneak
-1 Fitness
Endurance recovery suffers a %1%% decrease.
UI_trait_AT_NaturalTumbler_desc:
Your body is built for short falls.
You impact the floor at only %1%% of the fall speed.
UI_trait_AT_Stinky_desc:
You have a tendency to stink. Worse, you're nose-blind to it.
If you're too dirty, Zombies will be more attracted to you.
Other players may comment on your smell.
UI_trait_AT_Tail_desc:
You have a tail, which allows you to run with more balance.
%1%% reduced chance of tripping.
Doesn't work for tripping through trees/bushes.
UI_trait_AT_Torpor_desc:
Your ancestors hibernated, and part of that urge passed to you.
You have %1%% less endurance during the cold months.
UI_trait_AT_Unguligrade_desc:
You walk on the reinforced tip of your toes (hooves) and your legs are built for running.
Stomps do %1%% more damage, but you have a %2%% decreased carry weight.
Your hooves cannot be scratched, lacerated, or bitten.
Broken glass still affects your feet.
+1 Sprinting
+1 Nimble
UI_trait_AT_UnwieldyHands_desc:
Your hands have less fingers than a human, or simply don't work as well.
Actions requiring fine motor control are %1%% slower.
UI_trait_AT_VestigialWings_desc:
You gained semi-working wings from somewhere in your bloodline.
You are immune to all fall damage.
UI_trait_AT_VoiceAvian_desc:
Adds a %1%% chance for exclamations (Exclaimer) to be mistaken for animal sounds and ignored by zombies.
Your warning calls are also more bird-like.
UI_trait_AT_VoiceFeline_desc:
Adds a %1%% chance for exclamations (Exclaimer) to be mistaken for animal sounds and ignored by zombies.
Your warning calls are also more feline.
UI_trait_AT_VoiceSheep_desc:
Adds a %1%% chance for exclamations (Exclaimer) to be mistaken for animal sounds and ignored by zombies.
Your warning calls are also more sheep-like.
UI_trait_AVClubDesc: You are a part of the AV Club
UI_trait_AcrophobicDesc:
High levels of elevation causes stress
Witnessing large drops in elevation causes panic
Refusal to jump through high windows unless in dire straights
Less likely to land safely after a fall
UI_trait_ActionHeroDesc:
You live for the thick of the fight.
Your weapons deal half their normal damage when no enemies are nearby, but gain damage and critical chance for every living zombie within 10 tiles. Closer zombies provide larger bonuses.
UI_trait_ActionStarDesc: You trained to star in an action film but were fired and replaced with someone better looking.
UI_trait_AddictedToCaffeineDesc: Irritability, stress and fatigue when not consuming caffeine.
UI_trait_AgileDesc: Nimble, quick & knows the basics of fluid movement.
UI_trait_AgriculturistDesc:
Expert in crop cultivation.
Highly skilled in managing diverse crops, their specific requirements & growing optimization.
UI_trait_Aim2Desc: Trained survivor in advanced aiming & shooting techniques.
UI_trait_Aim3Desc:
Highly skilled & trained survivor.
Excels at precise shooting with ranged weapons.
UI_trait_AlcoholicDesc: You need alcohol flowing through your veins to feel good.
UI_trait_AllHailCaesarDesc:
Apes! Together! Strong!
[+30%% foraging bonus to firewood and stones]
UI_trait_AllThumbsDesc2:
Transfers inventory items 50%% slower. Draws weapons slower.
Climbs ropes slower, with an increased chance of falling.
Cannot craft items while walking.
UI_trait_AllergicDesc:
Likely to sneeze with pollen in the air, or on you.
Can muffle sneeze with a tissue.
UI_trait_AmateurElectricianDesc: You have practiced enough, you are ready to connect generators.
UI_trait_AmateurWelderDesc:
Familiar with many methods and constructions of metalworking.
+1 Metalworking
UI_trait_AmbidextrousDesc: You're naturally gifted at using both hands. All Ambidextrous skills are easier to learn!
UI_trait_AnemicDesc: You lose health more rapidly from unstemmed bleeding wounds.
UI_trait_AngryDesc_explicit:
Become angry after breaking something, crashing into an object with your car, jamming your gun, getting injured
gain anger when in pain or getting bored
Become angry easier when drunk or stressed
Lose anger by destroying things or doing things that make you happy
When angry you are more likely to break things, jam guns, get useless materials from carpentry, and damage weapons much faster
When angry you are more likely to critically hit.
At full anger you are very likely to break something without warning
UI_trait_AnimalControlDesc: Wild animals? In your backyard? Absolutely not!
UI_trait_AnimalDigestionDesc: Foods that are dangerous for animals, such as chocolate, cause food poisoning when eaten.
UI_trait_AnorexyDesc: Eating disorder. Intense fear of gaining weight.
UI_trait_AntiGunActivistDesc:
You have no experience with firearms and dislike using them.
Firearms take longer to aim, have reduced range, and make you unhappy while aiming or handling magazines.
You receive 25%% less Aiming and Reloading XP while between 5%% and 95%% progress through the current level.
UI_trait_AntiGunDesc:
Starting to use guns induces sadness and slight panic, but goes away over time.
50%% skill XP gain for guns.
UI_trait_Apathetic_Desc: Panic is suppressed. Stress, unhappiness, boredom, and discomfort are strongly limited.
UI_trait_ApexLungsActivate: Your lungs find a deeper rhythm.
UI_trait_ApexLungsDesc:
Deep, voluminous lungs let you push your body further without tiring.
Moderate and High Exertion appear later. While walking, you slowly recover endurance.

Activation messages will appear overhead.
UI_trait_ApprenticeBlacksmithDesc: You were learning from the best until the best tried to eat you.
UI_trait_Archerdesc: You have skills with bows and arrows.
UI_trait_AsceticDesc:
You reject elaborate food, comfortable sleep, and passive entertainment.
Simple food provides more fullness and calories. Boredom and unhappiness reductions from packaged food become increases instead. Prepared meals with two ingredients/spices provide no mood benefit; with three or more, their mood benefits become penalties.
Poor beds and bare floors feel good, good beds feel poor, and sleeping with a pillow always feels poor.
Television cannot reduce your boredom or unhappiness, and comic books provide no mood benefits. Ordinary books are unaffected. However, living such a simple life is what you are used to, and you your Boredom and Unhappiness are slowly reduces passively.

Due to technical limitations: The food always shows original benefits, the trait effect is applied when you eat an item. Same with beds and magazines, the bed tooltip shows non-Ascetic bed quality, but basically you just flip it. Comic books show original values too. This is a technical limitation that would require a LOT of work to bypass, so it's going to take some time, if it'll even be implemented at all.
UI_trait_AtletaDesc: Used to running, no longer fears or panics in crowds.
UI_trait_AutoBodyDesc: From not knowing how to hold the flashlight still, to fixing the whole car. You've come a long way.
UI_trait_AutumnHoarderDesc:
The crisp autumn air triggers a deep, biological imperative to stockpile for the freezing months ahead. Your focus sharpens dramatically when gathering provisions.
During Autumn (September-November), maximum carry weight is slightly increased.

Mutually exclusive with other seasonal traits.

UI_trait_Axe1Desc: Survivor learning basics of hatchet combat
UI_trait_Axe2Desc: Seasoned warrior adept in axe combat & is able to cut through both wood & undead flesh with ease.
UI_trait_Axe3Desc:
Highly skilled logger & axe handler.
Known for their unparalleled ability to cleave through hordes of undeads.
UI_trait_AxeThrowerDesc: You have participated in axe throwing competitions
UI_trait_BadTeethDesc: Eating may cause pain in your head. Larger portions cause more pain.
UI_trait_BagsAndBeltsDesc:
Trader who is well-versed in efficient bags and belts usage.
Has higher maximum carrying capacity during their travels and trades.
Increased maximum carrying capacity.
[32 at max strength]
UI_trait_BarFighterDesc2:
Used to getting in trouble.
Successful attacks in melee have a chance to reduce unhappiness.
Knows some improvised weapons recipes.
UI_trait_BarFighterHTDesc: Always with you, just one too many.
UI_trait_BatteringRamDesc:
When Sprinting (not running), knockdown zombies, barge through unlocked doors, and have a chance to barge through locked doors.
Less likely to trip sprinting through crowds the stronger you are.
Gain this trait automatically at 10 strength
+2 Strength
UI_trait_BatteringRamDesc_fun: "You know how to take people down."
UI_trait_BeastOfBurdenDesc:
A robust skeletal structure allows for excellent weight distribution.
Carry weight is increased by +{1}.
UI_trait_BeastkinDesc:
A beastly survivor with Outdoorsy benefits, improved Fitness, Animal Care and Tracking, and stronger foraging for animals, vegetables and herbs.

Foraging Bonuses:
+3 vision radius
+15%% chance to find wild herbs.
+10%% chance to find vegetables and animals.
+5%% chance to find berries, mushrooms, medicinal plants and wild plants.

Skill Bonuses:
UI_trait_BenzoAddictdesc:
Has a Benzo Dependence.
Withdrawals at 3 (Medium), 6 (Bad), 10 (Mild) days.
If Benzo taken every 3 days, you can lose trait with no withdrawals.
Will lose trait if no Benzo (Xanax) is done for 18-20 days.
-Hunger, +Thirst, +Fatigue, -Endurance, +Panic, +Stress.
UI_trait_BikeOwnerDesc: Start out with your own bicycle!
UI_trait_BittenDesc: You had really bad luck, a zombie gifted you a bite
UI_trait_BlackoutDesc: You get out of the shower and fall badly. You're blind drunk, and have a nasty cold. On top of all this, the house is on fire!
UI_trait_BlacksmithMasterDesc: Can create exquisite weaponry with rare resources
UI_trait_BladderControlDesc: 75%% chance to stop urination 5%% of the way through peeing self.
UI_trait_Blade1Desc: Survivor learning the art of sword combat.
UI_trait_Blade2Desc: Seasoned warrior skilled in sword combat, adept at slicing through undead.
UI_trait_Blade3Desc:
Masterful warrior trained in the ancient art of the blade.
Deadly force that elegantly slices through undead ranks with unparalleled skill & precision
UI_trait_BladeEnthusiastDesc: A deep appreciation for edged weapons and the discipline to wield them effectively. You've honed your skills with long blades, making every strike count
UI_trait_BleederDesc:
Wounds bleed excessively, heightening their severity and endangering survival.
[+100%% damage from bleeding]
UI_trait_BleedingOutDesc: Start with a glass shard lodged in your neck, bleeding profusely.
UI_trait_BlindDesc:
Use echolocation to detect your surroundings.
Perception based on hearing ability.
Cannot read.
UI_trait_BlissfulDesc: You have a positive outlook. Unhappiness and boredom fade more quickly.
UI_trait_BloodThirst_desc: You must feed on the dead to survive.
UI_trait_BloodlustDesc: Uncontrollable desire to kill. Your mood will be affected if you don't get victims.
UI_trait_Blunt1Desc: Survivor learning basics of long blunt combat
UI_trait_Blunt2Desc: Skilled in long blunt combat, adept at breaking through obstacles & undead.
UI_trait_Blunt3Desc: Powerful fighter wielding long blunt weapons, bulldozes through undead hordes effortlessly.
UI_trait_BodyWorkEnthusiastDesc: You enjoy repairing and restoring the bodies of old cars
UI_trait_BookLoverDesc: This survivor treasures two well-preserved books, one of the few really rare finds in the apocalypse.
UI_trait_BootCampDesc: As always a good military training pays back <LINE> +2 Strength, +2 Fitness, +1 Running, +1 Aiming and +1 Reloading
UI_trait_BouncerDesc:
You've roughed people up now and again.
When three or more zombies crowd around you, you may automatically stagger one of them.
UI_trait_BowelControlDesc: 75%% chance to stop defecation 5%% of the way through pooping self.
UI_trait_BrittleBodyDesc: Feels like every step is an effort, and every lift a strain.
UI_trait_BrittleKneesDesc: Your condition is terrible, your fitness is very reduced.
UI_trait_BrokenDesc: Start the game with a fractured leg.
UI_trait_BrokenLegDesc:
You were recovering from recent accident when everything started. You start with a broken leg, a severely debilitating injury.
Your leg will be splinted and bandaged.
UI_trait_BurnPatientDesc: Start covered in bandaged burns in various states of cleanliness.
UI_trait_BushinDesc:
In terms of martial arts, we have reached the state of God.
-2x Faster weapon swing.
UI_trait_ButcherDesc: Higher minimum damage with short blunt and short blade weapons.
UI_trait_ButterfingersDesc:
You may drop held items while moving. Heavy loads and running make this more likely.
You may also accidentally drop items on the ground while transferring them.
UI_trait_CMCatLoverDesc: Animals trust you faster. Comfort from cats is stronger. Does not start with a cat — find strays and earn trust with food. Cats never fight zombies.
UI_trait_Calloused_Desc: Panic is suppressed. Stress, unhappiness, boredom, and discomfort are moderately limited.
UI_trait_CarCrashDesc: Start at the scene of a car crash near your house, broken and bloody.
UI_trait_CarnivoreDesc:
Enjoys eating meat and seafood.
Meat and seafood are {1}%% more effective at reducing hunger and unhappiness.
Plant-based food is {2}%% less effective.
Raw meat doesn't make you sick.

Foraging Bonuses:
+1.5 vision radius
+20%% chance to find animals.

Skill Bonuses:
UI_trait_ChronicPainDesc:
Constant pain at night plagues this survivor, making their daily life uncomfortable.
Painkillers are crucial.
[Receives random pain levels nightly, ranging from "Pain" to "Severe Pain" (rarely "Agony")]
UI_trait_CoffeeLoverDesc:
Treasures a rare find: a pack of premium coffee.
A precious commodity in the apocalypse.
UI_trait_CokeHeaddesc:
Has a Cocaine addiction.
Withdrawals at 1 (Medium), 5 (Bad), 10 (Mild) days.
If Cocaine taken every 5 days, you can lose trait with no tier 2 withdrawals.
Will lose trait if no cocaine is done for 18-20 days.
+Hunger, +Thirst, +Fatigue, -Endurance, +Stress, +Head Pain.
UI_trait_ColdIntolerantDesc: Get cold more easy and take longer to warm up.
UI_trait_ColdIntolerantDesc_fun: "You never left home without a jacket."
UI_trait_ColdTolerantDesc: Stay warm more easy and warm up faster
UI_trait_CombatAnxietyDescDF: Although acclimatised to warfare, you were never able to master your battlefied anxiety. <LINE> Stress gains passively over time, and increases in combat.
UI_trait_ComicGeekDesc: True comic lover at heart, treasures two well-preserved exemplars.
UI_trait_CommSpecialistDesc:
Highly skilled in operation, crafting & maintenance of communication devices.
Proficient at establishing contact and surveilling frequencies.
UI_trait_ComputerWhizDesc: Your family members have you on speed dial.
UI_trait_CondenaSolar_desc: Endures daylight better, but thirst rises faster at night.
UI_trait_Cook3Desc: Knows recipes from pre fall & how to decently fry a fresh rat
UI_trait_Cooking1Desc:
Skilled at making meals that won't kill you.... instantly.
Consider it a culinary survival test.
UI_trait_CrushedHandsDesc: Start with two fractured hands, preventing the use of weapons until splinted.
UI_trait_CurativeSalivaDesc:
Your biology produces enzymes that naturally stave off infection. While you still need to bandage lacerations and scratches, your wounds stay remarkably clean on their own.
Wound infections clear up rapidly on their own and bandages take significantly longer to become dirty.

Mutually exclusive with Wound Picker.

Skill Bonuses:
UI_trait_DancerDesc: You're here. Now you're there. You're everywhere.
UI_trait_DayTorpor_desc: During the day you fall into lethargy: slower and weaker, but thirst eases while resting.
UI_trait_DeadStashBookwormDesc: Starts with Reading 1 and reads every book 10%% faster. Cannot be combined with Illiterate, Slow Reader or Fast Reader.
UI_trait_DefenseTacticsDesc: More likely to defend zombie attacks.
UI_trait_DeliWorkerDesc: Minimum wage, minimum effort. But you make a mean sandwich now.
UI_trait_DepressiveDesc:
You are prone to bouts of sadness.
You occasionally gain a large amount of unhappiness that slowly recedes until the episode ends.
UI_trait_DeprivedDesc: You didn't have much in the way of possessions before the apocalypse. You begin only with underwear, a T-shirt, sneakers, a garbage bag, and a key ring.
UI_trait_Detached_Desc: Panic is suppressed. Stress, unhappiness, boredom, and discomfort are limited.
UI_trait_DexterousDesc2:
Transfers inventory items 50%% faster. Draws weapons faster.
Climbs ropes faster, with a reduced chance of falling.
UI_trait_DisasterDesc:
"It's a miracle you've survived this long."
Louder footstep sounds
Chance to trip when running or sprinting
Can trip on corpses and items
Always trip if running downstairs

UI_trait_DislikesHeavyLoadDesc:
Carrying too much makes this survivor gradually stressed.
[+Stress if over 80%% of the max carry capacity]
UI_trait_Drug_ToleranceDesc: You are more resistant to DrugTime substances: effects build up more slowly and overdose damage is reduced.
UI_trait_Drugzz_CannabisConnoisseurDesc: Experienced with cannabis cultivation and dosing. Starts with the advanced manual and three classic seed varieties. Cannabis side effects and tolerance growth are reduced, while useful effects last slightly longer.
UI_trait_Drugzz_ClubRegularDesc: Starts with molly, ecstasy, and water. Mood and energy rise quickly, but dehydration, overheating, nausea, jaw pain, tolerance, fatigue, and a low comedown are familiar.
UI_trait_Drugzz_CocaineDependentDesc: Starts with a cocaine baggie and high stimulant tolerance. Short-lived energy comes with appetite loss, cottonmouth, panic, heart strain, a hard crash, and strong withdrawal.
UI_trait_Drugzz_CrackDependentDesc: Starts with a pipe, two rocks, and a lighter and already knows how to load a crack pipe. The rush is immediate, but dependence is severe; coughing, panic, overdose, exhaustion, depression, and cravings follow.
UI_trait_Drugzz_MethDependentDesc: Starts with meth, a pipe, and a lighter and already knows how to load a meth pipe. Long energy and alertness are offset by overheating, tremors, paranoia-like panic, dehydration, sleep debt, severe withdrawal, and high overdose risk.
UI_trait_Drugzz_PrescriptionDependentDes: Starts with Adderall and an established tolerance. Focus and energy improve temporarily, followed by appetite loss, anxiety, cottonmouth, poor rest, fatigue, and withdrawal.
UI_trait_Drugzz_PsychonautDesc: Experienced with mushrooms and LSD. Starts with one of each. Bad trips and nausea are less likely, but psychedelic effects last longer.
UI_trait_Drugzz_StonerDesc: A long-term cannabis habit. Starts with two joints and a lighter and knows how to grind flower and roll joints or blunts. Cannabis causes less panic, but you begin tolerant and dependent; withdrawal brings irritability, low mood, poor rest, and anxiety.
UI_trait_DruidDesc:
Driven by a deep biological connection to the earth, you know exactly when a crop is ready to yield the most food.

Foraging Bonuses:
+5%% chance to find crops.
UI_trait_DrummerDesc: You thought joining a band would be a great way to attract a mate.
UI_trait_DrunkenMasterDesc:
Survivor who uses intoxication to enhance combat.
However each undead defeated brings them closer to sobriety.
[+25%% DMG while being drunk]
UI_trait_EHR_PatientZeroDesc: Survived experimental gene therapy and became immune to the Knox infection.
UI_trait_EHR_ScalpelMasterDesc: Scalpels last dramatically longer and deal ninefold damage in trained surgical hands.
UI_trait_ESpearMasterdesc: Epic master in the art of the long spear. <LINE> +2 Spear
UI_trait_Elect1Desc: Has basic knowledge of electrical systems.
UI_trait_Elect2Desc:
Intermediate skill in electrical systems
Proficient in repairing complex circuits & electrical devices.
UI_trait_ElectronicsSpecialistDescDF: You are highly knowledgeable and experienced in electronics-based infiltration. <LINE> +3 Electrical and +2 Mechanic skills. <LINE> Start with learnt Electronics-related recipes. <LINE> Allows you to hotwire vehicles.
UI_trait_EmotionlessDescDF: The mission always comes first. Emotion only gets in the way. <LINE> You experience almost no emotion, however can experience outbursts.
UI_trait_EndlessSummerDesc:
Your biology thrives when the sun is scorching. You feel incredibly energized, resilient, and at your absolute peak during a prolonged, sweltering season.
From July through early October, Fatigue slowly fades and the thirst and exhaustion caused by overheating are greatly reduced.

Mutually exclusive with other seasonal traits.
UI_trait_EngineBuilderDesc:
Highly skilled mechanic.
Knows the maintenance & repair of all vehicle models.
UI_trait_EntertainersGuileDesc:
Your history of avoiding dangerous clients gives you an uncanny awareness of your surroundings. Furthermore, you've learned to push through sheer terror without letting it slow you down.
Panic clears {1}%% faster.
Foraging radius +3.
Grants the Keen Hearing trait for free.

Exclusive to the Bell Creek Entertainer occupation.
UI_trait_EternalHungerDesc:
Fresh kills feed something older than hunger. Raw game and other animal-derived food leave you riding a predatory high that builds with every mouthful.
Eating meat, fish, eggs or insects grants a stacking melee damage buff, up to stage 4. Each stage adds {1}%% damage. Every stage you gain adds {2} minutes plus a third of that food's hunger value on top of the time already left, banking up to {3} minutes. Eating once the stacks are maxed out does nothing.

Exclusive to the Feral Drifter occupation.
UI_trait_ExpertDriverDesc: Vehicles move faster, make less noise, and handle more efficiently.
UI_trait_FAM_SurgicalMasterydesc: Extensive surgical training. Can perform all advanced procedures — amputation, prosthetics, IV fluids, blood transfusion, epinephrine — without skill or protocol prerequisites. Grants Doctor +2 XP rate.
UI_trait_Farm2Desc:
Highly advanced understanding of crop cultivation
Knowledgeable in diverse crops & their specific needs for optimal growth.
UI_trait_Farm3Desc:
Advanced understanding of crop cultivation
Knowledgeable in diverse crops & their specific needs for optimal growth.
UI_trait_FashionmancerDesc:
Do you know what is most important in an apocalypse? style!
Start the game knowing all the clothing recipes from the Bianca Wardrobe Mod.
+1 Tailoring
UI_trait_FastEaterDesc: You waste no time eating. Food takes less time to consume.
UI_trait_FastWorkerDesc:
Take less time to get things done.
Perform timed actions faster.
UI_trait_FearfulDesc:
Audibly scared and likely to scream aloud when panicked.
Jumpscares and zombie attacks cause you to scream.
Can attempt to muffle screams by crouching.
UI_trait_FeralResilienceDesc:
Your nervous system suppresses pain to keep you moving during a fight or flight scenario. Injuries that would cripple a standard survivor are merely a nuisance to you.
Pain accumulates much slower and fades away faster, keeping severe pain and its combat penalties at bay.
UI_trait_FieldMedicDesc:
Veteran in emergency care, very experienced in diagnosing & treating injuries & illnesses.
Adept at using whatever's on hand to provide effective medical aid in the field.
UI_trait_Fishing2Desc:
Survivor with advanced fishing proficiency.
Adept at catching a variety of fish with specialized techniques & equipment.
UI_trait_FlabbyDesc: Your condition is bad, your fitness is reduced.
UI_trait_FlamingWreckageDesc: Start at the scene of a flaming wreck near your house, burned, broken, and bloody.
UI_trait_FlexTaperDesc: Knows how to create the ultimate Flex Tape.
UI_trait_FlimsyDesc: Your condition is bad, your strength is reduced.
UI_trait_Forage1Desc: Keen observer of the natural world.
UI_trait_Forage2Desc: Experienced in navigating diverse terrains and environments.
UI_trait_Forage3Desc:
Master of finding ressources in the wild
Posses highly advanced knowledge of flora & fauna, able to sustain themselves within the wilderness.
UI_trait_FortifiedPawpadDesc:
Fortified pawpads protect your feet from wounds and make stomps hit harder.
Foot wounds are prevented and stomping damage is multiplied by {1}x.
UI_trait_FragileDesc:
Become injured easier and take more damage than most.
Being over encumbered damages your health.
UI_trait_FrailDesc: Your condition is terrible, your strength is very reduced.
UI_trait_FrogFriendDesc: Welcomes a trusty frog friend into your company, providing companionship as you traverse the world.
UI_trait_FrostTrackerDesc:
You are completely in your element in the dead of winter. The stark, frozen landscape makes it incredibly easy for your tuned senses to spot disturbed snow and isolated prey.

+3 vision radius
+10%% chance to find crops, medicinal plants and wild plants during Winter (December-February).

Mutually exclusive with other seasonal traits.

UI_trait_FurnitureMakerDesc: All your furniture came in a flat box.

You delight in food of all kinds and enjoy cooking.
Food you cook cooks faster and takes longer to burn. Food you cook or prepare is more satisfying, and its temperature or preparation method does not bother you.

UI_trait_GroomingDependentStage3: I can't stand being this dirty!
UI_trait_GroomingDependentStage4: I desperately need to clean my fur!
UI_trait_GuardsmenDesc:
Hardened survivor.
Skilled in perimeter defending against both undead & living threats.
UI_trait_GunEnthusiastDesc: You enjoy handling firearms and go shooting at the range for fun

UI_trait_Gymnast2desc: Has skills in Nimble and Lightfooted.

UI_trait_HeatTolerantDesc: Stay cool more easy and cool down faster

Panic when performing first aid on self.

Gets stressed and unhappy when covered in blood.

Enjoys eating vegetables and plant-based food.
Plant-based food is {1}%% more effective at reducing hunger and unhappiness.
Meat, seafood, canned food, and miscellaneous food are {2}%% less effective.

+10%% chance to find berries, fruits, vegetables, crops, mushrooms, wild plants, and wild herbs.
