UI_trait_HibernationInstinctDesc:
As the days grow short and the temperature plummets, your metabolism crashes. Your body desperately wants to sleep through the cold, leaving you constantly lethargic.
During Winter (December-February), weight loss is slowed, you become Drowsy much earlier in the day, and you need significantly more sleep to fully rest.

Mutually exclusive with other seasonal traits.
UI_trait_HikerDesc2:
Experienced in hiking long distances.
Knows some trapping recipes.
(Slightly reduces accumulation of hunger, thirst and fatigue if walking for a while without stopping.)
UI_trait_HoarderDesc:
You have trouble throwing anything away and tend to carry a lot of stuff with you.
You can carry additional load per each point of Strength
UI_trait_Hoat_CouchPotatoDesc:
Always lazy and weak, this survivor has spent more time on the couch than anywhere else.
How they survived this long is anyone's guess.
UI_trait_HomeCookDesc: You enjoy making your own meals and bake the occasional cake
UI_trait_HomemakerDesc: You always said you wanted to get out of the house more.

UI_trait_HouseFireDesc: Start with a raging fire consuming your house. (Starts with a burn instead if fires are toggled off in sandbox.)
UI_trait_HousePetDesc:
Generations of comfortable indoor living have left your muscles soft and unaccustomed to grueling physical labor.

Mutually exclusive with Weak and Feeble.

When panic reaches its maximum level, you let out an involuntary vocalization that expands your sound radius and draws nearby zombies.
You yell, "Awoooo!"

UI_trait_HunterArcheryDesc: Knows Archery Basics and Crossbow Crafting recipes.
UI_trait_HyperMetabolismDesc:
Your body runs like a furnace, burning through calories to keep your energy up.
Hunger drains {1}%% faster and caloric loss is increased by 10%%.

Mutually exclusive with Hearty Appetite, Light Eater, and metabolism traits.
UI_trait_IdealWeightDesc: Your metabolism helps draw your weight toward a healthy range.
UI_trait_ImmunocompromisedDesc:
Your immune system is dangerously vulnerable.
Untreated wound infections worsen faster. Every new zombie injury may cause Knox infection, even when transmission is disabled.

Chance to trip on items, cracks, curbs, trash, and various other objects.

You are exceptionally difficult to kill.
Falling near death or having four zombies crowd within 1.5 tiles restores your health and endurance, removes fatigue, and knocks down zombies within 2.5 tiles. For two real-time minutes, pain and wound movement penalties are suppressed.
This does not close wounds or cure zombification.
UI_trait_IngenuitiveDesc:
Automatically know all recipes that would otherwise require a magazine or professional knowledge.
(This also includes recipes added by mods.)
UI_trait_IngenuitiveDesc_fun: You have a knack for figuring things out.

Comfortable carrying more than most, this survivor sees every additional load as training.
Increased maximum carrying capacity.
[27kg at max strength]
UI_trait_LightLoadLoverDesc:
This survivor finds happiness and stress relief when carrying a light load, preferring agility and freedom over heavy burdens.
[+Stress relief & happiness if under 30%% of the max carry capacity]
UI_trait_LightStepDesc: You are naturally light on your feet and make little sound moving
UI_trait_LightgunnerDesc: All those hours playing video games were not wasted after all.

Uncomfortable with carrying too much, this survivor shies away from excessive loads.
Reduced maximum carrying capacity.
[15kg at max strength]
UI_trait_LittleBuddyDesc:
This survivor is never without their beloved Spiffo doll, their closest companion in a harsh world.
Losing Spiffo would be the most awful thing that could happen to this survivor.
[Small boost to stress, boredom, and unhappiness when Spiffo is in inventory, but don't you dare lose Spiffo...You will regret it]
UI_trait_LoneWolfDesc:
You are naturally solitary and deeply protective of your personal space.
Stress and Unhappiness slowly build while another player is within 100 tiles.

Mutually exclusive with Pack Bond.
UI_trait_LordVampire_desc: A vampire who awakens true power: blood-fed combat bonuses, night vigor, and dark regeneration.
UI_trait_LowProfileDesc: You are a shady character and good at hiding
UI_trait_LumberingDesc:
Much slower turning speed.
Slower Nimble XP Gain.

In Love with MDMA.
Withdrawals at 3 (Medium), 6 (Bad), 10 (Mild) days.
If MDMA taken every 5 days, you can lose trait with no tier 2 withdrawals..

-Hunger, +Thirst, +Fatigue, -Endurance, +Stress, +Head Pain.

UI_trait_Maint2Desc: Knowledge of advanced equipment repairs & basic optimization.

UI_trait_MajorLimpDesc_fun: "Getting around was a struggle, although people would always help out... Be a shame if they weren't around anymore"
UI_trait_Mar_AcrophobicDesc:
Panic while near large drops of elevation, at great heights, or while climbing ropes.
Chance to refuse to jump through windows depending on height.
Slower rope climbing speed, and more chance of falling.
Less likely to land safely after falls.
UI_trait_Mar_AlcoholicDesc:
Unhappiness rises when having not drank.
Stress decreased after drinking.
UI_trait_Mar_AntiGunDesc:
Starting to use guns induces sadness and slight panic, but goes away over time.
50%% skill XP gain for guns.
UI_trait_Mar_BrokeLegDesc: Start the game with a fractured leg.
UI_trait_Mar_ButcherDesc: Higher minimum damage with short blunt and short blade weapons.
UI_trait_Mar_ColdIntolerantDesc: Get cold more easy and take longer to warm up.
UI_trait_Mar_ColdIntolerantDesc_fun: "You never left home without a jacket."
UI_trait_Mar_DefenseTacticsDesc: Better chance to successfully defend against zombie attacks.
UI_trait_Mar_DemomanDesc:
Better at destructions.
Faster and more efficient sledgehammer swing.
UI_trait_Mar_DepressiveDesc:
Sadness increases over time and sadness increases are exponentially worse.
Can be negated with medication.
UI_trait_Mar_ElectricalKnowledgeDesc:
+1 Electrical
Has knowledge with the creation and methods of many electronic devices.
Can Operate Generators
UI_trait_Mar_ElectricalKnowledge_copyDes:
Has knowledge with the creation and methods of many electronic devices.
Can Operate Generators
UI_trait_Mar_FastWorkerDesc:
Take less time to get things done.
Perform timed actions faster.
UI_trait_Mar_FearfulDesc:
Audibly scared and likely to scream aloud when panicked.
Jumpscares and zombie attacks cause you to scream.
Can attempt to muffle screams by crouching.
UI_trait_Mar_FragileDesc:
Become injured easier and take more damage than most.
Being over encumbered damages your health.
UI_trait_Mar_HeatIntolerantDesc: Get hot more easy and take longer to cool down
UI_trait_Mar_InattentiveDesc:
Prone to tripping on objects and to accidental injury when performing dangerous actions.
More prone to accidents while the mind is distracted.
Moving slowly reduces chances of tripping.
UI_trait_Mar_IngenuitiveDesc:
Automatically know all recipes that would otherwise require a magazine or professional knowledge.
(This also includes recipes added by mods.)
UI_trait_Mar_KeenDriverDesc: Vehicles move faster, make slightly less noise, and handle more efficiently.
UI_trait_Mar_LitheDesc:
Faster turning speed.
Slightly faster nimble XP gains.
UI_trait_Mar_LumberingDesc:
Much slower turning speed.
Slightly slower nimble XP gains.
UI_trait_Mar_MajorLimpDesc: Suffer from a permanent major limp.
UI_trait_Mar_MicrowaveSyndromeDesc:
Feel pain in the presence of electricity and immense pain using objects that emit it.
Unable to operate many electronic appliances.
UI_trait_Mar_MinorLimpDesc: Suffer from a permanent minor limp.
UI_trait_Mar_NoEmotionDesc: Do not experience states of sadness, happiness, or panic.
UI_trait_Mar_NyctophobicDesc_fun: "You never grew out of your nightlight."
UI_trait_Mar_PoorDriverDesc: Vehicles move slower, make slightly more noise, and handle less efficiently.
UI_trait_Mar_RushHourDesc: Enter cars, and move stuff around cars faster.
UI_trait_Mar_SlowWorkerDesc:
Take longer to get things done.
Perform timed actions slower.
UI_trait_Mar_SnorerDesc:
Snore when sleeping.
Snore louder when sick.
UI_trait_Mar_StrongBackDesc:
+2 carry weight.
Strength affects carry weight slightly more.
UI_trait_Mar_UnwaveringDesc:
Push away zombies faster.
Increased movement speed when limping.
UI_trait_Mar_WeakBackDesc:
-2 carry weight.
Strength affects carry weight slightly less.
UI_trait_Mar_WeldingKnowledgeDesc:
+1 Welding
Familiar with many methods and constructions of welding.
UI_trait_Mar_WeldingKnowledge_copyDesc: Familiar with many methods and constructions of welding.
UI_trait_MattedPeltDesc:
When any part of your fur becomes {1}%% covered in dirt or zombie blood, movement is restricted until you clean yourself.
Sprinting is disabled while matted.
UI_trait_MauledDesc: Mauled by an animal, start covered with several bites and a scratch.
UI_trait_Mechanics4Desc:
Specialist in automotive machinery.
Highly skilled in building & maintaining vehicle systems if provided reference material.
UI_trait_Medic2Desc:
Proficient in basic medical care
Skilled in treating injuries, illnesses, & first aid.
UI_trait_Medic3Desc:
Expert in comprehensive medical care.
Highly skilled in diagnosing & treating injuries, illnesses & conditions effectively.
UI_trait_MeikenkanteishiDesc:
A well versed in swords enough to identify legendary sword.
-When searching for a random container, You can find a special long blades with a low probability.
#This trait are affected by the "Lucky","Unlucky" Traits and can be adjusted with the sandbox option.
UI_trait_MelancholicDesc: Feelings of hopelessness are constant. Sad situations affect you more strongly.
UI_trait_Melee-maticianDesc:
Think fast, swing fast.
+25%% combat speed to all melee weapons
UI_trait_MenderDesc: With your redneck ingenuity, you can fix many things.
UI_trait_MenkyoDesc:
I've learned the quick eyes to read the flow of battle.
-1.7x Faster Spear swing.
-The trait change depending on the number of zombies killed and survived time.
#This traits and can be adjusted with the sandbox option.
UI_trait_MenkyokaidenDesc:
Learned martial arts under a particular school or has learned the logic of martial arts himself.
+1 Fitness
+1 Sterngth
+1 Nimble
-Battle Respiration : When using a specified weapons depending on the traits you have, It causes reduce endurance consumption.
-The trait given based on the number of zombies killed and survived time.
#This skill level and xp multiplier bonus for the trait is given only when you select the trait on the select occupation and traits screen.
UI_trait_Metal2Desc:
Advanced skill in metalworking.
Proficient in shaping, joining & repairing metal.
UI_trait_Metal3Desc:
Expert in metalworking techniques.
Highly skilled in forging & fabricating intricate metal structures using advanced welding methods.
UI_trait_MethHeaddesc:
Has a Meth addiction.
Withdrawals at 1 (Medium), 5 (Bad), 10 (Mild) days.
If Meth taken every 5 days, you can lose trait with no tier 2 withdrawals.
Will lose trait if no Meth is done for 18-20 days.
+Hunger, +Thirst, +Fatigue, -Endurance, +Stress, +Head Pain.
UI_trait_MicrowaveSyndromeDesc:
Feel pain in the presence of electricity and immense pain using objects that emit it.
Unable to operate many electronic appliances.
UI_trait_MilitarDesc: A soldier at the peak of their duty, giving their all.
UI_trait_MilitaryTrainingDesc: After years, you become the best of the best. <LINE> +3 Strength, +3 Fitness, +3 Running and +3 Survival skills.
UI_trait_MinorLimpDesc: Live with a permanent minor limp.
UI_trait_MinorLimpDesc_fun: "you'd always walk weird, but it's not like you needed to run that often... right?"
UI_trait_MokurokuDesc:
I know how to use shallow techniques.
-1.5x Faster Spear swing.
-The trait change depending on the number of zombies killed and survived time.
#This traits and can be adjusted with the sandbox option.
UI_trait_MundaneDesc:
Your weapon attacks never critically hit.
Other damage bonuses still apply normally.
UI_trait_MushroomGathererDesc:
Survivor with a keen eye for spotting fungi.
However, they lack knowledge of whether the mushrooms they find are edible or poisonous.
[+30%% foraging bonus to mushrooms]
UI_trait_NagaeDesc:
Martial arts... of all the thoughts in the world,
How many things can be described in words.
It's not logic. It's a feeling.
-Spears can be made from some materials.
-The probability of discovery of some materials increases when forage.
-Spears used reduce durability consumption.
-At the beginning, Proceed with a bag and a Spear.
-Pierce : Spears stab critical attack speed very faster.
UI_trait_NaturalEaterDesc:
You prefer natural foods over heavily preserved food.
Eating uncooked beans, berries, citrus, fruit, greens, mushrooms, nuts, or vegetables restores mental stats based on the portion's hunger value, up to 5%%.
UI_trait_NaturalStealthDesc:
Walking on your toes grants exceptional balance and silence.
Zombies are less likely to spot you and your footstep noise is reduced by 40%%.

Mutually exclusive with Graceful, Inconspicuous, and Conspicuous.
UI_trait_NervesOfSteelDescDF: Years of combat experience has acclimatised you to the chaos of warfare, proving your nerves of steel. <LINE> Stress decreases passively over time.
UI_trait_NervousWreckDesc: You are anxious by nature. Stressful situations affect you more strongly.
UI_trait_NestWeaverDesc:
Your instinct to construct tight, heavily insulated dens translates perfectly to reinforcing garments. You possess a natural talent for layering and binding materials to maximize warmth and physical protection.

Skill Bonuses:
UI_trait_NightHunter_desc: Absolute predator of the night; by day, a weaker shadow.
UI_trait_NightThirst_desc: The night awakens a stronger thirst, but feeding restores more.
UI_trait_NightmaresDesc: You suffer nightmares more often than others.
UI_trait_NocturnalHunterDesc:
You thrive in the dark and your eyes adjust quickly to gloom.
Night vision is improved and fatigue builds {1}%% slower at night, but {2}%% faster during the day.

Mutually exclusive with Cat's Eyes.
UI_trait_NoodleLegsDesc:
You may trip while running or sprinting.
The chance decreases with your Sprinting and Nimble levels.
UI_trait_NudistDesc:
Prefers the freedom of no clothing. Increases happiness when unclothed but causes discomfort when wearing clothes.
[Backpacks, shoes, watches, and all "Accessory" type items do not count as clothing]
UI_trait_Numb_Desc: Panic, stress, unhappiness, boredom, and discomfort are fully suppressed.
UI_trait_NyctophobicDesc_fun: "You never grew out of your nightlight."
UI_trait_OhBerserkerDesc: [Witness Me!] ~  By the axe you shall vanquish, by the axe you shall return to Valhalla <LINE><CENTRE> | (Massive Boosts to Dualwielding Axes. Unlocks a special passive ability while wielding 2 Axes! Press Q to activate!) | </CENTER> <LINE><LINE>(Naturally gained at Axes lvl 5 & Ambidextrous lvl 5)
UI_trait_OhBigIronDesc: [Big iron on his hip!] ~ And the notches on his pistol numbered one & nineteen more <LINE><CENTRE> | (Massive boosts to using Revolvers (vanilla only)) | <LINE><LINE> (Unlocked at Ambitextrous lvl 5, Aiming lvl 3)
UI_trait_OhBoxerDesc: [That's how winning is done!] ~ you're gonna eat lightning and crap thunder! <LINE><CENTRE> | (Massive boosts to Punching!! Unlocks a new Passive Ability!) | <LINE><LINE> (Naturally gained at Strength lvl 7, Nimble lvl 5, Ambidextrous Lvl 5)
UI_trait_OhHammerTimeDesc: [Stop! Hammer time!] ~ talkin' about the Hammer, talkin' about the Show. Work hard or ya might as well quit! <LINE><CENTRE> | (Massive Boosts to Dualwielding Short-Blunts!) | <LINE><LINE> (Naturally gained at Short-Blunt lvl 5, Ambidextrous lvl 3)
UI_trait_OhKenjutsuDesc: [You live by the Blade] ~ Niten ichi no michi ~ Strategy is the craft of the warrior <LINE><CENTRE> | (Grants bonus damage, attack-speed, and reduced endurance from Dualwielding Katanas. Unlocks a special ability for Katanas. 30 second cooldown) | </CENTER> <LINE><LINE>(Naturally unlocked at Longblade lvl 5 & Ambidextrous lvl 5)
UI_trait_OhMudaDesc: [Is that a fck'ng JoJo reference?!!] ~ Rare easter-egg trait! Press 'Z' on a zombie to unleash the 7-page MUDA! <LINE><CENTRE> | (Grants special Unarmed ability. 15 second cooldown) | </CENTER>
UI_trait_OhStabbyDesc: [Stabby Stabby!] ~ that's not a knife. THIS is a knife! <LINE><CENTRE> | (Massive boosts to Dualwielding Short-Blades!) | <LINE><LINE> (Naturally gained at Short-Blade lvl 5, Ambidextrous Lvl 3)
UI_trait_OhTerminatorDesc: [I'll be back!] ~ Guns, guns, guns! <LINE><CENTRE> | (Massive Boosts to Dualwielding Guns. Can now Dualwield Shotguns & Two-Handed Guns!!) | </CENTER> <LINE><LINE>(Naturally gained at Aiming Lvl 6 & Ambidextrous lvl 8)
UI_trait_OhTimelessDesc: [ZA WARUDO!] ~ FREEZE! During the Dualwielding attack animation; zeds in front of the player will be temporarily frozen in place <LINE><CENTRE> | (Grants special Passive ability. Triggered on Dualwielding attack animation) | </CENTER>
UI_trait_OlympianDesc: You are, or once were, an Olympic competitor whose fitness and speed reflect years of training.
UI_trait_OnYourToesdesc:
Light on your feet. Boosts your Nimble skill by 1.

(Only overhauls your pivoting if the trait toggle is enabled in this mod's sandbox settings. If it's disabled, pivoting is global for everyone and this trait is just a +1 Nimble add-on.)
UI_trait_OneHandedDesc: All your life, you've refused to use your left hand for any tasks. It is much more difficult to learn Ambidextrous skills! <LINE><LINE><CENTRE> (significantly reduced exp gains in Ambidextrous. massively reduced attack-speed in Offhand) <LINE> (Lost at Ambidextrous lvl 4)
UI_trait_OpioidAddictdesc:
Has an Opioid Dependence.
Withdrawals at 1 (Medium), 5 (Bad), 10 (Mild) days.
If Opioid taken every 5 days, you can lose trait with no tier 2 withdrawals.
Will lose trait if no Opioids are done for 18-20 days.
+Fatigue, -Endurance, +Stress, +Head Pain.
UI_trait_OriginBrandenburgDesc: Brandenburg is revealed on your map, and stress builds 10%% more slowly while you are there. Carpentry XP +10%%.
UI_trait_OriginDixieDesc: Dixie is revealed on your map, and stress builds 10%% more slowly while you are there. Cooking XP +10%%.
UI_trait_OriginEchoCreekDesc: Echo Creek is revealed on your map, and stress builds 10%% more slowly while you are there. Reloading XP +10%%.
UI_trait_OriginEkronDesc: Ekron is revealed on your map, and stress builds 10%% more slowly while you are there. Blacksmithing XP +10%%.
UI_trait_OriginFallasLakeDesc: Fallas Lake is revealed on your map, and stress builds 10%% more slowly while you are there. Aiming XP +10%%.
UI_trait_OriginIrvingtonDesc: Irvington is revealed on your map, and stress builds 10%% more slowly while you are there. Agriculture XP +10%%.
UI_trait_OriginLouisvilleDesc: Louisville is revealed on your map, and stress builds 10%% more slowly while you are there. Sprinting XP +10%%.
UI_trait_OriginMuldraughDesc: Muldraugh is revealed on your map, and stress builds 10%% more slowly while you are there. Mechanics XP +10%%.
UI_trait_OriginRiversideDesc: Riverside is revealed on your map, and stress builds 10%% more slowly while you are there. Fishing XP +10%%.
UI_trait_OriginRosewoodDesc: Rosewood is revealed on your map, and stress builds 10%% more slowly while you are there. Unhappiness builds 12.5%% more slowly.
UI_trait_OriginWestPointDesc: West Point is revealed on your map, and stress builds 10%% more slowly while you are there. Foraging XP +10%%.
UI_trait_PA_Bioscience_desc:
Rironn showed an interest in medicine and various plants from an early age and successfully obtained a Life Science Expert certification. 
She joined the Life Science Department of WESTTECH® Corporation at a very young age.
UI_trait_PA_CombatMaid_desc: As the personal maid of a Miss High, you must not only be ready to serve her at all times in daily life, but also stand up when her life is in danger.
UI_trait_PA_HomeMaid_desc: As a maid serving a noble family, mastering household duties is always the first priority.
UI_trait_PA_KaeriStart_desc: At the start of the game, you will receive essential items related to the {Maid and Master} scenario.
UI_trait_PA_Kaeri_desc:
In reality, Kaeri is not yet old enough to live independently. 
However, in this cruel world, she still has many things she must accomplish.
UI_trait_PA_LiliesStart_desc: At the start of the game, you will receive essential items related to the {The Glorious Finale} scenario.
UI_trait_PA_Modified_desc:
WESTTECH® Corporation has repaired all defects in your Moelotl genes. 
You no longer need to stay submerged in water forever, your skin is as smooth and dry as a human's, your face can charm everyone who sees you, your intelligence is now comparable to that of humans, and so on.
Rather than saying you are a Moelotl, it would be more accurate to say that you are a human with a Moelotl appearance.
UI_trait_PA_MoelotlStart_desc: At the start of the game, you will receive essential items related to the {Past and Future} scenario.
UI_trait_PA_Moelotl_desc:
You were once a member of the Moelotl race, whose home planet suffered a devastating attack by the mechanical race. 
However, you were rescued and raised by a Corrector from WESTTECH® Corporation.
UI_trait_PA_Ojousan1_desc:
Maid and workers usually address you as 'Miss High'. 
Under their care, you have lived a pampered life where everything is provided for you.
UI_trait_PA_Ojousan2_desc:
Your father often secretly trained you in the use of firearms. 
He said that one day you would need these skills. It seems that day has finally arrived.
UI_trait_PA_Ojousan3_desc:
Your father and mother provided you with elite education from a young age. 
As a result, you possess many practical life skills.
UI_trait_PA_Reaper_desc:
Your duty and mission are to guide the souls of the dead. 
However, for those walking corpses wandering the streets, you cannot determine whether these 'things' that transcend the laws of death should be under your jurisdiction.
UI_trait_PA_RironnStart_desc: At the start of the game, you will receive essential items related to the {The Chairman's Redemption} scenario.
UI_trait_PA_Rironn_desc:
A common genetic disease in the Glitter World. 
Patients suffer from a series of symptoms caused by abnormal cellular metabolism and division. 
Type III is the most severe stage of this disease, causing symptoms such as fatigue, weakened immunity, fragile bones, abnormal blood coagulation, and many others. The body is on the verge of collapse.
UI_trait_PA_SelfHealing_desc:
Your body still retains the rapid wound-healing ability shared by other Moelotl. 
However, the nanomedical machines inside your body assist you in achieving this process.
(Players with this trait heal wounds extremely quickly. However, health regeneration speed remains unchanged, and you are still susceptible to the Nox Virus.)
UI_trait_PA_TinaStart: {A Journey Home from Another World}Starting Items
UI_trait_PA_TinaStart_desc: At the start of the game, you will receive essential items related to the {A Journey Home from Another World} scenario.
UI_trait_PA_Tina_desc: You often call yourself the 'Koi no Yousei'. You always prefer idling around and staying at home, and you completely neglect the work that a Reaper should do.
UI_trait_PA_Training1_desc: Basic physical conditioning and combat training provided by WESTTECH® Corporation to all employees.
UI_trait_PA_Training2_desc: Advanced physical conditioning and combat training provided by WESTTECH® Corporation to combat specialists, including additional close-quarters combat and medical training.
UI_trait_PA_Traveler_desc:
You do not seem to belong to this world. 
However, thanks to Lilies's father, the chaotic overlap of time and space brought you here.
Before causing even greater chaos, you must stop the implementation of the Project Anime!
UI_trait_PacifistDesc2:
Decreases combat XP gains.
(-25%% XP for all weapon skills, Maintenance skill and Aiming skill.)
UI_trait_PackBondDesc:
You are a highly social creature that thrives in the company of other survivors. The mere presence of your pack brings you a deep sense of security and contentment.
Stress, Unhappiness, and Boredom slowly fade while another player is within 100 tiles.

Mutually exclusive with Lone Wolf.
UI_trait_PackHealerDesc:
Driven by a deep biological urge to keep your den-mates alive, you are adept at finding useful materials and quickly patching bleeding wounds.
You know all medicinal herb recipes.

Foraging Bonuses:
+5%% chance to find medicinal herbs.

Mutually exclusive with Herbalist.
UI_trait_PackMouseDesc: You always travel light. Your maximum carrying capacity is reduced.
UI_trait_PackMuleDesc:
You know how to pack everything you need.
Your maximum carrying capacity is increased by 20%%.
UI_trait_PainToleranceDesc: You are resistant to pain, your pain level never go above specific percentage (60%% by default)
UI_trait_PaniqeurDesc:
Extreme situations make you swing weapons faster.
Up to +25%% attack speed increase bazed on the amount of close and chasing zombies
Up to +12.5%% with attack speed boosting traits like Axeman
Doesn't affect Heavy weapons
UI_trait_PantingActivate: Panting helps you catch your breath.
UI_trait_PantingDesc:
You recover your breath rapidly through panting, but it dries you out quickly.
Sitting on the ground restores endurance {1}%% faster, but greatly increases thirst while resting.

Activation messages will appear overhead.
UI_trait_ParanoiaDesc:
While moving, you may suffer a false zombie scare that sharply increases panic and stress and may cause you to scream, attracting nearby zombies.
Higher stress makes attacks more likely. After an attack, there is a cooldown before another can occur.
UI_trait_ParanoidUserdesc:
Drugs give a panic attack for entire duration of effect.
CAN'T lose trait.
UI_trait_ParcopresisDesc: Defecation is difficult when near zombies or players.
UI_trait_PartCherokeeDesc: You're part Cherokee. Or at least, that's what your Grandma said.
UI_trait_ParuresisDesc: Urination is difficult when near zombies or players.
UI_trait_PeacefulDesc:
Each zombie kill brings a wave of unease, making you unhappier & more stressed.
What if there are alive and just trapped inside their minds?
UI_trait_PescatarianDesc: Save on groceries by eating the food on the ground and in the pond.
UI_trait_PetPersonDesc: You adore animals and are familiar with their care.
UI_trait_PetTherapyDesc:
You have always loved pets more than people. Petting animals gives you mood boost: reduces panic, boredom, unhappiness and stress.
By deafult, can only occur once every 5 min and gives 5%% mood boost. Adjustable in sandbox.
UI_trait_PhysicallyActiveDesc: Energetic person. Spending energy makes you feel good.
UI_trait_PillsAllergyDesc: Taking pills is not good for you. Perhaps the books are friendlier.
UI_trait_PluviophileDesc: You love the rain. Your mood improves by being under it.
UI_trait_PluviophobiaDesc: You hate the rain. Your mood worsens by being under it.
UI_trait_PodShofedesc:
A few drinks deep and never quite sober. Lowers your Nimble skill by 1.

(Only overhauls your pivoting if the trait toggle is enabled in this mod's sandbox settings. If it's disabled, pivoting is global for everyone and this trait is just a -1 Nimble add-on.)
UI_trait_PolearmFighterDesc: You've mastered the art of fighting with long, pole-like weapons. From pitchforks to spears, you know how to keep threats at bay with reach and precision
UI_trait_PoorDriverDesc: Vehicles move more slowly, make more noise, and handle less efficiently.
UI_trait_PoorPassengerDesc: Gets motion sickness in a moving vehicle.
UI_trait_PotHeaddesc:
Loves the Weeeeed, but lower Fitness levels.
Will lose trait if no Weed is done for 18-20 days.
UI_trait_PracticedSwordsmanDesc: You never thought all that swordplay would have practical use.
UI_trait_PreWinterRavenousDesc:
Your metabolism kicks into overdrive as the leaves fall, demanding an immense amount of calories to build up insulating fat before the snow hits.
During Autumn (September-November), Hunger depletes twice as fast.

Mutually exclusive with other seasonal traits.
UI_trait_PredatorsFinesseDesc:
You rely on quick, surgical strikes and meticulous tool care rather than brute force.
Weapons last longer and close-quarters slashing comes naturally.
UI_trait_PreyInstinctDesc:
Your instincts are wired for flight, not fight.
Panic rises faster when multiple zombies are nearby. Severe panic provides a {1}%% sprint-speed boost.

Mutually exclusive with Adrenaline Junkie and Primal Instinct.
UI_trait_PrimalApothecaryDesc:
Your refined medical expertise has regressed into something far more ancient and instinctual. You understand exactly how to mix wild, potentially toxic flora with standard medical supplies to create incredibly potent treatments.
You know a set of recipes for Feral Poultices, ground from foraged plants, poisonous berries and animal fat. Apply one to an injury from the health panel and it cures standard wound infection outright and cuts {1}%% off the remaining healing time of deep wounds and fractures. A poultice goes under a dressing, so the wound can still be bandaged.
All First Aid actions are {2}%% faster.
Bloodroot Tuber, Carrion Moss and Boneknit Fungus can be foraged in the wild.
You start with a mortar and pestle, a tub of lard and three of each reagent.

Exclusive to the Witch Doctor occupation.
UI_trait_PrimalInstinctDesc:
When panic reaches stage 3, instinct replaces hesitation.
Melee damage is increased by {1}%% and push/shove knockdown chance by 20%%.

Mutually exclusive with Adrenaline Junkie and Prey Instinct.
UI_trait_ProdigyDesc: You train Strength and Fitness faster than other people.
UI_trait_ProwessBladeDesc:
Bladed weapons deal 20%% more damage and degrade more slowly.
Your Small Blade, Long Blade, and Axe levels increase their critical chance.
UI_trait_ProwessBluntDesc:
Blunt weapons deal 20%% more damage and degrade more slowly.
Your Short Blunt and Long Blunt levels increase their critical chance.
UI_trait_ProwessSpearDesc:
Spears deal 20%% more damage and degrade more slowly.
Your Spear level increases their critical chance.
UI_trait_ProwlerDesc: An introvert must develop certain skills to remain at peace.
UI_trait_QuickRestDesc: You recover endurance faster while sitting on the ground or resting on furniture.
UI_trait_QuietDesc: You used to startle your friends and co-workers. Now that innate stealth is paying off.
UI_trait_RMHypochondriacDesc: Nine times out of ten, you will misdiagnose illnesses. <LINE> You can get lucky. You usually will not.
UI_trait_RMPharmacologyDesc: You are trained in medicine and know which treatments correspond to which illnesses. <LINE> There's nothing for you to learn about that.
UI_trait_RRRailroader_Desc:
Qualified on any locomotive without reading its manual.
A cold diesel catches more often, and a start that misses costs half the battery.
UI_trait_RSpearMasterdesc: Rare master in the art of the long spear. <LINE> +1 Spear
UI_trait_RVOwnerDesc: Turns out you already own an RV and you're using it to get away!
UI_trait_RancherDesc:
Knows the rhythm of life and death on the farm.
Proficient in tending livestock and processing them for essential supplies in harsh times.
UI_trait_Reload2Desc:
Experienced survivor in firearm reloading.
Proficient at quicker & smoother reloads under pressure.
UI_trait_Reload3Desc:
Highly proficient in firearm reloading.
Executes lightning-fast reloads, minimizing downtime in combat.
UI_trait_RenaissanceCelebrantDesc: You love the Renaissance Faire so much that you refuse to break character.
UI_trait_RenshiDesc:
I finally have the power to fight in a situation where I have to fight.
-1.5x Faster long blade swing.
-The trait change depending on the number of zombies killed and survived time.
#This traits and can be adjusted with the sandbox option.
UI_trait_RestorationExpertDesc: You know how to restore old items to pristine condition. You have a chance to not gain penalties for multiple repairs
UI_trait_RightDomDesc: You're right-hand dominant like most people. You may struggle using your left hand for most tasks. <LINE><CENTRE> (This trait is added by default. Remove it to access more Ambidextrous traits!) </CENTER> <LINE><LINE><CENTRE> (slightly reduced exp gains in Ambidextrous. slower attack-speed with Offhand) <LINE> (Lost at Ambidextrous lvl 3)
UI_trait_RomanhaDesc:
You don't understand me.
I've been dead for many years.
Today is the day I live.
-At the beginning, Proceed with a long blade.
UI_trait_RoughClawsDesc:

UI_trait_WellFittedDesc: Worn clothing weighs less and imposes reduced running- and combat-speed penalties.
UI_trait_WildPlantsAllergyDesc: Wild plants generate allergies, some more, some less. Better to avoid them.
UI_trait_WildScavengerDesc:
An excellent forager with an uncanny knack for spotting what others miss.
Foraged finds have a chance to yield double items. The chance equals your combined Foraging, Tracking, Trapping, and Sneaking levels (as %%), with diminishing returns above 25%%.

Skill Bonuses:
UI_trait_WildernessGourmetDesc:
You do not need a modern kitchen or complex spices to create a satisfying meal. The simple act of roasting meat and roots over an open flame is deeply comforting.
Eating cooked meals prepared without modern appliances (anything but a microwave) grants a bonus to Happiness and reduces Boredom.

Skill Bonuses:
UI_trait_WineLoverDesc:
Treasures a rare find: a fine bottle of wine & a delicate wine glass.
A really rare commodity in the apocalypse.
UI_trait_Wood2Desc:
Advanced carpentry knowledge.
Proficient in building sturdy structures & furniture.
UI_trait_Wood3Desc:
Expert in carpentry
Adept at repurposing salvaged materials to create durable constructions.
UI_trait_WoundPickerDesc:
Driven by an anxious, animalistic habit, you cannot leave your injuries alone. You constantly scratch at dressings and aggravate healing tissue.
Bandages become dirty twice as fast, and scratches and lacerations take slightly longer to heal.

Mutually exclusive with Curative Saliva.
UI_trait_YarijouzuDesc:
The title given to a person who has mastered ordinary spearsmanship.
+1 Spear
-The trait change depending on the number of zombies killed.
UI_trait_YarimeijinDesc:
The title given to a person who has the ability to perform martial arts across the country through spearsmanship.
+1 Spear
-The trait change depending on the number of zombies killed.
UI_trait_YaritatsujinDesc:
The title given only to the strong who have spearsmanship equivalent to or higher than that of a hero, Which means the path of martial arts.
+1 Spear
-Spears used reduce endurance consumption with "Mastery of Martial Arts" Trait
-The trait change depending on the number of zombies killed.
UI_trait_YaritenkaichiDesc:
The title given only to those whose spearsmanship have reached the realm of god, Creating a boundary of the spear around themselves.
+1 Spear
-Spears used reduce endurance consumption with "Mastery of Martial Arts" Trait
-The trait change depending on the number of zombies killed and traits owned.
UI_trait_YumiAnimalInstinctsDesc: Better awareness, survival instincts, and panic recovery.
UI_trait_YumiBorntoRunDesc: Massive sprinting talent with faster hunger, thirst, and endurance drain.
UI_trait_YumiCarnivoreDesc: You crave meat, fish, and eggs. Eating fruits, vegetables, or mushrooms makes you unhappy, bored, and can hurt your health.
UI_trait_YumiColdBloodedDesc: You struggle in cold weather but handle heat better.
UI_trait_YumiDigitigradeLegsDesc: Better sprinting and nimble movement, but higher endurance drain.
UI_trait_YumiFireResistantScalesDesc: Reduced fire and burn danger, but you are not immune to fire.
UI_trait_YumiHerbivoreDesc: You crave fruits, vegetables, and mushrooms. Eating meat, fish, or eggs makes you unhappy, bored, and can hurt your health.
UI_trait_YumiHornedPowerDesc: Heavy horns and raw force improve shove power, blunt fighting, and combat confidence.
UI_trait_YumiLoneBeastDesc: Better alone, worse around groups of survivors.
UI_trait_YumiNightEyesDesc: Your eyes are naturally adapted to darkness, making it easier to see and move at night.
UI_trait_YumiPackBondedDesc: Less stress and panic near allies, but worse when alone.
UI_trait_YumiPowerfulBiteDesc: A strong reptile or predator bite instinct improves close-combat survival.
UI_trait_YumiPowerfulJawsDesc: Predator-style survival trait with stronger close-combat instincts.
UI_trait_YumiPredatorsAppetiteDesc: Your body burns through food and water much faster, but your constant eating has made you naturally stronger.
UI_trait_YumiPreyReflexesDesc: Faster movement and reaction, but panic rises easier.
UI_trait_YumiPrimalFearResponseDesc: Panic rises faster, but it fits prey-animal survival instincts.
UI_trait_YumiReptileStomachDesc: Less likely to get sick from questionable animal protein, but this does not protect you from the Knox Infection.
UI_trait_YumiScaledSkinDesc: Tougher scaled skin gives a little extra survival toughness, but it is not armor.
UI_trait_YumiSensitiveTailDesc: More pain and stress when injured.
UI_trait_YumiSharpSensesDesc: Better foraging, tracking, and general awareness.
UI_trait_YumiSmallGameEaterDesc: You are built for eating small game, fish, eggs, and lean animal protein.
UI_trait_YumiSunBaskingDesc: Warm daylight calms you and helps you recover fatigue slightly while outdoors.
UI_trait_YumiTailBalanceDesc: Better balance, nimble movement, and lightfoot movement.
UI_trait_YumiTerritorialDesc: Less stress and panic around your base or familiar safehouse areas.
UI_trait_YumiThickFurDesc: Better cold resistance, but worse heat tolerance.
UI_trait_YumiThinFurDesc: Better heat tolerance, but worse cold resistance.
UI_trait_YumiWildAppetiteDesc: Hunger drains faster and you need more food.
UI_trait_YumiWildResilienceDesc: Your anthro biology is naturally tougher against normal sickness, but this does not protect you from the Knox Infection.
UI_trait_ZTCHardenedDesc:
Less prone to reaching maximum panic.
Improves by killing zombies.
UI_trait_ZephyrHTDesc: You move like a gentle breeze.
UI_trait_accmetabolismdesc:
Trains Strength and Fitness faster if not hungry.
Prone to maintain ideal weight.
(+30%% Strength and Fitness XP if hunger level not higher than Peckish,
-30%% calorie burn if weight is less than 76,
+30%% calorie burn if weight is over than 84.)
UI_trait_actionherodesc:
You live for the thick of the fight.
You deal only half as much normal damage, but you deal extra damage and have more critical chance the more enemies there are around you.
Your damage and critical chance scale based on number and distance of zombies around you.
UI_trait_adrenalrecoverydesc: The longer you stay in combat, the faster your body recovers endurance and fights off fatigue.
UI_trait_advancedforagingdesc: Significantly increases the chances of finding specific items in Search Mode depending on your occupation.
UI_trait_aggressivedesc:
After all that fighting, you've developed a deep hatred for zombies. You kill them FASTER.
+3 Combat Mastery
UI_trait_albinodesc:
You've always had extreme sunlight sensitivity.
While outside and in daylight, you experience progressive head pain.
Hold an umbrella to reduce pain.
UI_trait_alcoholicdesc:
Has an alcohol addiction.
Abstaining from alcohol increases boredom, unhappiness, and thirst.
Prolonged abstinence increases fatigue, stress, headache, and nausea.
Alcohol's effect on drowsiness is reduced.
UI_trait_allergicdesc:
Sneezes involuntarily, attracting unwanted attention.
(Sneezes can be muffled with a tissue, handkerchief, or toilet paper.)
UI_trait_amnesiadesc: Your past is missing, making survival harder to understand at first.
UI_trait_amputee_missingarm: I'm missing the arm for that...
UI_trait_amputeedesc:
One of your arms was amputated a long time ago.
You can not equip anything to your secondary, nor utilize your secondary arm for anything.
Your left arm can not be injured, and wounds that would otherwise be placed there are simply ignored.
UI_trait_anemicdesc: You bleed much more rapidly from wounds.
UI_trait_antigundesc:
You protest against guns and have no experience with them, making you worse at using them than others.
You take longer to aim, can not shoot far and become sad while using guns.
You receive 25%% less aiming XP.
UI_trait_antiquedesc:
You know how to recognize an antique item when you see it.
You have a rare chance to find unique variants of items while searching industrial containers.
+1 Scavenging if Scavenging Skill mod enabled
UI_trait_archerdesc:
Start with a bow and arrows.
+2 Archery
UI_trait_armorHistorianDesc:
You're familiar with rudimentary blacksmithing technique.
You know how to smith some simple medieval armor.
UI_trait_artisticdesc: Naturally gifted artists, they strongly benefit from <SPACE><RGB:1,0.8,0> Art <RGB:1,1,1><SPACE> related hobbies, they can also make for pretty good writers.
UI_trait_asceticdesc:
You prefer to abstain from the unnecessary pleasures of the body and find spiritual fulfillment in simple things.
You dislike cooked food.
Pre-Packaged foods give no mood boost.
Uncooked Meals are neutral.
Very high chance to burn meals.
UI_trait_autopsyespecialistDesc:
Years of study have finally paid off

+40%% Autopsy Speed
+20%% Autopsy XP
+Improves Blood Collection on the Morgue Table
UI_trait_badbackdesc: Heavy loads punish your back quickly, draining endurance and causing pain.
UI_trait_badkneesdesc: Running, crouching, and hauling weight all remind you that your joints have history.
UI_trait_badmemoryDesc: Receive less XP as you regain your memories.
UI_trait_badteethdesc:
You never took much care of your dental health.
When consuming food, you may experience pain. Larger portions cause more pain.
UI_trait_barricadeddesc:
Has followed the government's self-quarantine instructions.
Spawns in a barricaded house.
UI_trait_batteringramdesc:
You know how to force your way through crowds like a professional football player.
While Sprinting (not running), you knockdown zombies in your path.
Every zombie you knockdown depletes some endurance depending upon your Fitness level, so be careful charging into large crowds, as this may leave you exhausted.
Note: This trait overrides the Spear's charge ability.
UI_trait_battlefrenzydesc: While actively fighting, your melee strikes and firearm hits bite harder.
UI_trait_beachdesc: This person has a preference for beach music.
UI_trait_beachnodesc: This person would prefer to hear anything but beach music.
UI_trait_biozarddesc: You are more prepared to handle infection risks and contaminated environments.
UI_trait_bladetoolsdesc: Gains +20%% XP when using Axes, Short Blades, or Long Blades with the main hand.
UI_trait_bladetwirldesc: You never thought all that swordplay would have practical use.
UI_trait_blissfuldesc:
You have a positive outlook at all times.
You regain happiness at an increased rate.
Boredom is reduced at an increased rate.
UI_trait_bloodlust_desc: Uncontrollable desire to kill and an unhealthy obsession with bloodiness.
UI_trait_bloodmomentumdesc: Each confirmed zombie kill hardens your rhythm. The more you have killed, the more damage you deal, up to a limit.
UI_trait_bloodshydesc: Killing and blood unsettle you, turning violence into stress instead of relief.
UI_trait_bloodthirstdesc: Killing zombies calms you and feeds a short burst of violence. Going too long without a kill makes you restless.
UI_trait_blunttwirldesc: Sure, you've capped a few knees in your time. That experience could prove useful.
UI_trait_bouncerdesc:
You've roughed people up now and again.
Whenever you are surrounded by two or more zombies,
you will automatically attempt to push them away.
UI_trait_breakintechniquedesc: Axes deals more damage to doors and barricades.
UI_trait_breathingTechniqueDesc:
Survivor who has mastered a special breathing technique, allowing them to recover from exhaustion faster while sitting on the ground.
[+25%% endurance recovery bonus while sitting]
UI_trait_breathingtechdesc:
Increases endurance recovery while not moving.
(More effective while sitting.)
UI_trait_breathingtechniquedesc:
Increases endurance recovery while not moving.
(More effective while sitting.)
UI_trait_brokedesc:
Ouch! You start with a broken leg, a severely debilitating injury.
Note: Your leg will be splinted.
UI_trait_brokenlegdesc: You start with a fractured leg. Surviving the first days will require patience, shelter, and a splint.
UI_trait_burneddesc:
You had a traumatic experience with fire that affected you both physically and mentally.
You start out covered in bandaged burns on every part of your body.
Observing fire gives you panic and anxiety, this effect scales based on the distance between you and the fire.
Prevents you from throwing fire bombs, molotov cocktails and starting any kind of fire.
UI_trait_butterfingersdesc:
You may sometimes drop something you are holding.
Chance is based on carry weight and other traits such as luck or dextrous.
UI_trait_calmmindeddesc:
Remains calm in stressful situations.
(Maximum stress cannot exceed 50%%,
Stress and panic decrease faster.)
UI_trait_cannibalistDesc: You've been eating too much inappropriate protein.
UI_trait_charmingDesc: Higher chance that people will forgive your trespassees.
UI_trait_classicaldesc: This person has a preference for classical music.
UI_trait_classicalnodesc: This person would prefer to hear anything but classical music.
UI_trait_claustrophobicsurvivordesc: Long stretches indoors make your breathing tighten and your panic rise.
UI_trait_cleanfreakdesc:
They find solace in cleanliness and feel a compulsive need to live in a spotless environment.

Almost no tolerance for dirty environments.
Cleaning takes longer to perform.
UI_trait_cleanwaterdesc: You know how to think about sanitation, contamination, and safe water handling.
UI_trait_clinicalmethoddesc: You approach injuries, equipment, and contamination with careful technical discipline.
UI_trait_cocainedependentdesc:
Stress and unhappiness rise when cocaine is not used.
Stress and unhappiness decrease after using cocaine.
UI_trait_coldnervesdesc: Combat pressure has less hold over you, keeping panic and stress lower when things turn violent.
UI_trait_combatMasterdesc:
Everyone fears you, as you are a killing machine.
+5 Combat Mastery
UI_trait_combatconditioningdesc: When combat starts, your body settles into the work and preserves endurance under pressure.
UI_trait_commdriverdesc:
Reduces fatigue gain when driving a moving vehicle.
Able to repair heavy vehicles.
UI_trait_commercialdriverdesc:
Reduces fatigue gain when driving a moving vehicle.
Able to repair heavy vehicles.
UI_trait_contaminationdrilldesc: You know the routine: mask, gloves, clean hands, steady breathing. Contamination scares you less.
UI_trait_couchpotatodesc:
They prefer to stay home and indulge in comfort.

Gets tired faster and sleeps more often.
Enjoys passive entertainment.
Slower boredom buildup while indoors.
Hates Meditation and being outside.
UI_trait_countrydesc: This person has a preference for country music.
UI_trait_countrynodesc: This person would prefer to hear anything but country music.
UI_trait_coverttrainingdesc: You settle into quiet movement quickly and recover your nerve while sneaking.
UI_trait_crisiscookdesc: You can turn short supplies, questionable ingredients, and rough harvests into meals.
UI_trait_cropsciencedesc: You understand soil, crops, pests, and how to turn land into long-term food security.
UI_trait_crueltydesc:
Increases combat XP gains.
(+25%% XP for all weapon skills, Maintenance skill and Aiming skill.)
UI_trait_crybabydesc:
You tend to cry often.
You will automatically start crying at high depression levels.
You can cancel the crying action at any time.
Crying will produce audible noise to zombies.
UI_trait_cuttingtoolsdesc: Gains +20%% XP when using Axes, Short Blades, or Long Blades with the main hand.
UI_trait_deaddroprunnerdesc: You are used to moving fast between hidden caches without drawing attention.
UI_trait_deadeyefocusdesc: When you aim, the world narrows and panic bleeds away.
UI_trait_defenselessdesc:
You've never learned how to defend yourself, making you slow in combat.
-5 Combat Mastery
UI_trait_demostronggripdesc: Heavy long blunt weapons like sledgehammers or clubs consume less endurance when swinging.
UI_trait_depressivedesc:
You're prone to bouts of sadness.
You occassionally become sad. While depressed, sadness stacks until removed.
UI_trait_depressivemooddesc:
Often sad. May become depressed for no reason.
Bad mood can affect productivity.
(Unhappiness builds up over time.
Sudden depression may occur once every few days.
Reduces XP gain in all skills depending on
Unhappiness moodle, up to -10%%.)
UI_trait_depriveddesc: You begin the game with absolutely nothing - not even clothes!
UI_trait_disciplineddesc:
Diligent and focused, constantly striving to improve themselves, they make for excellent Martial Artists and Meditation masters.

Not very interested in passive entertainment.
Comfort need - reduced rate and positive/negative effects.
UI_trait_discodesc: This person has a preference for oldies music.
UI_trait_disconodesc: This person would prefer to hear anything but oldies music.
UI_trait_drinkerdesc:
You have a dependence on alcohol. If you go too long without alcohol, you'll begin to feel stressed, then pain, and eventually withdrawal.
If you go through withdrawal, you will grow progressively more sick until you drink again or die.
You begin the game with one bottle of whiskey - better find more booze soon.
UI_trait_ectomorphdesc:
Trains Fitness faster, but trains Strength slower.
Prone to lose weight.
(+30%% Fitness XP, -30%% Strength XP,
+30%% calorie burn if weight is over than 70.)
UI_trait_efficientDesc: For some reason, you're faster than everyone else.
UI_trait_endomorphdesc:
Trains Strength faster, but trains Fitness slower.
Prone to gain weight.
(+30%% Strength XP, -30%% Fitness XP,
-30%% calorie burn if weight is less than 90.)
UI_trait_enjoytheridedesc:
Driving at high speed reduces Stress and Unhappiness.
Able to repair sport vehicles.
(Vehicle speed must be over 60 MPH.)
UI_trait_entomologistdesc: Increases chance to find insects in Search mode.
UI_trait_evasivedesc:
You're agile.
You have a 33%% chance to dodge any incoming attack.
When dodged, you have no hit animation.
UI_trait_exaddictdesc:
Formerly dependent.
Using addictive drugs may cause dependence to return.
UI_trait_expertdriverdesc:
You drive cars much more effectively.
Vehicles move faster, make less noise, and handle more efficiently.
UI_trait_fastdesc:
You were always quick on your feet.
You move 15%% more quickly.
UI_trait_fasthandsdesc: Your fingers move quickly under pressure, helping with tools, packs, and close survival work.
UI_trait_fastmetabolismdesc:
Prone to lose weight.
Trains Fitness faster, but Strength slower.
(+30%% calorie burn if weight is more than 70,
+30%% Fitness XP, -30%% Strength XP.)
UI_trait_fearfuldesc: You're easily scared and likely to scream aloud if panicked.
UI_trait_fearofthedarkdesc:
Fear of the dark. Panic without light sources.
Being in the dark for a long time also increases stress.
UI_trait_fieldrepairdesc: You are used to keeping broken machinery alive with limited tools and improvised parts.
UI_trait_fitteddesc: Worn clothing weighs half as much and does not impose any speed penalty.
UI_trait_footballplayerdesc:
Reduces the likelyhood of tripping when running or sprinting at zombies.
Increases the chance of knocking down a zombie when running or sprinting at them. 
Removes all clothing related discomfort.
UI_trait_formeralcoholicdesc:
Has a chance of relapsing and becoming an Alcoholic again when drinking alcohol.
The chance of relapsing becomes lower with each passing day.
UI_trait_formersmokerdesc:
Has a chance of relapsing and becoming a Smoker again when using tobacco products.
The chance of relapsing becomes lower with each passing day.
UI_trait_fountain_deal_quickhands_desc: Most timed actions are much faster
UI_trait_fountain_deal_starving_desc: You need to eat and drink 4x more
UI_trait_fountain_deal_xp_desc: You gain 100%% more XP for all your skills
UI_trait_fragilehealthdesc:
Trains Strength and Fitness slower.
Carrying too much may cause health problems.
(-30%% Strength and Fitness XP,
Heavy Load moodle gradually reduces health to 50%%.)
UI_trait_fuelsickdesc: Gas fumes, engines, and chemical smells turn your stomach quickly.
UI_trait_gasmanagementdesc:
Transfers inventory items, refuels vehicles and drains gasoline faster.
(-25%% inventory transferring time, refueling vehicles and draining gasoline.
Up to -60%% inventory transferring time with "Dextrous" trait.)
UI_trait_gaussTrait1desc: Knows how to make and operate gauss weaponry (20%% less charge per shot when using a gauss weapon)
UI_trait_gaussTrait2desc: Knows how to make and efficiently operate gauss weaponry (40%% less charge per shot when using a gauss weapon)
UI_trait_gearhoarderdesc: You hate leaving supplies behind, even when carrying them is a terrible idea.
UI_trait_generatordesc: You know how to operate a generator.
UI_trait_generatorexpertdesc:
Knows how to operate and repair generators.
(Repairing a generator increases its condition by an additional 5%%.)
UI_trait_genexpdesc:
Knows how to operate and repair generators.
(Repairing a generator increases its condition by an additional 5%%.)
UI_trait_gimpdesc:
You've always been the last in line.
You move 15%% more slowly.
UI_trait_glassbodydesc:
You're particularly vulnerable and frail.
You take twice as much damage from all sources.
You become easily scratched from minor injuries.
Even a short fall or moderate damage can result in a broken bone.
Heavy Encumberance can result in severe damage.
UI_trait_goodmemoryDesc: Receive more XP as you regain your memories.
UI_trait_gordanitedesc:
You are adept at using crowbars as weapons.
Your attacks with crowbars have a higher critical hit chance as well as increased base damage.
Effect scales with Long Blunt skill.
UI_trait_gourmanddesc:
You delight in food of all kinds and find cooking an enjoyable sport.
Food cooks in half the time and takes twice as long to burn.
More likely to find Fresh ingredients.
Food that you cook is better.
Temperature of food and method of cooking does not bother you.
UI_trait_graverobberdesc:
While others find it difficult, you have no qualms pilfering the remains of the dead.
You are more likely to find loot on zombie corpses.
+1 Scavenging if Scavenging Skill mod enabled
UI_trait_gridsensedesc: You understand power flow, improvised wiring, and the risks of damaged electrical systems.
UI_trait_gruntdesc: You worked some odd-jobs here and there.
UI_trait_gu_kid_desc: You are a child. Small, weak, and scared.
UI_trait_gunenthusiastRFNGPdesc: A regular at the local firing range
UI_trait_gunspecialistdesc: Begin the game with advanced knowledge of guns.
UI_trait_gymgoerdesc:
You enjoy working out.
Exercise is twice as effective for you.
Exercise Fatigue lasts half the time than usual.
UI_trait_happyreaderdesc: Reading organizes your thoughts and lifts your mood. Making progress in books and magazines reduces unhappiness, boredom, and stress.
UI_trait_hardbargainerdesc: You survived enough desperate trades to read people and keep your nerve.
UI_trait_hardydesc:
Whether by force of will or physical fitness, you're not one to tire after long hours working.
Your maximum endurance is increased by 25%%
UI_trait_heavyaxemybeloveddesc:
Heavy axes like wood axes or battle axes consume less endurance when swinging.
Gains additional Axe XP when chopping trees.
UI_trait_heroindependentdesc:
Stress and unhappiness rise when heroin is not used.
Stress and unhappiness decrease after using heroin.
UI_trait_highsweatydesc:
Increases wetness generated.
(Sweating increases during combat, running or doing fitness.)
UI_trait_holidaydesc: This person has a preference for holiday music.
UI_trait_holidaynodesc: This person would prefer to hear anything but holiday music.
UI_trait_idealweightdesc:
You like to keep your weight in check.
You gain 1.5x calories when under 78 weight.
You gain 0.75x calories when above 82 weight.
UI_trait_immunocompromiseddesc:
Your immune system is vulnerable to infection.
Your wounds tend to become infected.
You have a 25%% greater chance to become zombified
Note: This trait will still let you be infected by zombie injuries, even if you disable transmission in the sandbox.
UI_trait_improvedforagingdesc: Increases the chances of finding specific items in Search Mode depending on your occupation.
UI_trait_improvisedcleaningdesc:
Can make improvised cleaning supplies.
Knows how to make Bleach and Cleaning Liquid.
UI_trait_improvisedsplintsdesc: You are better at stabilizing injuries and keeping pain under control with crude medical supplies.
UI_trait_improviserdesc: Can craft shivs, aerosol bombs, and smoke bombs.
UI_trait_inattentivedesc: You cannot gain any xp in Scavenging, ever.
UI_trait_incomprehensivedesc:
You're not as thorough as most.
You tend to find less items while searching containers.
UI_trait_indefatigabledesc:
You're one hard person to kill. Whenever you are reduced below 15%% HP or dragged down, you are healed to full HP.
This effect may only occur once per character and it cures zombification.
Note: This does not heal injuries caused by Injured or Broke Leg.
UI_trait_ingenuitivedesc:
You have a knack for figuring things out.
You automatically know all recipes that would otherwise require a magazine or professional knowledge.
(This also includes recipes added by mods.)
UI_trait_injureddesc:
You begin the game with moderate injuries.
Note: You won't start with zombification and your wounds are bandaged.
UI_trait_jazzdesc: This person has a preference for jazz music.
UI_trait_jazznodesc: This person would prefer to hear anything but jazz music.
UI_trait_journalkeeperdesc: Writing keeps your mind organized, lowering boredom and stress over time.
UI_trait_juryriggingdesc: You can make ugly repairs work long enough to matter.
UI_trait_killjoydesc: Large crowds, loud music, and frenetic energy are not your cup of tea.
UI_trait_knoxleftdeafdesc:
You hear nothing in your left ear.
Your right ear still hears normally, so quiet sounds carry as far as ever.
Anything on your left must bend around your head to reach you: you hear it, but dull and without its edge.
You cannot tell which side a sound comes from.
UI_trait_knoxrightdeafdesc:
You hear nothing in your right ear.
Your left ear still hears normally, so quiet sounds carry as far as ever.
Anything on your right must bend around your head to reach you: you hear it, but dull and without its edge.
You cannot tell which side a sound comes from.
UI_trait_labdisciplinedesc: You keep notes, isolate variables, and stay calm around sickness and equipment.
UI_trait_larkpersondesc:
Prefers to be awake in the morning.
(Fatigue gains more slowly in the morning (05:00 a.m. - 10:00 a.m.),
but faster in the evening (05:00 p.m. - 10:00 p.m.)).
UI_trait_lastpush_desc: Try to escape the death with your last push in your last moments.
UI_trait_leadfootdesc:
You've always had a heavy step and now it's time to put your foot down - on some zombies.
Your stomps are considerably more powerful.
UI_trait_lesssweatydesc:
Reduces wetness generated.
(May be less effective while under rain.)
UI_trait_lifelonglearnerdesc: Does not get bored while reading educational literature.
UI_trait_lightpackerdesc: You pack cleanly and distribute weight well, carrying more before the load starts to punish you.
UI_trait_liquidblooddesc:
Wounds bleeds more.
(+100%% damage from bleeding.)
UI_trait_loodoman_desc:
Unlocks tinkering ability.
+20%% chance to not consume items when reforging.
3x reforging speed (6x when combined with Reforger).
+7.77%% chance of legendary modifier when reforging.
77.77%% chance the reforged item will be of bad quality.
UI_trait_luckydesc: Sometimes things just go your way.
UI_trait_magnetizingDesc: People that follow you and be more loyal to your cause.
UI_trait_marathonrunnerdesc:
Increases endurance recovery while running.
(Does not affect running while sneaking.)
UI_trait_martialdesc:
You've practiced martial arts and are versed at self-defense.
Your bare-handed attacks deal damage.
Damage scales with Short Blunt skill.
UI_trait_medicationdependentdesc: Without regular medicine, withdrawal brings stress, fatigue, and sickness back fast.
UI_trait_mesomorphdesc: Average body type with no pros or cons.
UI_trait_metaldesc: This person has a preference for metal music.
UI_trait_metalnodesc: This person would prefer to hear anything but metal music.
UI_trait_methdependentdesc:
Stress, fatigue and unhappiness rise when meth is not used.
Using meth removes fatigue but causes prolonged anxiety and panic.
UI_trait_minersendurancedesc:
Has a small chance to partially recover endurance after a successful weapon attack.

UI_trait_packmousedesc:
You always travel light.

UI_trait_popdesc: This person has a preference for pop music.

UI_trait_pronetoillness2desc:
More prone to disease. May accidentally catch a cold.

(+25%% zombification speed, +70%% chance of catching a cold,
+20%% cold strength, +50%% cold progression speed,

UI_trait_psychopathDesc:
For you, the end of the world was just the beginning
Now you can keep doing whatever you did before, but without all the consequences.

Your endurance recovery while sitting is doubled.

UI_trait_quickworkerdesc:
You have a penchant for expedience in all things.

UI_trait_scrapperdesc:
You're good at taking things apart.
Allows you to craft metal sheets and pipes.
UI_trait_scroungerdesc:
You're careful to search every nook and cranny.

+1 Scavenging if Scavenging Skill mod enabled
UI_trait_secondwindcooldown: *Second Wind Is No Longer In Cooldown*
UI_trait_secondwinddesc:
You know to push your body to its limits when heading towards danger.
If there are 3 zombies near you while you're exhausted or very tired, gain full endurance and restore fatigue.
Second Wind has a cooldown of 14 days, however it is halved if it didn't recover any fatigue.
UI_trait_selfdestructivedesc:
When the going gets tough, you crumble.
While sad, your health begins to decline down to a maximum relative to your unhappiness level.
UI_trait_sensitivedigestiondesc:
Experiences stomach discomfort, pain, and nausea when overeating.
(The higher the fullness, the stronger the discomfort, pain, and nausea.)
UI_trait_shakyhandsdesc: Stress makes careful work and steady aim harder than they should be.
UI_trait_shelterheartdesc: Walls, a roof, and quiet make you feel safe. Indoor spaces reduce unhappiness, boredom, and stress.
UI_trait_shooter2desc: Has skills in Aiming and Reloading.
UI_trait_signaldisciplinedesc: You work calmly with radios, wiring, and low-profile field communication.
UI_trait_silenthandsdesc: You work with tools, doors, packs, and weapons without making much noise.
UI_trait_sloppydesc:
Tidiness isn't their priority.

Higher tolerance for dirty environments.
Hates Cleaning and takes longer to perform it.
Almost never flushes the toilet on their own.
Clogs the toilet more often.
Higher chance to generate blood/dirt when bloody/dirty and trash when crafting.
UI_trait_slowburnDesc: You are one of the lucky few who are infected but don't turn. You walk among the dead undetected. Zombies ignore you unless provoked. Complete immunity to zombie infection.
UI_trait_slowmetabolismdesc:
Prone to gain weight.
Trains Strength faster, but Fitness slower.
(-30%% calorie burn if weight is less than 90,
+30%% Strength XP, -30%% Fitness XP.)
UI_trait_slowworkerdesc:
Whether because you're lazy or just like to double-check your work, you tend to take longer getting things done.
You perform timed actions (such as sawing logs, crafting items, or disassembling furniture) much more slowly.
UI_trait_snorerdesc: Snores loudly during sleep, attracting unwanted attention.
UI_trait_soalcoholicdesc:
Has an alcohol addiction.
Abstaining from alcohol increases boredom, unhappiness, and thirst.
Prolonged abstinence increases fatigue, stress, headache, and nausea.
Alcohol's effect on drowsiness is reduced.
UI_trait_softstomachdesc: Spoiled food, dirty water, and rough meals hit you harder than most.
UI_trait_sorelegsdesc:
Experiences pain in the legs when walking, running, sprinting, doing fitness and stomping.
While sprinting, the pain and endurance consumption is much higher.
(Sprinting level reduces pain while running and sprinting.
Lightfooted level reduces walking and stomping pain.)
UI_trait_specaiddesc:
You are specialized with First Aid.
Your dedication to this specialization limits your access to other skills.
You receive 25%% XP from all other sources.
Has access to several unique recipes which allow the
improvisation of many medical items.
UI_trait_speccraftingdesc:
You are specialized in all things crafting.

UI_trait_specfooddesc:

UI_trait_specgunsdesc:
You are specialized with the use of all firearms.
