You receive 25%% XP from all other sources.
UI_trait_specialops_adrenalinesurge_Desc: At 40%% Endurance or lower near a zombie, gain 25%% extra Endurance-loss resistance for 45 seconds. 5-minute cooldown.
UI_trait_specialops_ballisticgenius_Desc: Gifted shooter. While aiming and standing still, your sights settle much faster than normal.
UI_trait_specialops_bloodlust_Desc: A qualifying nearby kill restores 15%% Endurance only. 2-minute cooldown; only the nearest eligible operator benefits.
UI_trait_specialops_breachercharge_Desc: Shock entry. Sprinting into zombies can knock them down.
UI_trait_specialops_combathardened_Desc: Desensitized muscle memory. Panic and fear are heavily suppressed in danger.
UI_trait_specialops_combatmobility_Desc: Faster combat movement. While moving under an active zombie threat, new Endurance loss is reduced; it does not restore Endurance or remove Fatigue.
UI_trait_specialops_combattriage_Desc: Unlocks supply-driven Field Triage for nearby wounded allies. Your presence suppresses panic, but never passively heals wounds or infection.
UI_trait_specialops_commandpresence_Desc: Leadership under fire. Nearby allies gain panic suppression and bounded resistance to new incoming Endurance loss; it never restores Endurance or health.
UI_trait_specialops_controlleddemo_Desc: Knows flame bombs, timers, and targeted SOS charges that breach doors and windows without a wide-area blast.
UI_trait_specialops_deadeye_Desc: Precision under stress. Reduced panic while aiming and sharper long-range focus.
UI_trait_specialops_demolitions_Desc: Trained in charges, wiring, and field repairs. Strong technical foundation.
UI_trait_specialops_demolitionsspec_Desc: +3 Electrical and stronger field engineering instincts.
UI_trait_specialops_fieldbreaching_Desc: Knows pipe bombs, noise makers, smoke, aerosol charges, and cheaper SOS field-expedient versions.
UI_trait_specialops_fieldmedic_Desc: Advanced First Aid training without passive wound healing or infection reduction.
UI_trait_specialops_fieldsurgeon_Desc: +3 First Aid and advanced trauma readiness.
UI_trait_specialops_ghostprotocol_Desc: Silent movement discipline. Greatly reduced chance to attract attention while sneaking.
UI_trait_specialops_gunfighter_Desc: Fire on the move with faster aim settle, less strain, better combat movement, and much lighter firearms.
UI_trait_specialops_ironwill_Desc: Unbreakable mindset. Unhappiness and boredom drain far slower.
UI_trait_specialops_juryrig_Desc: Knows SOS Field Repair and Advanced Field Repair — use them on damaged weapons and tools to restore condition with scrap and tape.
UI_trait_specialops_lightweapons_Desc: Firearms in your inventory weigh significantly less, so you can carry more guns and ammo.
UI_trait_specialops_loadoutassault_Desc: Start with a shotgun, shells, and a sledgehammer.
UI_trait_specialops_loadoutcarbine_Desc: Start with an assault rifle, magazines, and basic combat kit.
UI_trait_specialops_loadoutcovert_Desc: Start with a suppressed-style pistol kit, knife, and stealth gear.
UI_trait_specialops_loadoutcqc_Desc: Start with a pistol, melee weapons, and close-quarters kit.
UI_trait_specialops_loadoutheavy_Desc: Start with an assault rifle, lots of ammo, and heavy provisions.
UI_trait_specialops_loadoutmarksman_Desc: Start with a hunting rifle, ammo, and overwatch kit.
UI_trait_specialops_loadoutparatrooper_D: Start with a carbine kit, rope, bag, and drop-zone survival gear.
UI_trait_specialops_loadoutsupport_Desc: Start with medical supplies, food, water, and utility gear.
UI_trait_specialops_nightops_Desc: Comfortable in the dark. Much less panic at night.
UI_trait_specialops_oneshotdoctrine_Desc: After you settle your aim, the first firearm hit hits much harder and can stagger the target. Re-aim to ready the next killing shot.
UI_trait_specialops_operator_Desc: Years of black-ops deployments. Strong baseline combat fitness, weapons handling, and a base carry capacity of 20 before Strength and condition modifiers. Starts with an armorer manual for suppressors and laser modules.
UI_trait_specialops_painkiller_Desc: Adds strong, capped pain and strain resistance. Injuries and existing pain still require treatment.
UI_trait_specialops_quickdraw_Desc: Faster weapon handling instincts. Better Aiming and Reloading foundation.
UI_trait_specialops_runngun_Desc: Fire on the move. Aim settles much faster while moving, and panic/fatigue build slower. Crosshair still blooms a bit vs standing still (vanilla), but far less than a normal shooter.
UI_trait_specialops_scoutsense_Desc: While sneaking (and enabled), nearby zombies pulse as green HUD pins and edge arrows for about 1–2 seconds — including contacts behind you and through walls. Toggle with N (Options → Key Bindings) or the world context menu.
UI_trait_specialops_secondwind_Desc: At 20%% Endurance or lower, restore 30%% Endurance. 10-minute cooldown; recovery scales with sandbox settings.
UI_trait_specialops_shadowcloak_Desc: At night while sneaking, your ghost effect is stronger — zombies forget you across a wider radius.
UI_trait_specialops_silentstep_Desc: While sneaking, nearby zombies lose interest more easily and struggle to keep a lock on you.
UI_trait_specialops_squadaura_Desc: Active command radius. Nearby allies gain strong panic suppression and non-stacking resistance to new incoming Endurance loss; it never restores Endurance or health.
UI_trait_specialops_steadyhands_Desc: Rock-solid aiming discipline that suppresses panic while aiming without removing fatigue.
UI_trait_specialops_stimulantprotocol_De: Additional First Aid and fitness training for sustained field operations.
UI_trait_specialops_tacticalawareness_De: Situational mastery. Panic spikes are crushed; you stay composed in chaos.
UI_trait_specialops_tacticalelectronics_: Knows generators, makeshift radios, remote triggers, timers, and improvised lights.
UI_trait_specialops_traumaresponse_Desc: Additional First Aid training for recognizing and responding to battlefield trauma.
UI_trait_specialops_unstoppable_Desc: At 35 health or lower, restore 35%% Endurance only. 12-minute cooldown; recovery scales with sandbox settings.
UI_trait_specialops_warhero_Desc: +2 Aiming, +2 Reloading, +2 Sprinting from prior deployments.
UI_trait_specmovedesc:
You are specialized with movement.
Your dedication to this specialization limits your access to other skills.
You receive 25%% XP from all other sources.
UI_trait_specweaponsdesc:
You are specialized with the use of all melee weapons.
Your dedication to this specialization limits your access to other skills.
You receive 25%% XP from all other sources.
UI_trait_speedreloaderdesc: You've practiced the art of reloading firearms and magazines
UI_trait_steadyhandsdesc: When aiming a firearm, your hands hold steady
UI_trait_stonerdesc: Does not get sleepy or hungry from smoking pot, but needs more for the same effect.
UI_trait_streetmedicdesc: You learned fast medicine in bad places, where clean rooms and calm patients are rare.
UI_trait_strongbackdesc:
Increases carry weight.
(Plus 1-2 carry weight depending on Strength level.)
UI_trait_stronggripdesc:
Heavy weapons consume less endurance when swinging.
(affects weapons with heavy attacks, changing their increased stamina consumption to the base)
UI_trait_superimmunedesc:
You have an exceptionally strong immune system.
Your wounds can never become infected.
You are completely immune to death by Zombification, however it will take weeks to fully recover from the virus.
UI_trait_swordenthusiastRANBdesc: You collect and maintain swords on the regular.
UI_trait_tavernbrawlerdesc:
You are more effective at using whatever is available to you as a weapon.
Improvised weapons (such as, but not limited to: Spoons, Forks, Pool Cues, or Frying Pans) are slightly more effective and much less likely to break.
Please note that improvised weapons will never be a good alternative to proper weapons, but this trait makes them more usable as a stopgap.
UI_trait_techsavvydesc: Immune to computer viruses. +25%% XP from training disks. +15%% XP from data recovery.
UI_trait_terminatordesc:
You're all man, no machine, but with firearm in hand, you may as well be a killing machine. Hasta la vista, baby.
25%% extra damage from guns.
Doubled aiming speed, increased range, decreased panic and stress when holding a gun.
+3 Aiming, +2 Reloading, +1 Nimble.
You do not gain XP multiplier by this trait. The bonus levels do not show in character creation menu.
UI_trait_thickblooddesc: You bleed more slowly from wounds.
UI_trait_tidydesc:
Keeping their living space clean comes easy to them.

Less chance to generate blood/dirt when bloody/dirty and trash when crafting.
Enjoys Cleaning and the action is done faster.
UI_trait_tinkerer2Desc: The go-to tech guru: adept at repairing gadgets & knows how to craft special explosives.
UI_trait_tinkererdesc: You have a habit of tinkering with things.
UI_trait_tirelessdesc:
Has a small chance to partially recover endurance after a successful weapon attack.
Muscle strain recovers faster.
UI_trait_tonedeafdesc: Not gifted with a good ear for <SPACE><RGB:1,0.8,0> Music <RGB:1,1,1><SPACE> and can't stand this kind of entertainment, they much prefer peace and quiet.
UI_trait_toolclumsydesc: Tools never sit right in your hands. Repairs and salvage work wear you down.
UI_trait_toughdesc: You're exceptionally mentally resilient. You'll quickly adapt to the hardships of the apocalypse.
UI_trait_trailmemorydesc: You remember routes, landmarks, and quiet paths, staying calmer outdoors and at night.
UI_trait_tranquildesc: Remains unfazed by what would make others panic.
UI_trait_truemoozicfanDesc: Loves music. Boredom, stress and unhappiness fade twice as fast while listening to songs on any music device. Starts with a walkman, headphones and 3 random cassettes.
UI_trait_uglyDesc: Lower chance that people will forgive your trespassees.
UI_trait_underweightDesc2:
Low combat effectiveness, low endurance and prone to injury.
Starts with 70 weight and Fast Metabolism trait.
UI_trait_unefficientdesc:
You are lazy and slow.
-2 Efficiency
UI_trait_unlimitedtraitpointsDesc: Unlimited points to spend on other traits.
UI_trait_unluckydesc:
What could go wrong for you, often does.
-10%% chance to find rare loot.
+5%% chance of failing item repairs.
UI_trait_unluckydsc: What could go wrong for you, often does.
UI_trait_unwaveringdesc:
Damage penalty from being low on endurance, being tired or in pain is greatly reduced.
Penalty for movement speed from injuries is decreased.
You recover from zombie attacks twice as fast.
UI_trait_usedtocorpsesdesc:
Decaying corpses do not cause nausea.
(If do not have nausea at the moment. Does not affect zombification sickness.)
UI_trait_vagabonddesc:
You know how to survive on the streets.
You know that there is always something to eat where people would never look, namely the trash.
You tend to find more food items in garbage containers.
Chance affected by luck.
+1 Scavenging if Scavenging Skill mod enabled
UI_trait_veryunderweightDesc2:
Very low combat effectiveness, very low endurance and prone to injury.
Starts with 60 weight and Fast Metabolism trait.
UI_trait_virtuosodesc: Musicians at heart, with a natural talent for playing and composing <SPACE><RGB:1,0.8,0> Music <RGB:1,1,1><SPACE>, they also make for very charismatic performers.
UI_trait_volatiledesc:
You tend to be affected by depression more than others.
Chance to have a mental breakdown and start crying at high depression levels.
You won't be able to control your character until he/she finishes crying.
Crying will produce audible noise to zombies.
UI_trait_vulnerabledesc:
You're not very skilled at fighting with weapons.
-2 Combat Mastery
UI_trait_vulturedesc: You know where to look for the good stuff.
UI_trait_weakbackdesc:
Reduces carry weight.
(Minus 1-3 carry weight depending on Strength level.)
UI_trait_weaponHistorianDesc:
You're familiar with rudimentary blacksmithing technique.
You know how to smith some simple medieval weaponry.
UI_trait_weathersensitivedesc: May experience headaches when the weather changes and when it rains/snows.
UI_trait_welding_knowledge_desc: Has knowledge of welding and basic metalwork.
UI_trait_welding_knowledge_desc2: Has knowledge of welding and basic metalwork.
UI_trait_wildsmandesc:
You are trained to live off the land.
You have knowledge of basic stick trap recipes as well as the ability to craft a basic fishing rod.
UI_trait_woodaxemybeloveddesc:
Gain additional Axe experience when chopping trees.
Can use Wood Axe more effectively in combat.
(Wood Axe swings cost less endurance.)
UI_trait_woodcutterdesc: You know a thing or three about swinging an axe around..
UI_trait_worlddesc: This person has a preference for world music.
UI_trait_worldnodesc: This person would prefer to hear anything but world music.
UI_trait_zReAntibodiesDesc: Your immunity can suppress the zombie virus.
UI_traitdesc_Abuelita: Your recipes and energy keep others alive, even on worst days.
UI_traitdesc_Agrofitness: Your active life made you strong and resilient. Physical effort doesn't scare you.
UI_traitdesc_ArritmiaCardiaca: Risk of heart attack under high panic
UI_traitdesc_Breacher: Melee weapons deal twice as much damage to doors.
UI_traitdesc_CarneDura: You endure pain and regain some stamina while suffering
UI_traitdesc_Chamanismo: You master ancient knowledge: you hunt, gather, and use nature to your advantage.
UI_traitdesc_Chatarrero: Your life among scrap taught you to give new life to old metals.
UI_traitdesc_CorazonMuerto: Nearly immune to panic; stress greatly reduced
UI_traitdesc_Cuidador: You have patience and a gentle hand to care for others and keep things tidy.
UI_traitdesc_Demolitionist: Increases explosion power and blast radius of explosives.
UI_traitdesc_Desgraciado: Your body's been beaten by life. Tired, weak, and unlucky.
UI_traitdesc_Despojo: Your health is fragile and your food rarely tastes good.
UI_traitdesc_Desterrado: Exile made you clumsy and distrustful. Moving unseen is hard for you.
UI_traitdesc_Devoto: You trust faith more than science. You walk with purpose—but clumsily.
UI_traitdesc_DownRanger: Increased max range for all firearms. Scales with Aiming.
UI_traitdesc_Envidioso: Envy clouds your judgment. You move awkwardly, consumed by comparison.
UI_traitdesc_Epilepsia: Random seizures may knock you unconscious
UI_traitdesc_Esmirriao: Your weak body barely handles effort. Tools feel heavy in your hands.
UI_traitdesc_FaultySpots: Better critical chance and damage when using a ranged weapon that has optics attached. Scales with Aiming.
UI_traitdesc_Feo: You're not pretty or subtle, but survival isn't about looks.
UI_traitdesc_FibrosisPulmonar: Physical effort reduces health while running
UI_traitdesc_Flojo: Gets tired sooner and recovers stamina more slowly
UI_traitdesc_Gafe: If something can go wrong, it will—and usually with you.
UI_traitdesc_Gato: Recovers stamina faster and builds less fatigue while moving
UI_traitdesc_Gunsmith: Firearms lose condition slower. Scales with Maintenance.
UI_traitdesc_HeaveHo: Increases throwing range of explosives. Scales with Strength.
UI_traitdesc_HeavyHitter: Heavy melee weapons (e.g. Sledgehammer) swing faster and use less endurance. Scales with Long Blunt.
UI_traitdesc_Hemorratico: Bleeding is dangerous and drains health faster
UI_traitdesc_Herido: You start wounded and bleeding (2 bandages in inventory)
UI_traitdesc_HuesosDeAcero: General toughness; recover from hits more easily
UI_traitdesc_Iluminado: You are one with silence. No one notices you until it's too late.
UI_traitdesc_Inmunodeficiencia: Accelerated general decay; illnesses last longer
UI_traitdesc_LastLaugh: Drop a live grenade when you die. (Has Mod Options)
UI_traitdesc_LicensedMover: Gain the knowledge of a professional mover with the ability to pick-up any furniture item, irregardless of previously required skills or tools.
UI_traitdesc_LocknLoad: Chance to load/unload 2 bullets at a time. Scales with Reloading.
UI_traitdesc_LoveTheSpread: Shotguns gain increased stopping power and knockdown chance. Scales with Aiming.
UI_traitdesc_MakeshiftWarrior: Melee weapons lose condition slower. Scales with Maintenance.
UI_traitdesc_Maleante: The streets were your school. You can hotwire and break locks with ease.
UI_traitdesc_MandibulaDeAcero: You've got a jaw like an anvil. Blows don't knock you down easily.
UI_traitdesc_ManoDeSanto: Your hands are blessed: you heal wounds and find natural remedies with ease.
UI_traitdesc_ManosSucias: Better performance in combat/repairs; less fatigue when attacking
UI_traitdesc_MartialArtist: Long blades gain increased critical chance. Scales with Long Blade.
UI_traitdesc_MenteSana: Your mind and body are in balance. You adapt quickly to chaos.
UI_traitdesc_MotorRoto: Adrenaline in combat; more fatigue afterwards
UI_traitdesc_NeuralgiaCronica: Sudden bursts of severe pain affect your performance
UI_traitdesc_NightPerson: Nearby enemies and animals are highlighted during the night. (Has Mod Options)
UI_traitdesc_Obsesivo: Increases stress and panic; drains stamina under high panic
UI_traitdesc_Olfateador: Your animal instinct lets you detect traps, prey, and hidden resources.
UI_traitdesc_PerdidoFeliz: In chaos (high panic), you tire out less
UI_traitdesc_PielDeOso: Hunger and thirst affect you less
UI_traitdesc_PistolPreference: Pistols gain increased minimum and maximum damage. Scales with Aiming.
UI_traitdesc_Pocho: Your health was never great. Effort drains you quickly.
UI_traitdesc_ProfetaCiego: Your vision is poor, but you trust your other senses to move.
UI_traitdesc_Pyromaniac: Increases number of flames created by incendiary explosives.
UI_traitdesc_QuickHands: Chance to reload an empty magazine instantly. Scales with Reloading.
UI_traitdesc_RSFBladeArtist: Trained in close-quarters knife work. Hold Sprint near a zombie and attack with any stab weapon to perform an instant jaw-stab kill.
UI_traitdesc_RSFBulldozer: Your massive frame is an unstoppable battering ram. Sprint into zombies to send them flying. Granted automatically at Fat/Obese tier. Obese: 100%% knockdown. Fat: 50%% knockdown.
UI_traitdesc_RSFExecutioner: Skilled in brutal finishing blows. Hold Run and Aim near a zombie, then attack with any melee weapon to deliver a devastating two-hit combo: an overhead chop drops the zombie to its knees, followed by an automatic uppercut that finishes it off.
UI_traitdesc_RataCallejera: Less hunger/thirst and reduced fatigue while moving
UI_traitdesc_Recio: You're tough as a rock; you endure pain and fatigue better than most.
UI_traitdesc_Refugiado: You learned to survive with what's available. You build, repair, and maintain your shelter.
UI_traitdesc_Reparador: Your hands were made to fix things. Nothing breaks twice under your watch.
UI_traitdesc_Rifleman: Rifles gain increased minimum and maximum damage. Scales with Aiming.
UI_traitdesc_RugidoInterior: When your health drops, you gain endurance and composure
UI_traitdesc_SangreVieja: Veteran’s calm: less panic and constant fatigue reduction
UI_traitdesc_Slugger: Baseball bats swing faster. Scales with Long Blunt.
UI_traitdesc_SmartShot: Increased chance to hit your target. Scales with Aiming.
UI_traitdesc_SuperSlam: Melee weapons gain increased pushback. Scales with Strength.
UI_traitdesc_TaxRefund: Chance to refund a spent bullet back into the gun's chamber. Scales with Reloading.
UI_traitdesc_Terminal: Latent infection: after 48 hours, health starts draining
UI_traitdesc_Tranquilo: You don't get rattled easily. You move calmly, without noise or haste.
UI_traitdesc_Viejo: Experience is your best tool. You survive with calm and wisdom.
UI_traitdesc_Woodchucker: Axes deal twice as much damage to trees and use less endurance.
